title: Research Scientist in Economics of Sustainability (m/f)
description:
Description:


Language: English (UK)
Location: Esch-sur-Alzette
Country: Luxembourg

Organisation data: Luxembourg Centre for Socio-Environmental Systems
Job Number: UOL08508
Contract Type: Permanent
Expected Start Date: 01/11/2026

Job Level: level 1
Functions: Researcher
Role Type: Cluster
Expertise: Researcher / Postdoctorant
Job (internal): Research scientist


Your role:

The successful candidate will establish internationally visible research at the interface of economics, sustainability science and global environmental change, developing new quantitative approaches to understand and steer transformations across food, land, water and natural-resource systems.
The candidate's research will combine economic theory, fine-scale spatial data, empirical evidence and computational modelling to explain trade-offs, synergies and spillovers that remain hidden in single-scale analyses. Relevant research may address at least three of the following fields: agricultural production, labor markets, natural-resource scarcity, food security, climate change, technological change, impacts of demographic transition, social cohesion, resilience of supply chains, environmental policy, and the distributional consequences of sustainability transformations.
A key ambition is to move beyond diagnosing unsustainable trajectories towards designing effective and equitable transformation pathways, exploring how policy, innovation and global interconnectedness can reconcile environmental sustainability with food security, livelihoods and economic development.


Your profile:

The successful candidate holds a strong academic background in economics, agricultural or environmental economics, together with an internationally recognized research record. They have demonstrated expertise in economic theory and quantitative modelling, complemented by experience with spatially explicit data, empirical estimation, computational methods or other approaches capable of linking processes across scales.
Additionally, they can translate theoretical concepts into transparent, empirically grounded models and integrate economic analysis with insights and data from other disciplines. Experience in interdisciplinary research on food, land, water, climate, natural resources or related sustainability challenges can be proven by documented participation within interdisciplinary networks and projects.
The successful candidate is an intellectually independent researcher with the ambition to build a collaborative, interdisciplinary research team, attract competitive research funding, develop innovative methodological approaches and contribute to policy-relevant sustainability science. A commitment to open, reproducible research, excellent communication across disciplinary boundaries, and the ability to engage effectively with policy and practice are essential.


The ideal candidate will have:

• A PhD in a relevant field and a minimum of 4 years Postdoc experience demonstrating ability to independently develop a research agenda
• A strong capability to think out of the box and shape their research around the challenges posed by interdisciplinary questions
• A strong record of research excellence, evidenced by impactful publications and success in securing external research funding
• Willingness to contribute to teaching programmes at the undergraduate and graduate levels in areas related to environmental change and socio-environmental systems


Language requirements:

The University of Luxembourg is set in a multilingual and multicultural context. The person hired for this position must have an excellent command of English. The University encourages its staff to learn additional languages and provides access to language courses to this end.


We offer:

• A modern, dynamic university with a personal and inclusive atmosphere. Multilingual and international character. Staff coming from more than 90 countries. Member of The Guild of European Research Intensive Universities
• An exceptional research environment, supported by skilled staff and high-quality equipment. Strong links to professional sectors and the Luxembourg labour market. A unique urban campus with excellent infrastructure
• A partner for society and industry. Cooperation with European institutions, innovative companies, the Financial Centre and a wide range of non-academic partners including ministries, local governments, associations, and NGOs
• Attractive salary and benefits packages with excellent opportunities for external funding. Support for career development and mentoring. Services to promote staff well-being and a healthy work-life balance


How to apply:

Applications should contain:

• CV; you may include any periods of absence from work, such as family-related leave or career breaks, if you consider them relevant for the fair assessment of your experience
• Cover letter detailing your motivation for applying to the advertised research topic and/or project, including how your background, interests, and career goals align with its objective
• Short description of profile, key achievements and impact, summarizing main publications and projects
• Lists of publications, research projects, PhD theses supervised and subjects taught if applicable


All applications will be handled in the strictest confidence. Applications by post or e-mail cannot be considered. Early application is highly encouraged, as the applications will be processed upon reception.

The University is committed to achieving gender parity among its academic staff. Opportunities in locations including: the UK, Luxembourg, France, Germany, Spain, Italy, Sweden and the Netherlands. While we will consider location preferences if possible, we ask you to be as location-agnostic as possible since you may receive an offer from any of these corporate locations. Fluency in English is essential for all roles in Europe and local language skills are highly desirable for some positions, but are not essential for every role.

At Amazon, we are excited to offer MBA candidates the opportunity to launch into big careers with limitless possibilities. We know searching for a full-time role is as much about finding a company where you can picture yourself being successful as it is about finding the right role. We look forward to meeting you and your classmates this year. As we get to know you more, we invite you to get to know us better.
Visit www.amazon.com/about to learn more about...

• Our businesses by reviewing Press Releases on our Investor Relations site, CEO Andy Jassy's 2022 Letter to Shareholders, and the first letter shared in 1997, which is included in our annual report each year
• Amazonians - and follow us on Facebook, Twitter, and LinkedIn
• Our commitment to our communities, diversity and military veterans
• Our European offices, our headquarters in Seattle, as well as where we operate around the world

Important Notes

• You will have the opportunity to specify location and business preference when you create your candidate profile and submit your application within the Amazon portal.
• You need only to submit one Amazon job application for all roles listed below (please use your school e-mail).
• We are looking for candidates who want to own, build and impact the customer experience over being tied to a specific role or team. The role and team placement will be based on business needs and as Amazon continues to grow we cannot guarantee that you will be based in the location or business area of your choice, but we will do our best to take your preferences into account.
• Make sure to list your MBA program and expected conferral date (month and year) within the Education section of your online application and on your resume.
• A cover letter is not necessary.

Key job responsibilities

Launch, Amazon's corporate MBA program for Europe, recruits top MBA international talent and builds broad, adaptable Amazonians across corporate businesses in Europe. The program provides a platform for MBAs to make the successful transition from their pre-MBA experience to Amazon. We run a three-year program offering two job rotations supported through on-boarding activities, core training modules, networking opportunities, and mentorship. Launch MBAs start by diving deep to understand customers and how the business is meeting their needs, then apply the learning from their MBA and their own creativity to identify the opportunities where they can make the biggest difference. At the end of the three-year program, MBAs have integrated into Amazon's peculiar ways and have acquired a diverse set of experiences that enable them to take ownership of their next career move through Amazon's extensive internal job opportunities. Through the rotation process, MBAs are able to move to a new function, business, and/or European location.

A day in the life

Opportunities within different business areas vary each year, and can include: Advertising, Amazon Web Services (AWS), Amazon Prime Video, Consumer and Devices/Alexa.

Example full-time job functions include:

• Sr. Business Development Manager: Partners with business leaders to grow the business by creating new partnerships, leveraging existing relationships, and/or licensing assets to drive product improvements and innovation, enable distribution of our application, products and/or services, and reduce costs without sacrificing the customer experience.
• Sr. Category Merchant Manager: Manage the portfolio of third-party merchant accounts, support revenue growth and traffic, conduct regular intensive business analysis and reporting, and support the development of the Fulfillment by Amazon (FBA) program, and manage projects working with our technology teams to build an extraordinary customer experience.
• Sr. Instock Manager: Develop and execute inventory management strategies (including forecasting, capacity planning, and supply chain optimization), determine how to allocate resources for variable cost reduction and profit margin improvement to drive overall profitability for the business unit.
• Sr. Marketing Manager: Develop and execute strategies for growing the size and lifetime value of the business unit's customer base, through both acquisition and CRM strategies for targeting and communicating with customers.
• Sr. Product Manager: Support the definition and launch of new products, services, or features in partnership with technical teams. Evaluate the existing experience(s) for customers on and off Amazon, identify areas for improvement, develop business requirements, craft and implement marketing plans, and own measures of success.
• Sr. Program Manager: Find solutions to complex problems and innovate on leading edge solutions to manage programs broadly across businesses within Amazon. Given responsibility to own those business challenges and the autonomy to think strategically and make data driven decisions. Drive efforts independently and as part of larger project teams, and have a significant impact on the customer experience and the business.
• Sr. Vendor Manager: Identify new brand and product business opportunities, manage relationships with key vendors, negotiate competitive business terms, and secure participation in promotions and marketing programs.

Basic Qualifications

• Currently enrolled in a full-time MBA program at time of application
• Graduating between December 1, 2025 and September 30, 2026
• 3+ years of full-time industry work experience, which occurred between the conferral date from your undergraduate program and prior to starting your MBA, OR 3+ years of military work experience prior to starting your MBA program

Preferred Qualifications

• 4+ years of full-time industry/military work experience prior to your MBA
• Fluency in a European language (e.g., German, French, Italian, Spanish)
• Demonstration of interest in the technology industry, such as: Undergraduate/Master's degree in computer science or engineering; prior work experience in a start-up or technology company; SQL or programming experience, etc.
• Experience in sales or account management
• Demonstrated capability of both high-level strategic thinking and detailed execution
• Consistent track record of taking ownership and driving results
• Comfortable with “hands-on” management of tasks, and proven ability to manage multiple, contending priorities simultaneously

description:
Financial Analyst
Job ID: 10552169 | Amazon EU Sarl

Description

At Amazon, we are working to be the most customer-centric company on earth. To get there, we need exceptionally talented, bright, and driven people. Amazon is continually evolving and is a place where motivated employees thrive and also where employee ownership and accountability lead to meaningful results.

The Amazon University Talent Aquisition Team (AUTA) is looking for ambitious Graduates to join us at the heart of our core consumer business. The Financial Analyst will work closely with multiple Pan EU teams within our Category Excellence organization such as Inventory, Management, Planning, Pricing and Operations to streamline our reporting and controlling processes. We are looking for someone who can go beyond reporting and tell the story behind the numbers and propose corrective actions.

Key job responsibilities

• Collecting, analyzing and reviewing quantitative data and creating meaningful reports to drive business improvement and cost reductions
• Root cause analysis and uncovering core issues using data
• Assist with development, and implementation of policies and programs that guide the organization in maintaining and improving its competitive position and profitability
• Assist in the development of all weekly and monthly financial close, all planning, forecasting, and reporting models and their continuous innovation and improving the use and ease of interpretation by your business partners
• Work with data source providers and technology teams to ensure that key decision data is accurate, automated, and timely
• Analysis of tax law and application to Amazon's facts and filing requirements.

A day in the life

You will learn how Finance supports the various business teams in forecasting and analyzing actual financial results, managing the external reporting of Amazon's quarterly financial statements and inputting to the launch of new customer-focused initiatives to ensure customers can find and discover anything and everything they want online.

Basic Qualifications

• In final year of study for Bachelor's or Master's degree, or graduated in the last 12 months
• Studies within Engineering, Commerce, Business administration or similar field

Preferred Qualifications

• Fluent written and verbal communication in English
• Knowledge in MS Office programs as Outlook, Excel and PowerPoint
• Analytical skills
• Planning, prioritization and time-management skills
• Ability to communicate efficiently
• Strong attention to detail
• Experience in financial analysis, retail buying, retail planning & allocation, product/project management, marketing, consulting, negotiation or supply chain is a plus

Your Job in a Nutshell

• Within our International Non-Life department, we are building a new Pan-European business branch operating under the Freedom of Service (FoS) regime.
• Our ambition: bring innovative insurance solutions to B2B partners across Europe — from MGAs and brokers to corporate clients seeking fronting solutions for their captives.
• As Data and Process Manager, you will play a key role in structuring and supervising the entire data process exchange for our international operations.
• You will also be in charge of building processes and optimizing them to create the most efficient organization. You will ensure that data provided by third-party are handled efficiently, compliantly, and in line with Baloise's best practices — a cornerstone of our competitiveness.
• You will work within a multidisciplinary international team operating in start-up and agile mode, reporting directly to the Head of International Non-Life.
• You will be part of an international team shaping a new line of business within a stable and reputable insurance group, with the opportunity to make a tangible impact on our European growth story.

What you can expect

Your main missions will be to:

Financial Management and Data Quality:

• Manage operational financial flows and work closely with Finance teams to ensure the timely and accurate transmission of data.
• Ensure the consistency and reliability of technical and financial data, notably by overseeing proper data reconciliation with actuarial teams and collaborating with partners to enhance the integrity of incoming data flows.

Operational and Cross-Functional Support:

• Coordinate operations across internal teams and external partners.
• Support claims management, fraud investigations, and customer complaints handling, while assisting in the design and deployment of operational processes with partners.
• Collaborate with legal and technical stakeholders whenever required.
• Take ownership of cross-functional topics and urgent requests that have not yet been allocated within the team, stepping in where necessary to ensure business continuity and the successful delivery of activities across functions.
Process Management and Cross-Functional Coordination:
• Define, formalize, document, and continuously improve business processes, including underwriting, claims management, data flows, and reporting.
• Actively manage workflow automation and digitalization initiatives in close collaboration with IT and data teams.
• Ensure that processes comply with applicable regulatory requirements.
• Identify operational pain points and drive problem-solving and process optimization initiatives.
• Act as a central coordination point between operational teams, IT, Finance, and external partners.
• Foster collaboration and ensure seamless coordination across teams to address operational challenges.
• Ensure the timely implementation of IT solutions with our partners and proactively remove any delivery blockers.
• Contribute to the implementation or enhancement of tools and systems supporting operational management.
• Identify opportunities for operational improvement and lead process optimization projects.

What we expect

• Master's degree (or equivalent, Bac+5) in Management, Engineering, Finance, Insurance, or a related field
• At least 5 years of experience in a cross-functional role, with exposure to operational processes, technology, finance, data management, and business operations
• Proven experience in an international and/or multi-country environment is highly desirable
• Strong organizational, problem-solving and analytical skills, with a continuous improvement mindset
• Proven ability to thrive in complex, multicultural environments, ideally within agile or fast-growing organizations.
• Fluency in English (working language); additional European languages (French, German, Spanish) are an asset
• SQL language proficiency

About Baloise

We are more than a traditional insurance company: we are the personal partner for everyone who wants to feel simply safe. In addition to our traditional financial business, we are also broadening our range with ecosystems in the areas of mobility and home. We see the digital age as an opportunity to make our offering even more sustainable, innovative and customer-oriented in the future. Are you shaping it with us?

We give you the freedom to pursue your ideas. Get involved! Question us! Develop yourself and us even further! Our culture of learning and making mistakes as well as communication at eye level all make this possible. Because only together can we move forward.

title: Software Development Engineer (ML), EU International Technologies (m/f)

Description

As an engineer on our team, you will take on a key role in improving capabilities of the Amazon product search service, and ensure we offer top-quality recommendations for all our customers regardless of their location or language. We help customers find the products they are searching for, and discover new products they would be interested in, by developing ML models trained on terabytes of product and traffic data to improve query understanding, ranking of search results, and personalization. We are seeking a software engineer who will assist in deploying those ML models, integrating them into existing services, and optimizing their performance. You will do so by building robust pipelines to train, evaluate, and deploy our models.

This is a rewarding role where you will be able to draw a clear connection between your work and how it improves the experience of millions of Amazon customers across the globe every day. You can also expect to have excellent opportunities, and ample support, for career growth, development, and mentorship. The team is a mixed science/engineering group, with each team member able to contribute to both engineering excellence as well as scientific innovation.

Key job responsibilities

- Design and implement new features across the various software components powering our search system
- Participate in the design and deployment of robust and scalable pipelines for data processing, model training, and model inference
- Build and configure metrics, dashboards, and alerting mechanisms for our deployed services and models
- Work closely with ML experts on your team to identify improvement opportunities and tackle technical obstacles
- Coordinate with engineering counterparts in other teams and stakeholders we work with

A day in the life

You will collaborate with scientists who build ML models trained on terabytes of data, and integrate these models into the production search engine that serves customers, closing the loop through design, implementation, deployment, and monitoring. The chosen approaches for model architecture will balance business-defined performance metrics with the needs of millisecond response times.

EU International Technologies is an organization focused on accelerating the EU Stores business by delighting customers and selling partners. The team's mission is to innovate locally and scale worldwide, fostering a world-class community of builders that delivers with speed and agility. Fluency in English is essential for all roles in Europe and local language skills are highly desirable for some positions, but are not essential for every role.

At Amazon, we are excited to offer MBA candidates the opportunity to launch into big careers with limitless possibilities. We know searching for a full-time role is as much about finding a company where you can picture yourself being successful as it is about finding the right role. We look forward to meeting you and your classmates this year. As we get to know you more, we invite you to get to know us better.
Visit www.amazon.com/about to learn more about...

• Our businesses by reviewing Press Releases on our Investor Relations site, CEO Andy Jassy's 2022 Letter to Shareholders, and the first letter shared in 1997, which is included in our annual report each year
• Amazonians - and follow us on Facebook, Twitter, and LinkedIn
• Our commitment to our communities, diversity and military veterans
• Our European offices, our headquarters in Seattle, as well as where we operate around the world

Important Notes

• You will have the opportunity to specify location and business preference when you create your candidate profile and submit your application within the Amazon portal.
• You need only to submit one Amazon job application for all roles listed below (please use your school e-mail).
• We are looking for candidates who want to own, build and impact the customer experience over being tied to a specific role or team. The role and team placement will be based on business needs and as Amazon continues to grow we cannot guarantee that you will be based in the location or business area of your choice, but we will do our best to take your preferences into account.
• Make sure to list your MBA program and expected conferral date (month and year) within the Education section of your online application and on your resume.
• A cover letter is not necessary.

Key job responsibilities

Launch, Amazon's corporate MBA program for Europe, recruits top MBA international talent and builds broad, adaptable Amazonians across corporate businesses in Europe. The program provides a platform for MBAs to make the successful transition from their pre-MBA experience to Amazon. We run a three-year program offering two job rotations supported through on-boarding activities, core training modules, networking opportunities, and mentorship. Launch MBAs start by diving deep to understand customers and how the business is meeting their needs, then apply the learning from their MBA and their own creativity to identify the opportunities where they can make the biggest difference. At the end of the three-year program, MBAs have integrated into Amazon's peculiar ways and have acquired a diverse set of experiences that enable them to take ownership of their next career move through Amazon's extensive internal job opportunities. Through the rotation process, MBAs are able to move to a new function, business, and/or European location.

A day in the life

Opportunities within different business areas vary each year, and can include: Advertising, Amazon Web Services (AWS), Amazon Prime Video, Consumer and Devices/Alexa.

Example full-time job functions include:

• Sr. Business Development Manager: Partners with business leaders to grow the business by creating new partnerships, leveraging existing relationships, and/or licensing assets to drive product improvements and innovation, enable distribution of our application, products and/or services, and reduce costs without sacrificing the customer experience.
• Sr. Category Merchant Manager: Manage the portfolio of third-party merchant accounts, support revenue growth and traffic, conduct regular intensive business analysis and reporting, and support the development of the Fulfillment by Amazon (FBA) program, and manage projects working with our technology teams to build an extraordinary customer experience.
• Sr. Instock Manager: Develop and execute inventory management strategies (including forecasting, capacity planning, and supply chain optimization), determine how to allocate resources for variable cost reduction and profit margin improvement to drive overall profitability for the business unit.
• Sr. Marketing Manager: Develop and execute strategies for growing the size and lifetime value of the business unit's customer base, through both acquisition and CRM strategies for targeting and communicating with customers.
• Sr. Product Manager: Support the definition and launch of new products, services, or features in partnership with technical teams. Evaluate the existing experience(s) for customers on and off Amazon, identify areas for improvement, develop business requirements, craft and implement marketing plans, and own measures of success.
• Sr. Program Manager: Find solutions to complex problems and innovate on leading edge solutions to manage programs broadly across businesses within Amazon. Given responsibility to own those business challenges and the autonomy to think strategically and make data driven decisions. Drive efforts independently and as part of larger project teams, and have a significant impact on the customer experience and the business.
• Sr. Vendor Manager: Identify new brand and product business opportunities, manage relationships with key vendors, negotiate competitive business terms, and secure participation in promotions and marketing programs.

Basic Qualifications

• Graduating between December 1, 2025 and September 30, 2026
• 3+ years of full-time industry work experience, which occurred between the conferral date from your undergraduate program and prior to starting your MBA, OR 3+ years of military work experience prior to starting your MBA program

Preferred Qualifications

• 4+ years of full-time industry/military work experience prior to your MBA
• Fluency in a European language (e.g., German, French, Italian, Spanish)
• Demonstration of interest in the technology industry, such as: Undergraduate/Master's degree in computer science or engineering; prior work experience in a start-up or technology company; SQL or programming experience, etc.

title: Directeur de la Practice CIO Advisory (h/f)
description:
Directeur de la Practice CIO Advisory (H/F) – Région Liège-Luxembourg

Reference: LU879641
Luxembourg
Permanent
Legal and Professional Services

Notre client est un cabinet de conseil international fondé au début des années 2000 et aujourd'hui présent dans plusieurs pays européens.
Sa mission est d'accompagner les entreprises dans l'atteinte de leurs objectifs en délivrant des résultats mesurables et concrets.
Son expertise couvre l'excellence opérationnelle, l'optimisation de la supply chain, la data, la conduite du changement, la transformation digitale et la transition durable.

Le cabinet intervient auprès d'organisations de premier plan dans des secteurs variés tels que l'industrie, les sciences de la vie, le secteur public, les services financiers, le retail et la construction.
Dans un contexte où les transformations numériques s'accélèrent et où les DSI, CIO et CTO jouent un rôle croissant dans la définition de la stratégie des entreprises, notre client souhaite aujourd'hui franchir une nouvelle étape avec la création et le développement d'une practice CIO Advisory.

Cette practice a vocation à devenir un axe majeur du développement du cabinet, en accompagnant les dirigeants IT et les directions générales dans leurs réflexions et transformations stratégiques, organisationnelles et technologiques.
Pour accompagner sa croissance et participer à des projets de transformation et d'excellence opérationnelle, notre client recherche actuellement un(e) Directeur de la Practice CIO Advisory (H/F).

Votre rôle

En tant que Directeur de la Practice CIO Advisory, vous aurez la responsabilité de piloter et délivrer des missions de transformation IT à fort impact, tout en contribuant au développement de la practice, de son portefeuille clients et de ses équipes.
Vous interviendrez directement auprès des CIO, CTO, DSI et Directions Générales, de la définition des orientations jusqu'à leur mise en œuvre, avec une forte exigence de résultats, de qualité de delivery et d'impact durable.

Pilotage et delivery des missions clients

Vous jouerez un rôle central dans la conduite et la réussite des missions de la practice :

• Piloter des missions complexes de stratégie et transformation IT, de leur cadrage jusqu'à leur mise en œuvre.
• Accompagner les clients dans la définition de leur vision cible IT et sa déclinaison en feuilles de route concrètes et opérationnelles.
• Superviser les diagnostics, analyses, recommandations et plans de transformation réalisés par les équipes.
• Challenger les organisations, processus, architectures et modes de fonctionnement IT afin d'identifier les leviers de performance et de transformation.
• Assurer la qualité des livrables, le respect des engagements et l'atteinte des résultats attendus.
• Intervenir directement auprès des instances de direction et accompagner les clients dans leurs décisions stratégiques.
• Sécuriser l'exécution des transformations et accompagner les équipes clients jusqu'à l'obtention de résultats durables.
Développement et structuration de la practice

En vous appuyant sur les besoins rencontrés sur le terrain, vous contribuerez à faire évoluer et structurer l'offre CIO Advisory :

• Développer des méthodologies et approches permettant de transformer l'expertise acquise en mission en offres structurées et réplicables.
• Identifier les nouvelles problématiques rencontrées par les CIO et faire évoluer l'offre en conséquence.
• Développer des synergies avec les autres expertises du cabinet : cybersécurité, data, ERP, cloud, transformation et excellence opérationnelle.
• Contribuer au positionnement et au développement de la practice au sein de mon client.
Développement commercial et relation client
Le développement commercial s'inscrira dans la continuité de votre activité de conseil et de votre proximité avec les clients :
• Développer des relations de confiance durables avec les CIO, CTO, DSI et Directions Générales.
• Identifier de nouvelles opportunités à partir des enjeux et besoins rencontrés chez les clients.
• Construire et développer un portefeuille de missions CIO Advisory.
• Piloter les avant-ventes, propositions commerciales, appels d'offres et soutenances.
• Développer le cross-selling avec les autres practices et contribuer à la croissance du cabinet.

Leadership et développement des équipes

En tant que Directeur, vous serez également responsable de la qualité et du développement des équipes intervenant sur vos missions :

• Encadrer les équipes et leur apporter le niveau de guidance nécessaire à la réussite des missions.
• Challenger les analyses, recommandations et livrables afin de garantir un haut niveau d'exigence.
• Accompagner les consultants dans leur montée en compétences et leur capacité à prendre progressivement davantage de responsabilités en delivery.
• Transmettre votre expertise à travers le coaching, le mentoring et le partage d'expérience.
• Contribuer au recrutement et au développement des expertises nécessaires à la croissance de la practice.
• Développer une culture fondée sur l'excellence du delivery, le pragmatisme, la collaboration et l'obtention de résultats concrets.

Profil recherché

Nous recherchons avant tout un leader entrepreneurial, capable de combiner expertise technique, excellence du delivery et développement commercial.

Vous disposez idéalement de :

• Une formation de niveau Master (Bac+5), idéalement issue d'une école d'ingénieurs, d'une université ou d'une grande école avec une spécialisation IT, digitale ou technologique.
• Au moins 10 ans d'expérience dans le conseil, la transformation IT ou des environnements technologiques complexes.
• De solides compétences techniques et une forte compréhension des enjeux IT, vous permettant de challenger des architectures, des organisations, des choix technologiques et des trajectoires de transformation.
• Une expertise sur plusieurs dimensions du CIO Advisory : stratégie IT, operating model, cloud, infrastructures, architecture, cybersécurité, data, modernisation ou rationalisation des systèmes d'information.

title: Systems Modeling & AI Research Engineer – Adaptive Security Systems (m/f)
description:
Systems Modeling & AI Research Engineer – Adaptive Security Systems

Position: Systems Modeling & AI Research Engineer – Adaptive Security Systems
Location: Esch-sur-Alzette, Luxembourg
Start Date: Immediate
Type: Full-time

Company Overview

We're LuxQuantum, a Luxembourg-based deep-tech startup developing the next generation of quantum-safe communication systems.

Our mission is to address one of the key challenges in modern cybersecurity: how to combine Quantum Key Distribution (QKD) and Post-Quantum Cryptography (PQC) into a unified, adaptive, and scalable security architecture.

At LuxQuantum, we believe security decisions should not be static. Different data, infrastructures, risks, trust assumptions, and operational conditions may require different protection strategies. That's why we are developing intelligent and adaptive approaches to model these complex environments and support dynamic security and orchestration decisions.

Our work brings together AI, systems modeling, cybersecurity, and quantum-safe communications, creating research challenges that span multiple scientific and engineering disciplines.

We are a small and ambitious team of researchers, engineers, and innovators who enjoy exploring difficult problems, learning across disciplines, and turning research ideas into real-world technology.

Role Overview

As a Systems Modeling & AI Research Engineer, you will contribute to the research and development of the intelligence and decision-making capabilities behind LuxQuantum's adaptive quantum-safe security systems.

You will investigate how complex security and communication systems can adapt to changing risks, uncertainty, trust requirements, infrastructure conditions, and operational constraints. Your work may involve mathematical and computational modeling, optimization, probabilistic methods, AI, or other data-driven and decision-support approaches.

You will work closely with our research and engineering team to formulate research problems, explore and compare different approaches, develop models and algorithms, evaluate them through experiments and simulations, and translate promising results into working prototypes.

The research sits at the intersection of systems modeling, intelligent decision-making, cybersecurity, and quantum-safe communications.

What You'll Do

• Investigate challenging research problems in intelligent and adaptive security systems
• Formulate research questions, develop new approaches, and design experiments and simulations to evaluate them
• Develop mathematical, computational, and AI-based models for decision-making under uncertainty, risk, and changing operational conditions
• Explore adaptive approaches for the orchestration and optimization of hybrid quantum-safe systems
• Design and evaluate methods that help security systems dynamically respond to changing infrastructure, trust, and operational requirements
• Translate research ideas, models, and algorithms into working prototypes and validate them in realistic scenarios
• Collaborate closely with researchers and engineers across software, AI, cybersecurity, and quantum technologies
• Contribute to the technical direction, architecture, and documentation of LuxQuantum's research and development activities

What We're Looking For

• PhD in a quantitative, scientific, engineering, or computing-related field; or a Master's degree with strong relevant research or R&D experience
• Strong research and analytical abilities, with the capacity to investigate complex problems, develop new approaches, and evaluate them systematically
• Experience with quantitative, computational, modeling, optimization, AI/ML, or related research methods
• Good programming and computational skills in one or more languages such as Python, C++, Rust, or similar
• Ability to translate research ideas, mathematical models, or algorithms into working prototypes
• Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively within a small multidisciplinary team
• Curiosity, adaptability, and willingness to learn and work across different technical domains
• Understanding of startup environments and research-driven innovation
• Fluent written and verbal communication in English

We welcome candidates from different scientific, engineering, and computational backgrounds, including PhD graduates, postdoctoral researchers, and researchers interested in transitioning from academia to industrial R&D. Prior experience in quantum technologies or quantum-safe cybersecurity is welcome but not required.

Nice to Have

Experience in any of the following is a plus, but not required:

• Cybersecurity, risk modeling, or security-related systems
• Quantum technologies, Post-Quantum Cryptography (PQC), or Quantum Key Distribution (QKD)
• Complex or distributed systems, simulation, or system orchestration
• Research software development and building experimental prototypes
• APIs, containerization, or ML/MLOps tools such as Docker, FastAPI, MLflow, or similar

Who You Are

• Curious and motivated by difficult problems where the answer is not always known in advance
• An independent thinker who enjoys exploring, testing, and improving new ideas
• Interested in turning research and theory into working systems with real-world impact
• Comfortable taking ownership while collaborating closely with a small multidisciplinary team
• Open to learning across disciplines and applying your expertise to new technical challenges
• Excited by the pace, responsibility, and opportunity to shape technology in an early-stage
deep-tech startup

Why Join LuxQuantum

Research with Real-World Impact

Work on challenging R&D problems and help turn research ideas, models, and algorithms into technologies for next-generation secure communication systems.

High Ownership

Take meaningful ownership of your work and have the opportunity to influence technical decisions and the direction of LuxQuantum's technology.

Work Across Disciplines

Collaborate at the intersection of systems modeling, AI, cybersecurity, software engineering, and quantum-safe communications, with the opportunity to expand your expertise into new areas.

Grow with a Deep-Tech Startup

Join LuxQuantum at an early stage, with the autonomy to explore ideas, take responsibility, and contribute to the development of both our technology and our research-driven engineering culture.

How to Apply

Please send:

• Your CV
• A short cover letter describing your background, relevant research or technical experience, and interest in the role
• Links to relevant projects, technical work, GitHub, or other examples of your work, if available (optional)

to:

contact@luxquantum.lu

Join us in building intelligent, adaptive security systems for the future of quantum-safe communications.

title: (Senior) Spezialist*in Beteiligungsmanagement (Finanzassistent/in)
employer: Commerz Real AG Commerz Real Düsseldorf
description:
Willkommen im Team als

(Senior) Spezialist*in Beteiligungsmanagement

Das Unternehmen:

Die Commerz Real AG ist der Asset Manager der Commerzbank Gruppe und verfügt über 50 Jahre internationale Markterfahrung. Das Unternehmen vereint umfassendes Know-how im Asset Management mit breiter Strukturierungsexpertise und entwickelt daraus sachwertorientierte Fondsprodukte sowie maßgeschneiderte Investmentlösungen in den Bereichen Immobilien und Infrastruktur. Als Leasingdienstleister des Commerzbank-Konzerns bietet die Commerz Leasing zudem bedarfsgerechte Leasingkonzepte. Seit 2025 sind die Asset-Management-Beteiligungen der Commerzbank Gruppe bei der Commerz Real AG gebündelt. Neben den Marken und Produkten der Commerz Real zählen dazu die Aquila Capital Investmentgesellschaft mit Fokus auf nachhaltige Sachwertinvestments im Bereich Energieinfrastruktur sowie Yellowfin Asset Management als Boutique für liquide Investmentstrategien. Unter dem Dach der Commerz Real AG verwalten insgesamt rund 1.000 Mitarbeitende an rund 20 Standorten Vermögenswerte von rund 55 Milliarden Euro.

Die Commerz Real Fundmanagement S.à r.l. (“CRFM“) ist ein Spezialist für die Verwaltung von Alternativen Investmentfonds. Die CRFM trägt hierdurch zum Profil der Commerz Real AG und ihren Konzerngesellschaften (“Commerz Real Gruppe“) als integrierter Investmentdienstleister bei. Die CRFM arrangiert Alternative Investmentfonds, insbesondere für Immobilien, Infrastrukturprojekte, Anlagen zur Erzeugung erneuerbarer Energien sowie Großmobilien (wie z.B.: Flugzeuge, Schiffe und Schienenfahrzeuge). Die CRFM ist eine Tochtergesellschaft der Commerz Real AG, die ihrerseits eine Tochter der Commerzbank Aktiengesellschaft, Deutschland, ist.

Aufgabe:

description:
Dein Job in Luxemburg!

SiFa Sicherheitsfachkraft (m/w/d) in Luxembourg

OG Recruitment ist Ihre Beratungsagentur für die Vermittlung von SpezialistInnen und Führungskräften in Luxemburg und der Grenzregion. Bei uns geht es ausschließlich um direkte Personalvermittlungen zu unseren Auftraggebern.

Für unseren renommierten Auftraggeber mit Sitz in Luxemburg-Stadt suchen wir ab sofort eine Sicherheitsfachkraft (m/w/d).

Ihre Mission ist die Umsetzung und Einhaltung sowie die Risikobeurteilung der Arbeitssicherheit auf der Baustelle und im Büro.

Unser Kunde ist ein etabliertes, ausführendes Unternehmen für Technische Gebäudeausrüstung innerhalb einer namhaften luxemburgischen Firmengruppe mit spannenden Projekten und einem offenen und modernen Arbeitsumfeld.

Die Stelle wird im Rahmen der direkten Personalvermittlung mit unbefristetem Arbeitsvertrag direkt beim Auftraggeber besetzt.

Ihre Aufgaben

- Sie sind Ansprechpartner/in für alle sicherheitsrelevanten Fragen und koordinieren den Informationsaustausch zwischen verschiedenen Abteilungen und externen Partnern
- Sie überwachen und kontrollieren die Einhaltung der Sicherheitsvorschriften und -standards im gesamten Unternehmen
- Sie führen die Sicherheitsunterweisungen und Schulungen zur Arbeitssicherheit in den Büros sowie auf den Baustellen durch
- Sie sind verantwortlich für die Analysen und Auswertungen der Risiken für die Arbeitssicherheit der Mitarbeitenden
- Sie entwickeln und implementieren die Sicherheitskonzepte und -maßnahmen und sind für die Risikobewertung und Unfalluntersuchungen zuständig
- Sie führen die Gefahrenanalyse sowie die Bestandsaufnahme durch (Postes à risques, STM)
- Sie sorgen für die Umsetzung der Managementsysteme im Bereich Arbeitsschutz
- Das Sicherheitsregister wird von Ihnen gepflegt und aufrechterhalten
- Sie nehmen regelmäßig an Sicherheitsmeetings teil und verfassen und publizieren monatliche Sicherheitsanweisungen
- Sie beraten die Geschäftsführung im Bereich der Arbeitssicherheit
- Sie sind für den einwandfreien Ablauf der behördlichen Kontrollen zuständig
- Sie organisieren die internen, externen und Baustellenaudits für die Sicherheit sowie ISO 45001
- Etwa 2-3 Mal pro Woche sind Sie vor Ort auf den Baustellen, führen Dokumentationen, erstellen Berichte und erledigen weitere administrative Aufgaben

Ihr Profil

- Sie bringen eine abgeschlossene Ausbildung als Fachkraft für Arbeitssicherheit (Sifa) im Bauwesen mit und verfügen über eine abgeschlossene Berufsausbildung oder Studium mit der Fachrichtung Elektrotechnik oder haben eine Weiterbildung zum Techniker / Meister oder einen gleichwertigen Abschluss
- Sie haben die Qualifikation zum "Sicherheitsbeauftragten Gruppe C3" (Travailleur désigné) für Sicherheit und Gesundheit am Arbeitsplatz erfolgreich abgeschlossen
- Sie können mindestens drei Jahre Berufserfahrung als Sicherheitsbeauftragte(r) vorweisen
- Sie haben fundierte Kenntnisse im Bereich Sicherheit und Gesundheitsschutz am Arbeitsplatz
- Sie haben die Qualifizierung zum Schulungsleiter (von Vorteil)
- Sie haben ein sehr gutes technisches Verständnis
- Sie sind offen und kommunikativ im Austausch mit Mitarbeitern und arbeiten gerne im Team
- Sie sprechen fließend Deutsch und haben gute Kenntnisse in Französisch

Das wird Ihnen geboten

- Ein unbefristeter Arbeitsvertrag direkt beim Auftraggeber
- Eine attraktive Vergütung
- Gutes Betriebsklima und moderne Arbeitsumgebung
- Zukunftssichere Perspektive mit aussichtsreichen Karrieremöglichkeiten
- Flexible Arbeitszeiten
- Weiterbildungsmöglichkeiten

So geht es weiter

- Bewerben Sie sich gern online und klicken Sie auf Jetzt-auf-diese Stelle-bewerben
- Bei Fragen können Sie sich jederzeit telefonisch oder per Mail an uns wenden
- Wir sichten Ihre Unterlagen und vereinbaren einen telefonischen oder persönlichen Kennenlerntermin

Diskretion steht an erster Stelle

- Wir sichern Ihnen höchste Vertraulichkeit Ihrer Bewerbung zu.
- Selbstverständlich arbeiten wir verantwortungsbewusst im Sinne der DSGVO.

Klingt das gut? Dann bewerben Sie sich jetzt. Wir freuen uns auf Sie!

description:

About the FSTM
The University of Luxembourg is an international research university with a distinctly multilingual and interdisciplinary character.
The Faculty of Science, Technology and Medicine (FSTM) at the University of Luxembourg contributes multidisciplinary expertise in the fields of Mathematics, Physics, Engineering, Computer Science, Life Sciences and Medicine.
Through its dual mission of teaching and research, the FSTM seeks to generate and disseminate knowledge and train new generations of responsible citizens in order to better understand, explain and advance society and the environment we live in.
The Department of Engineering (DoE) is a dynamic, interdisciplinary group engaged in civil, electrical, mechanical engineering and operations research/management, driving forward innovative research and solutions. It also has an internationally leading profile in computational science and engineering. We develop cutting-edge technologies, promoting the sustainable and economical use of resources, and meeting the technological demands of Luxembourg, the Greater Region, and beyond. Nearly all research projects are supported by a network of national and international partnerships, several with public or industrial stakeholders. At the University, the Department cooperates across faculties and with the interdisciplinary centres. In particular, the new interdisciplinary centre focused on complex environmental systems opens up significant opportunities for future collaborations.
The Department of Engineering seeks to hire a Research Support Engineer, with an interdisciplinary background in Electrical/Mechanical Engineering, to integrate the Technical Support Unit (TSU). The candidate will work closely with the Technical Support Unit (TSU) Team Leader across all DoE research areas.

Your role
As a Research Support Engineer within the Department of Engineering TSU, you'll have an exciting and diverse job, typically at the intersection of technical support and project management. You'll be involved in research activities but as well support the Department outreach and education missions.
Support management tasks:
• Project management: Plan and coordinate research support activities, allocate resources, set timelines, continuously evaluate and optimise resource utilisation to improve efficiency and ensure project deliverables are met, in close collaboration with the Principal Investigator
• Acquisition/procurement: Organise together with the PI the purchase of materials, equipment and software. Keep the maintenance and update of licenses schedules
• Laboratory Management: Ensure all laboratory equipment is properly maintained, calibrated, and functioning optimally. Implement and enforce safety protocols to maintain a safe working environment, in collaboration with the FSTM Safety Officers. Oversee that researchers create and maintain accurate lab books
• Communication: Support the Team Leader in the liaison between PIs and relevant central administration services, e.g. procurement, infrastructures, safety and security, in collaboration with the Head of Department and the Deanship

Technical Support and Development:
• Work closely with researchers to understand their technical needs, provide advice on technical solutions and facilitate the translation of research questions into technical implementations
• Setup of experimental platforms involving sensors, instrumentation, and physical measurements, support to prototyping, including the involvement in the design, wiring, commissioning, and troubleshooting of systems
• Coordination and supervision of experimental work together with the PIs
• Liaising with companies and experts to guarantee the efficient, timely, and quality supply of services, software, equipment and laboratory consumables
• Good practices in documenting prototypes, procedures, and experimental results
• Ability to read and write technical documents: schematics, protocols, reports

Your profile
• Master's degree in mechanical, electrical engineering, or similar
• Leadership skills, experience as a team coordinator
• At least 7 years of experience in academia, in charge of supervision of experimental tasks: in the fields of mechanical and civil engineering - structures, knowledge in thermodynamics would be considered an asset
• Interest in academic environments and collaborative research is highly valued
• Adaptability and eagerness to learn
• Problem-solving attitude
• Excellent command of English (C1) is required for international communication and documentation. Excellent command of French or German (C1) is mandatory

We offer
• A modern, dynamic university with a personal and inclusive atmosphere. Multilingual and international character. Staff coming from more than 90 countries. Member of The Guild of European Research Intensive Universities
• An exceptional research environment, supported by skilled staff and high-quality equipment. Strong links to professional sectors and the Luxembourg labour market. A unique urban campus with excellent infrastructure
• A partner for society and industry. Cooperation with European institutions, innovative companies, the Financial Centre and a wide range of non-academic partners including ministries, local governments, associations, and NGOs

How to apply
Applications should include:
• Curriculum Vitae, including any publications or technical projects, if applicable
• Cover letter
Early application is highly encouraged, as the applications will be processed upon reception. Please apply ONLINE formally through the HR system. Applications by Email will not be considered.
All qualified individuals are encouraged to apply. In line with our values, the University of Luxembourg promotes an inclusive culture. We encourage applications from individuals of all backgrounds and are dedicated to upholding equality and respect for our employees and students.
General information:
• Contract Type: Permanent
• Work Hours: Full Time 40.0 Hours per Week
• Location: Kirchberg Campus
• Internal Title: Research support engineer
• Job Reference: UOL08417.

title: Duty Manager Passenger Assistance (m/f/x)
description:
Duty Manager Passenger Assistance (m/f/x)

Missions :

Assurer la préparation des opérations et la planification journalière des ressources nécessaires à l'activité
Contrôler le respect du planning et enregistrer les changements de personnel selon les procédures en vigueur. Selon les besoins de l'opération et les requêtes individuelles procéder aux ajustements du planning à court terme
Transmettre l'information et les directives nécessaires aux équipes du Ground Handling pour le bon déroulement des opérations et suivre les statuts des vols afin d'anticiper toute éventualité
Etre l'interlocuteur privilégié avec les autres services ainsi qu'avec les représentants des compagnies tierces
Signaler toute irrégularité et établir le srapport quotidien de fin de tournée
Proposer des actions correctives afin d'améliorer la qualité du service
Etre en étroite collaboration avec le Manager Passenger Assistance afin de participer au développement et suivi des ressources. Coordonner les besoins spécifiques/individuels avec le département Formation
Gérer les irrégularités du réseau Luxair et LuxairTours au départ et à l'arrivée de toutes les stations desservies en collaboration avec l'OCC et coordonner les plans d'actions avec les équipes et prestataires concernés
Rapporter toute anomalie à la Direction du Ground Handling

Profil requis:

Critères minimaux requis pour le poste

Etre détenteur d'un diplôme de fin d'études secondaires au Luxembourg ou équivalent
Maîtriser l'anglais, le français et/ou l'allemand (parlé & écrit)
Etre orienté clients, avoir une présentation soignée et respecter les procédures du port d'uniforme
Avoir une expérience confirmée de l'Assistance Passager ainsi que de l'encadrement d'équipes opérationnelles
Maintenir la stricte confidentialité des données
Etre précis, avoir le sens de l'organisation et des priorités et une grande résistance au stress
Savoir travailler de manière autonome et en équipe
Travail sur tournées
Le luxembourgeois et toute autre langue sera considérée comme un atout majeur à ce poste

------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Profile

Ensure the preparation of operations and the daily planning of the resources required for the activity.
Monitor compliance with the schedule and record staff changes in accordance with the applicable procedures. Based on operational requirements and individual requests, make short-term adjustments to the schedule as necessary.
Communicate the information and instructions required by the Ground Handling teams to ensure the smooth running of operations, and monitor flight statuses in order to anticipate any potential issues.
Act as the main point of contact with other departments as well as with representatives of third-party airlines.
Report any irregularities and prepare the daily end-of-shift report.
Propose corrective actions to improve service quality.
Work closely with the Passenger Assistance Manager to contribute to the development and monitoring of resources.
Coordinate specific and individual needs with the Training Department.
Manage irregularities affecting the Luxair and LuxairTours network, both on departure and arrival at all stations served, in cooperation with the OCC, and coordinate action plans with the relevant teams and service providers.
Report any anomalies to Ground Handling Management.

Minimum Requirements

Hold a Luxembourg secondary school leaving diploma or an equivalent qualification.
Have a good command of English, French and/or German, both spoken and written.
Be customer-oriented, maintain a professional appearance and comply with uniform-wearing procedures.
Have proven experience in Passenger Assistance as well as in supervising operational teams.Maintain strict confidentiality of information and data.
Be accurate, well-organised, able to prioritise effectively and highly stress-resistant.
Be able to work both independently and as part of a team.
Be willing to work shifts.
Luxembourgish and any other additional language will be considered a major asset for this position.

title: IT Application Expert (m/f/x)
description:
Description de tâches:


For our department Application Management within General Services, we are looking for a (an):

IT Application Expert (m/f/x)

The IT Application Expert plays a crucial role in maintaining and enhancing the effectiveness of our application landscape. This individual serves as a key escalation point for the Service Desk and internal customers, addressing complex application-related support issues. The role involves continuous collaboration with IT stakeholders and vendors to manage application lifecycles, improve support processes, and contribute to IT service management (ITSM) knowledge.


Key responsibilities:

Serve as an advanced support contact for the Service Desk and internal customers, addressing application-related inquiries and issues.
Enhance the ITSM knowledge base with detailed application support processes and user-centric articles.
Oversee the lifecycle management of a designated application portfolio, including road-mapping, licensing, integration, user training, support, and upgrades.
Coordinate and participate in application upgrades, releases, and maintenance activities with internal IT teams and external vendors, including planned interventions outside normal working hours, typically after the last scheduled flight, to minimize operational disruption and ensure service continuity.
Proactively inform and advise business stakeholders on new application functionalities, utilizing established communication channels.
Collaborate with various IT teams and external vendors to define and establish necessary environments for testing and deploying new releases.
Engage in continuous improvement initiatives, developing and maintaining relevant guidelines and best practices.
Support on the creation of Business Impact assessments for the applications.
Participate in IT related projects, contributing expertise and insights.
Provide occasional administrative support within the activity scope, ensuring operational efficiency.
Uphold responsibility for ITIL process adherence and implementation within the domain.


Required profile:


Qualifications:

Possession of a Bachelor's degree in Information Technology or an equivalent blend of education and experience in a similar role.
Demonstrated ability to prioritize tasks effectively.
Methodical approach to analysis and documentation with a keen attention to detail.
Proven reliability and precision in work output.
Exemplary customer service orientation and ability to act as a role model in this capacity.
Proficiency in standard office software applications.
Excellent communication skills in English, both verbal and written.
Strong training delivery capabilities, tailored to diverse audiences.
Effective presentation skills.


Technical knowledge:

Ability to troubleshoot complex application issues using application logs, monitoring dashboards, event management tools, alerts, and performance metrics.
Working knowledge of relational databases and SQL to execute queries for data validation, incident investigation, troubleshooting, and reporting.
Understanding of application integrations, APIs (REST/SOAP), middleware, messaging, and data flows between enterprise systems.
Knowledge of networking and authentication concepts relevant to application support, including TCP/IP, DNS, HTTPS, firewalls, Active Directory, LDAP, SSO, OAuth, and SAML.
Ability to analyze technical documentation, architecture diagrams, and system dependencies to support root cause analysis and issue resolution.
Software development skills are not required; however, the ability to understand technical concepts, communicate with technical teams and vendors, and participate in technical troubleshooting is essential.


Desired skills:

Ability to work collaboratively and independently within a team-oriented environment.
Eagerness to learn and apply new technologies.
Advanced communication skills, capable of engaging with all organizational levels and external parties.
Familiarity with departmental tools and applications.
Agility and flexibility in responding to new challenges and priorities.
Basic understanding of ITIL Framework principles.
Commitment to delivering results within agreed timeframes and maintaining data confidentiality.
Additional language skills are considered a valuable asset.


The IT Application Support Specialist in Luxair is a pivotal role aimed at enhancing our IT application services throughout our business lines. We are looking for a dedicated professional who demonstrates a passion for technology, a commitment to service excellence, and a deep understanding of application support dynamics. If you are seeking a challenging and rewarding career opportunity, we invite you to apply for this position.

Job Description & Summary

Meet your future team

Join our Talent Attraction and Acquisition team, supporting recruitment across PwC Luxembourg.
Working closely with Talent Acquisition Advisors and Talent Acquisition Partners, you will join a collaborative team where strong coordination makes a real difference. By bringing structure, responsiveness and consistency to our activities, you will help create a smooth recruitment experience for candidates while supporting the team in working effectively with hiring teams and meeting its operational and administrative requirements.

What your role will look like

As a Talent Attraction & Acquisition Coordinator, you will combine hands-on recruitment scheduling with essential administrative responsibilities. You will manage multiple activities and priorities in parallel, ensuring that each step is handled accurately, on time and with the right level of attention.
The role requires someone who can stay one step ahead, take ownership and bring clarity, while maintaining a high standard of service and attention to detail.

You will:

• Coordinate interviews across the firm, from scheduling and invitations to sharing practical information with candidates.
• Manage Talent Acquisition team calendars and coordinate multiple schedules to ensure a smooth and efficient interview process.
• Serve as a reliable point of contact for candidates, providing clear, timely and professional communication throughout interview coordination.
• Manage the validation and follow-up of Talent Attraction and recruitment invoices and expenses.
• Manage ADEM administration, including vacancy declarations, required updates and documentation, ensuring accurate records and compliance with Luxembourg requirements.
• Track and report on key scheduling metrics, including time-to-schedule, rescheduling, no-shows, interviewer availability and bottlenecks.
• Prepare weekly and monthly activity reports and maintain accurate data for key Talent Attraction and Acquisition metrics.
• Support Talent Attraction and Acquisition projects and initiatives, ensuring effective coordination and follow-up.
• Maintain accurate and up-to-date process documentation to support consistency, knowledge sharing and business continuity.

Your growth and opportunities

This role offers the opportunity to build a strong foundation in Talent Attraction and Acquisition while gaining exposure to recruitment activities across PwC Luxembourg.
You will develop your expertise in recruitment coordination, administration, stakeholder management and reporting, while building a broader understanding of how an in-house Talent Acquisition function operates.
As you grow into the role, you will have the opportunity to take greater ownership, contribute ideas and improvements, and become a trusted point of reference for the team. The experience you build will provide a strong platform to continue developing within Talent Acquisition and the broader HR environment.

The skills you bring

You are organised, dependable and comfortable managing multiple priorities. You communicate with confidence and professionalism, take ownership of your responsibilities and pay close attention to the details that contribute to a well-coordinated recruitment process.

• 3 to 4 years of experience in an administrative or coordination role.
• A genuine interest in Human Resources and recruitment.
• Strong organisational and prioritisation skills, with the ability to manage multiple activities while maintaining accuracy and meeting deadlines.
• Clear, warm and professional written and spoken communication in a multicultural environment, with fluency in English and French.
• Strong stakeholder management skills, with the confidence to follow up, align expectations and challenge constructively when needed.
• A proactive and solution-oriented mindset, with a strong sense of ownership and reliability.
• Discretion and integrity when handling confidential candidate and employee information.

Ways of working

• You contribute actively to the team, build trusted relationships and understand how your work supports shared outcomes.
• You communicate with care and professionalism, adapt to different stakeholders and remain solution-focused when priorities evolve.
• You follow through on commitments, work collaboratively and handle sensitive information with discretion and integrity.

Additional skills that would support your success

• Portuguese language skills would be considered an asset.
• Previous exposure to recruitment, HR coordination or a similar environment would be an advantage.
• Confidence working with HR or recruitment systems and digital tools.
• Good command of Microsoft Excel and an interest in data and reporting.

The skills listed reflect what matters most to succeed in this role. If your experience aligns with them, even if your path looks different, we encourage you to apply and start the conversation with us.

Take your next step

Bring your organisation, communication skills and sense of service to a role where your contribution is visible and valued. You will have the opportunity to build strong recruitment expertise, take increasing ownership and become a trusted part of the Talent Attraction and Acquisition team.

If you are looking for a role where great coordination, strong relationships and attention to detail are genuinely valued, we would be happy to hear from you.

Optional Skills

Accepting Feedback, Active Listening, AI Fluency, AI-Human Collaboration, Applicant Tracking System, Behavioral Interviewing, Campus Placement, Candidate Management, Candidate Selection, Candidate Sourcing, Communication, Contract Negotiation, Digital Tooling, Direct Recruiting, Emotional Regulation, Empathy, Employee Referral Programs, End-to-End Recruitment, Escalation Management, Faculty Relations, Hiring Management, Hiring Manager Liaison, Inclusion, Intake Interviews {+ 28 more}

time type Full time

Operating as an internationally integrated partnership in over 100 countries and territories, Forvis Mazars Group specialises in audit, tax and advisory services. The partnership draws on the expertise and cultural understanding of over 40,000 professionals across the globe to assist clients of all sizes at every stage in their development.

Joining our team as a Senior Tax Advisor means taking on a pivotal role within a dynamic and fast-paced advisory environment, where technical excellence and high-quality client service are at the core of everything we do.
You will operate in a stimulating and demanding consulting environment where excellence, ownership and continuous development are expected.

You will lead complex assignments aligned with our clients' strategic priorities, bringing technical expertise and a pragmatic approach to problem-solving. As a key point of contact for both clients and junior team members, you will contribute to high-quality deliverables while ensuring deadlines and expectations are consistently met.

You will play an active role in client interactions, developing strong relationships, understanding their challenges and providing tailored, value-added advice. Beyond client work, you will play an important role in the development of our team. You will coach and mentor junior team members, review their work and contribute to fostering a collaborative and high-performing culture. Your experience and leadership will help shape both individual careers and the continued growth of our practice.

In return, we offer a stimulating and intellectually challenging environment that encourages initiative and provides genuine opportunities for career progression. Through ongoing training, exposure to complex international projects and increasing leadership responsibilities, you will be empowered to continuously develop your expertise and advance your professional ambitions.

Responsibilities:

As part of our International Tax team, you will take on a central role in delivering high-quality advisory services within a dynamic and client-driven environment.

Your role will include:

• Advising clients on complex International and Luxembourg tax matters, ensuring technical accuracy and relevance in a constantly evolving regulatory landscape;
• Leading and reviewing in-depth tax analysis, and translating technical findings into clear, strategic and actionable recommendations;
• Managing client engagements, including planning, execution and timely delivery of high-quality outputs;
• Acting as a potential point of contact for clients, starting building trusted relationships with the aim of ensuring  full client satisfaction;

title: Job på Malta - Administrativ kundeservice - Book en samtale i dag!
description:
Drømmer du om at kombinere et socialt arbejdsliv med sol, hav og et ungt dansk team? Har du lyst til at arbejde i et miljø, hvor tempo, samarbejde og personlighed betyder lige så meget som erfaring? Så har du muligheden for at blive en del af et lille, tæt dansk team i Sliema, hvor du arbejder med kundesupport for flere etablerede brands.

Du bliver en vigtig del af et team på otte danske kolleger, hvor man lægger stor vægt på personlighed, trivsel og fællesskab. Her handler det ikke kun om at yde god kundeservice — men også om at fungere godt socialt, bidrage til stemningen og være en del af et miljø, hvor man både arbejder og laver ting sammen uden for kontoret.

Vi leder efter en udadvendt og engageret person, der motiveres af at skabe gode kundeoplevelser og som trives i et miljø, hvor man hurtigt bliver en del af fællesskabet.

Hvad laver en administrativ kundeservicemedarbejder?

Du besvarer kundehenvendelser via e-mail og chat og sikrer, at hver kunde får en professionel og hjælpsom oplevelse. Du hjælper med teknisk support, guider kunder gennem platformen og sørger for, at eventuelle problemer bliver løst hurtigt og korrekt. Du overvåger også hjemmesidens funktionalitet og rapporterer fejl eller driftsproblemer til teamlederen. Derudover hjælper du med at promovere nye produkter og kampagner og støtter teamet i ad hoc-opgaver, når der er behov.

Du bliver en del af et mindre, socialt team, hvor personlighed og samarbejde vægtes højt — og hvor fredagsbar, fælles frokost og sociale aktiviteter er en naturlig del af kulturen.

Bidrager til teamet og udviklingen

Du er med til at skabe en god stemning i teamet og bidrager til, at hverdagen fungerer. Du deler viden, støtter nye kolleger og hjælper med at sikre, at teamet arbejder effektivt og med høj kvalitet. Da teamet er lille, har du mulighed for hurtigt at få mere ansvar og udvikle dig i rollen. Du bliver en vigtig del af et fællesskab, hvor man hjælper hinanden, og hvor personlighed og teamfit er afgørende.

Dit ansvar:

  • Kundesupport via e-mail og chat

  • Teknisk vejledning og fejlfinding

  • Overvågning af platformens funktionalitet

  • Rapportering af driftsproblemer

  • Hjælp til kampagner og produktinformation

  • Vidensdeling og støtte til nye kolleger

  • Opdatering af interne systemer og kundehistorik

  • Ad hoc-opgaver efter behov

Dine kvalifikationer:

  • Taler og skriver dansk og godt engelsk

  • Udadvendt, social og trives i et ungt team

  • Har øje for detaljer og arbejder struktureret

  • Motiveret for at lære — erfaring er ikke et krav

  • Bonus: Erfaring med kundeservice eller kendskab til casino-/iGaming-branchen

  • Evne til at håndtere flere opgaver og bevare overblikket

Da teamet kun består af otte danske kolleger, lægger man stor vægt på personlighed og på, hvordan du fungerer i fællesskabet. Du skal trives i et miljø, hvor man både arbejder sammen og laver ting sammen uden for arbejdstiden.

Løn og benefits:

  • Årsløn: 27.000 EUR

  • Relocationpakke

  • Løn stiger efter oplæring/kvalifikation

  • Ca. 15 % skat

  • 40 timer om ugen

  • Rotation mellem 08.00 – 21.00

  • 22 feriedage om året

  • Sundhedsforsikring

  • Socialt arbejdsmiljø med fredagsbar, frokost og teambuilding

  • Danske ledere og et stabilt team

  • Gode lokale deals på fitness, sprogkurser m.m.

Karrieremæssige fordele:

  • Internationale muligheder – Malta er et globalt knudepunkt for tech- og iGaming-industrien, hvilket giver adgang til et bredt netværk af virksomheder og karrieremuligheder.

  • Erhvervserfaring i et voksende marked, en vigtig del af den digitale verden, og erfaring inden for dette felt kan åbne døre til fremtidige roller i tech, compliance og kundeservice.

  • Udvikling af værdifulde færdigheder – Du vil opbygge kompetencer inden for kommunikation, problemløsning og digital sikkerhed, som er eftertragtede på arbejdsmarkedet.

  • Mulighed for karrierevækst – Mange virksomheder i Malta tilbyder interne udviklingsprogrammer og karriereforløb, så du kan avancere i din rolle.

Livet på Malta:

  • Middelhavslivsstil – Malta byder på en afslappet livsstil med smukke strande, historiske byer og en livlig expat-community.

  • Engelsk som arbejdssprog – Engelsk er et af de officielle sprog i Malta, hvilket gør det nemt at integrere sig både socialt og professionelt.

  • Lav kriminalitet og god sikkerhed – Malta har en af de laveste kriminalitetsrater i Europa, hvilket gør det til et trygt sted at bo.

  • Leveomkostninger – Leveomkostningerne er generelt lavere end i mange andre europæiske lande, især når det kommer til bolig og dagligvarer.

Skat på Malta:

  • Attraktive skatteforhold – Malta har en gunstig skattepolitik for expats, hvor indkomstskat kan være så lav som 15 % for visse erhvervsgrupper.

  • Ingen ejendomsskat – Der er ingen årlig ejendomsskat, hvilket kan være en fordel for dem, der ønsker at investere i bolig.

  • Lav selskabsskat – Hvis du senere ønsker at starte din egen virksomhed, har Malta en af de mest konkurrencedygtige skatteordninger i EU.

Klimaet på Malta:

  • Solrigt året rundt – Malta har over 300 solskinsdage om året, hvilket gør det til et af de mest solrige steder i Europa.

  • Milde vintre – Selv i januar falder temperaturen sjældent under 10°C, hvilket betyder, at du kan nyde udendørslivet året rundt.

  • Varme somre – Sommeren kan blive varm med temperaturer op til 35°C, men den friske havbrise gør det behageligt.

At arbejde på Malta giver dig ikke kun en spændende karrierevej, men også en fantastisk livsstil i et solrigt og dynamisk miljø. Lyder det som noget for dig?

  • Lav kriminalitet og god sikkerhed – Malta har en af de laveste kriminalitetsrater i Europa, hvilket gør det til et trygt sted at bo.

  • Leveomkostninger – Leveomkostningerne er generelt lavere end i mange andre europæiske lande, især når det kommer til bolig og dagligvarer.

Skat på Malta

  • Attraktive skatteforhold – Malta har en gunstig skattepolitik for expats, hvor indkomstskat kan være så lav som 15 % for visse erhvervsgrupper.

  • Ingen ejendomsskat – Der er ingen årlig ejendomsskat, hvilket kan være en fordel for dem, der ønsker at investere i bolig.

  • Lav selskabsskat – Hvis du senere ønsker at starte din egen virksomhed, har Malta en af de mest konkurrencedygtige skatteordninger i EU.

Klimaet på Malta

  • Solrigt året rundt – Malta har over 300 solskinsdage om året, hvilket gør det til et af de mest solrige steder i Europa.

  • Milde vintre – Selv i januar falder temperaturen sjældent under 10°C, hvilket betyder, at du kan nyde udendørslivet året rundt.

  • Varme somre – Sommeren kan blive varm med temperaturer op til 35°C, men den friske havbrise gør det behageligt.

At arbejde i Malta giver dig ikke kun en spændende karrierevej, men også en fantastisk livsstil i et solrigt og dynamisk miljø. Lyder det som noget for dig?

Your job
Are you motivated to advance operational forest disturbance monitoring using radar satellite data and to contribute to global efforts to understand and combat forest loss?
We are seeking a highly motivated postdoctoral researcher to advance near-real-time forest disturbance and regrowth monitoring using radar satellite observations. The position combines methodological research with the further development and operation of the RADD (Radar for Detecting Deforestation) forest disturbance alerts , using established and newly available radar satellite missions, including Sentinel-1 and NISAR.
Radar remote sensing is particularly valuable for forest monitoring because of its sensitivity to vegetation structure and its ability to provide systematic observations largely independent of daylight and cloud cover. Translating these observations into accurate, consistent, and operational information on forest disturbance and post-disturbance regrowth, however, remains challenging. Radar responses are influenced by wavelength, acquisition geometry, forest structure, seasonality, and environmental conditions.
The project will address these challenges in two main directions. First, you will extend the RADD framework from disturbance detection towards continuous forest change monitoring, including the detection and characterization of post-disturbance forest regrowth and structural recovery. Second, you will expand the geographic applicability of the RADD alerts beyond their current implementations in the humid tropics and Europe.
