title: Teamlead Reliability Engineers (m/w/d) (Ingenieur/in - Elektrotechnik)
description:
Operations and technicians

Teamlead Reliability Engineers

Imagine a future where you lead an international engineering team that improves the safety, reliability, and performance of our wind farms.Join us in this role where you’ll provide people and technical leadership to the Continental Europe Reliability Engineering team. You’ll set priorities, develop capabilities, and enable consistent, high-quality reliability support across our wind farms. Through data-driven decisions and close collaboration, you’ll help address technical risks, improve asset performance, and strengthen the way we work across sites and turbine platforms. Welcome to Generation CE You’ll be part of WTG Engineering where you, together with your colleagues, will support our operational sites by identifying and addressing technical risks, yield-loss drivers, recurring failures, and improvement opportunities. You’ll connect Reliability Engineers, site teams, CE Engineering, Technical Support, and other specialist functions to coordinate effective corrective and preventive actions. As a team, we share knowledge, support one another, and turn technical insight into practical improvements. We succeed as one by building trust across sites, giving our experts the context and space to make decisions, and keeping safety at the heart of our work. You’ll play an important role in: leading, motivating, and developing an international team of Reliability Engineers through clear objectives, coaching, competence planning, and development conversations translating Generation, CE Engineering, and site priorities into an aligned reliability engineering plan with clear ownership, milestones, and outcomes ensuring structured analysis of reliability performance, yield-loss drivers, recurring failures, technical risks, and emerging trends overseeing root-cause analyses, technical assessments, corrective and preventive actions, and prioritised reliability improvement initiatives strengthening consistent reliability practices, knowledge sharing, and collaboration across operational sites, engineering functions, suppliers, and technical support teams promoting a proactive safety culture and ensuring compliance with asset integrity, HSE, governance, and applicable technical requirements. To succeed in the role, you: have a relevant technical or engineering qualification within mechanical engineering, electrical engineering, reliability, asset management, wind energy, or a comparable field, or equivalent experience bring leadership experience that enables you to develop people, set priorities, allocate resources, and create clarity across an international or multi-site team understand wind turbine operations, reliability engineering, technical support, maintenance engineering, asset integrity, or another high-reliability industry have strong knowledge of reliability and continuous-improvement methods, such as root-cause analysis, trend analysis, failure-mode analysis, reliability-centred maintenance, risk assessment, and corrective-action management can interpret technical and operational performance data and turn your findings into clear priorities, decisions, and measurable improvement actions communicate complex technical matters clearly, build trusted stakeholder relationships, and work professionally in English. Maybe you’ve read the above and can see you have some transferable skills, even though they don’t quite match all the points. If you think you can bring something to the team, we still encourage you to apply. Shape the future with us Send your application to us as soon as possible. We’ll be conducting interviews on a continuous basis and reserve the right to take down the advert when we’ve found the right candidate. As an applicant or employee, you may request reasonable work and position accommodation or adjustments via accommodation@orsted.com (accommodation@orsted.com) . Please note that for your application to be taken into consideration, you must submit your application via our online career pages and answer the screening questions relevant for your country. We don't take applications or inquiries from external recruiters or agencies into account for this position. Position salary range: For this role, the base pay will be determined according to the relevant pay structure for the location where the position is filled. Actual pay will be based on skills, experience, and the expected role fulfilment to ensure a fair and competitive offer. Where applicable, you may also be eligible for variable payment and a comprehensive benefits package. Pay details specific to your location will be provided during the interview process.Pre-employment background checks:For certain positions, a background check may be required as part of the hiring process. Because we recruit across multiple countries, the specific checks performed will depend on the role and the legal requirements in the location where the position is filled. If a background check is relevant for the role you are being considered for, you will be informed during the recruitment process. All background checks are carried out by an external provider and always in accordance with applicable local laws and regulations.

description:
Front Office Supervisor

Opis firmy

Tworzymy wyjątkowe miejsce dla naszych Gości dzięki wspólnej pasji do nowoczesnego designu i wysokiej jakości obsługi.

Już ponad 100 hoteli w 13 krajach imponują wyjątkowym designem, najwyższymi standardami obsługi i doskonałymi lokalizacjami w samym sercu miast.

Dołącz do naszego zespołu w Gdańsku!

Odkryj możliwości pracy w miejscu, gdzie liczy się pasja, zaangażowanie i chęć rozwoju!

Twoim priorytetem będzie troska o dobre samopoczucie Gości i Pracowników!

Twoje obowiązki będą obejmować również:

- Meldowanie Gości, sprawdzanie listy przyjazdów oraz innych raportów
- Zapewnienie profesjonalnej, najwyższej jakości obsługi
- Monitorowanie oraz reagowanie na opinie Gości

Benefits:

- Bonus program: The better the guests rate their stay, the higher the bonus!
- Make an international career: Discover a variety of career opportunities in our hotels nationally and internationally, or join one of our numerous new openings.
- Staff discounts: Benefit from attractive staff rates in all of our hotels throughout Europe and the USA.
- Develop personally and professionally: With an extensive onboarding, annual trainings and coaching at our One University, you will hit the ground running.
- Celebrate together: Whether it's a summer party, holiday party or our annual international soccer tournament - we celebrate successes together with the team.

Kwalifikacje

Czy posiadasz wyjątkową osobowość oraz doskonałe umiejętności z zakresu gościnności?

Jeśli tak, to idealnie będziesz pasować na to stanowisko! Nasze dodatkowe wymagania:

- Doświadczenie zawodowe w branży hotelarskiej
- Doskonałe wyczucie jakości i obsługi
- Otwartość, komunikatywność oraz bardzo dobra znajomość języka angielskiego (w mowie i piśmie)
- Umiejętność pracy w zespole i gotowość do udzielania pomocy we wszystkich działach – wyniki osiąga się dzięki współpracy!
- Praca w godzinach porannych, popołudniowych i/lub nocnych

title: Division Controller & Commercial Manager High Speed (m/f/d) (80-100%)
description:
Accelleron is accelerating sustainability in the marine and energy industries as a global technology leader in turbocharging, fuel injection, and digital solutions for heavy-duty applications. Building on a heritage of over 100 years as a trusted industry partner, the company serves customers in more than 100 locations in over 50 countries. Accelleron’s 3,000 employees are continuously innovating to deliver best-in-class products, services, and solutions that are mission-critical for the energy transition. You will join a team of experts in an exciting international environment, committed to excellence and innovation. Together, we support our customers in driving the transition toward sustainable industries with cutting-edge technology, deep expertise, and smart solutions. At Accelleron, we foster diversity and inclusion, welcoming and celebrating individual differences as a source of strength.

In this role, you will serve as a strategic Finance Business Partner for the High Speed Division, supporting the Division President and Leadership Team in driving profitable growth, operational excellence, and strategic decision-making across a global business. Working closely with stakeholders across Sales, Operations, and Technical Development in Europe, the US, and China, you will ensure financial transparency, performance management, and value creation while translating business insights into impactful actions. Reporting directly to the Chief Financial Officer (CFO), you will lead planning, forecasting, reporting, and business performance processes, while actively contributing to the division's strategic development and future growth.

Your responsibilities:


Support the definition and execution of the High Speed strategy, ensuring alignment between strategic priorities and financial targets.
Own the strategic five-year planning, budgeting and forecasting processes for the High Speed Division globally.
Own monthly, quarterly and annual financial closing and reporting, ensuring compliance with internal and external requirements.
Lead the monthly financial performance review with the Division President, providing transparency on key P&L and operational performance drivers.
Ensure transparency on customer, product and lifecycle profitability and provide actionable insights to improve financial performance.
Drive cost and working capital performance across the Division and initiate corrective actions where required.
Act as financial business partner for strategic initiatives, investments and major development projects, including active participation in business cases, design reviews and steering committees.
Partner with Sales on commercial and financial risk management, including risk reviews, insurance claims and escalation mechanisms.
Ensure effective financial governance and internal controls, including implementation and adherence to the Table of Authority.
Drive continuous innovation and improvement, simplification and standardization of financial processes and reporting.
Actively contribute to the strategic development of the High Speed division as member of the Division’s Leadership Team
Contribute to cross-divisional and Group Finance initiatives, supporting the development of the global Finance function.

Your background:


Strong financial background with expertise in controlling, planning and internal controls
Results-oriented finance leader with strong analytical and problem-solving skills
Strong business partnering and communication skills, with the ability to challenge and influence and implement solutions across the organization
Strong cross-cultural collaboration skills in a global organization
Ability to translate financial and operational insights into actions
10+ years of relevant experience, complemented by strong digital & financial tool capabilities
Digital mindset with proof record on digital innovations

Your benefits:


Attractive compensation & benefits
Employee Assistance Program Global
Parental Leave Program



We look forward to receiving your application. If you want to discover more about Accelleron, take another look at our website accelleron.com.

Lódz, Poland | Hybrid (3-4 days onsite)

DP World, one of the world's leading logistics providers, is looking for a Senior Network Security Engineer (m/f/d) to join our European Network team in Lódz.

In this role, you will take ownership of our network security landscape across Europe, ensuring the stability, security, and continuous improvement of critical network infrastructure. Please note that regular travel within Europe and occasional out-of-hours work are required.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

* Own and continuously improve the network security environment across Europe.

* Fluent English (at least C1), strong troubleshooting skills, and willingness to travel across Europe.

title: Teamlead Reliability Engineers (m/w/d) (Ingenieur/in - Elektrotechnik)
description:
Operations and technicians

Teamlead Reliability Engineers

Imagine a future where you lead an international engineering team that improves the safety, reliability, and performance of our wind farms.Join us in this role where you’ll provide people and technical leadership to the Continental Europe Reliability Engineering team. You’ll set priorities, develop capabilities, and enable consistent, high-quality reliability support across our wind farms. Through data-driven decisions and close collaboration, you’ll help address technical risks, improve asset performance, and strengthen the way we work across sites and turbine platforms. Welcome to Generation CE You’ll be part of WTG Engineering where you, together with your colleagues, will support our operational sites by identifying and addressing technical risks, yield-loss drivers, recurring failures, and improvement opportunities. You’ll connect Reliability Engineers, site teams, CE Engineering, Technical Support, and other specialist functions to coordinate effective corrective and preventive actions. As a team, we share knowledge, support one another, and turn technical insight into practical improvements. We succeed as one by building trust across sites, giving our experts the context and space to make decisions, and keeping safety at the heart of our work. You’ll play an important role in: leading, motivating, and developing an international team of Reliability Engineers through clear objectives, coaching, competence planning, and development conversations translating Generation, CE Engineering, and site priorities into an aligned reliability engineering plan with clear ownership, milestones, and outcomes ensuring structured analysis of reliability performance, yield-loss drivers, recurring failures, technical risks, and emerging trends overseeing root-cause analyses, technical assessments, corrective and preventive actions, and prioritised reliability improvement initiatives strengthening consistent reliability practices, knowledge sharing, and collaboration across operational sites, engineering functions, suppliers, and technical support teams promoting a proactive safety culture and ensuring compliance with asset integrity, HSE, governance, and applicable technical requirements. To succeed in the role, you: have a relevant technical or engineering qualification within mechanical engineering, electrical engineering, reliability, asset management, wind energy, or a comparable field, or equivalent experience bring leadership experience that enables you to develop people, set priorities, allocate resources, and create clarity across an international or multi-site team understand wind turbine operations, reliability engineering, technical support, maintenance engineering, asset integrity, or another high-reliability industry have strong knowledge of reliability and continuous-improvement methods, such as root-cause analysis, trend analysis, failure-mode analysis, reliability-centred maintenance, risk assessment, and corrective-action management can interpret technical and operational performance data and turn your findings into clear priorities, decisions, and measurable improvement actions communicate complex technical matters clearly, build trusted stakeholder relationships, and work professionally in English. Maybe you’ve read the above and can see you have some transferable skills, even though they don’t quite match all the points. If you think you can bring something to the team, we still encourage you to apply. Shape the future with us Send your application to us as soon as possible. We’ll be conducting interviews on a continuous basis and reserve the right to take down the advert when we’ve found the right candidate. As an applicant or employee, you may request reasonable work and position accommodation or adjustments via accommodation@orsted.com (accommodation@orsted.com) . Please note that for your application to be taken into consideration, you must submit your application via our online career pages and answer the screening questions relevant for your country. We don't take applications or inquiries from external recruiters or agencies into account for this position. Position salary range: For this role, the base pay will be determined according to the relevant pay structure for the location where the position is filled. Actual pay will be based on skills, experience, and the expected role fulfilment to ensure a fair and competitive offer. Where applicable, you may also be eligible for variable payment and a comprehensive benefits package. Pay details specific to your location will be provided during the interview process.Pre-employment background checks:For certain positions, a background check may be required as part of the hiring process. Because we recruit across multiple countries, the specific checks performed will depend on the role and the legal requirements in the location where the position is filled. If a background check is relevant for the role you are being considered for, you will be informed during the recruitment process. All background checks are carried out by an external provider and always in accordance with applicable local laws and regulations.

title: Job i Portugal med firmabolig - Kunderådgiver for Audi - Opstart den 1. november - Book en samtale i dag!
description:
Kundeservicerådgiver for Audi. Vi har opstart den 1. november med mulighed for firmabolig.

Er du klar til at tage springet og blive en del af en global digital organisation, der leverer support i verdensklasse?

Vi søger en kunderådgiver til en spændende rolle med Audi – en af Europas mest ikoniske bilproducenter. Stillingen er 100 % remote fra Portugal, og du bliver en nøglespiller i et internationalt team, der sikrer en ekstraordinær kunderejse for Audi’s brugere.

Hvad laver en Kundeservicerådgiver?

Som kundeservicerådgiver er du kundens direkte kontaktpunkt og hjælper med alt fra bilteknologi til digitale funktioner og serviceydelser. Du skaber en professionel oplevelse med struktur, empati og høj kvalitet i centrum.

Dine opgaver inkluderer bl.a.:

  • Besvarelse af henvendelser via telefon, e-mail og chat

  • Fejlsøgning af tekniske problemer og vejledning i bilsystemer

  • Registrering af kundeinteraktioner i CRM-systemet

  • Opdatering på Audi’s produkter og politikker

  • Aktiv deltagelse i teamets deling af best practices

Dine kvalifikationer:

Vi leder efter dig, hvis du:

  • Taler og skriver dansk + har et minimum B2-niveau i engelsk

  • Har erfaring med kundeservice – gerne fra bilbranchen

  • Har teknisk flair og interesse for digitale løsninger

  • Kan kommunikere tydeligt, løse problemer og skabe tillid

Du behøver ikke opfylde alle krav – vi opfordrer dig stadig til at søge!

Vi tilbyder:

  • Mulighed for firmabolig i Braga

  • Konkurrencedygtig grundløn plus bonusordning

  • Professionelle udviklingsmuligheder

  • Et samarbejdende og støttende arbejdsmiljø

  • Adgang til eksklusive rejsefordele og rabatter

  • Restaurantkort

  • Privat sundhedsforsikring

  • 14 lønudbetalinger om året

Fordele ved at arbejde i en international virksomhed i Portugal

  • Udvidelse af dine faglige kompetencer gennem globalt samarbejde

  • Forbedring af kommunikation og salgsteknikker i et internationalt miljø

  • Mulighed for karriereudvikling inden for kundeservice, salg og rejsebranchen

  • Adgang til et netværk af internationale kolleger og brancheeksperter

  • Erfaring med moderne digitale værktøjer til kundehåndtering

Dette er en unik mulighed for at kombinere en stærk erhvervserfaring med en fleksibel arbejdsmodel.

Fordele ved at arbejde fra Portugal

  • Mildt klima året rundt – Portugal har et behageligt middelhavsklima med varme somre og milde vintre, hvilket gør det til en attraktiv destination for dem, der ønsker at bo og arbejde i et solrigt land

  • Lavere leveomkostninger – Sammenlignet med mange andre europæiske lande er leveomkostningerne i Portugal relativt lave, hvilket giver mulighed for en høj livskvalitet til en rimelig pris.

  • Høj livskvalitet – Portugal er kendt for sin afslappede livsstil, gode mad og venlige lokalbefolkning, hvilket skaber et positivt og behageligt arbejdsmiljø.

  • Internationale karrieremuligheder – Arbejde i Portugal giver mulighed for at udvikle internationale færdigheder og samarbejde med kolleger fra forskellige nationaliteter, hvilket kan være en fordel for din fremtidige karriere.

  • God infrastruktur og moderne faciliteter – Portugal har en stærk digital infrastruktur, moderne kontorfaciliteter og gode transportmuligheder, hvilket sikrer en behagelig arbejdsdag.

  • Adgang til smukke strande og natur – Portugal tilbyder nem adgang til fantastiske strande, naturskønne områder og en rig kulturarv, som kan opleves både i fritiden og weekenderne.

  • Attraktiv skattepolitik for udlændinge – For internationale medarbejdere findes der skattefordele, der kan gøre det økonomisk fordelagtigt at arbejde i Portugal.

  • Voksende erhvervsliv og økonomi – Portugal har en blomstrende erhvervssektor, hvor flere internationale virksomheder etablerer sig, hvilket skaber gode jobmuligheder og karriereveje.

  • Stærkt netværk af expats og internationale virksomheder – Mange internationale virksomheder har kontorer i Portugal, hvilket gør det nemt at integrere sig i et globalt arbejdsmiljø.

Arbejdet i Portugal giver både professionel og personlig udvikling samt mulighed for at opleve en spændende livsstil med stor kulturel og økonomisk værdi.

- Mínimo 2 anos de experiência comprovada em reparação de smartphones e tablets;
- Experiência efetiva em reparação ao nível da placa (soldadura BGA, substituição de ICs, uso de estação de rework);

- Experiência em atendimento ao público em ambiente de retalho;
- Domínio de inglês para comunicação técnica com fornecedores;

- Autonomia, organização, boa apresentação e sentido de responsabilidade.

title: OUTROS TRABALHADORES POLIVALENTES
description:
Técnico de Manutenção Polivante Condomínio de Alto Padrão: Procuramos um Técnico de Manutenção para integrar a equipa responsável pela operação de um condomínio residencial de segmento premium, com spa, ginásio e piscinas interior e exterior.

Missão da função
Assegurar o bom funcionamento das instalações e infraestruturas do condomínio, garantindo elevados padrões de qualidade, segurança e apresentação. A função terá especial enfoque na manutenção preventiva, acompanhamento de fornecedores especializados e controlo operacional diário, em articulação com o Facility Manager.

Principais responsabilidades
Executar pequenas intervenções de manutenção geral: eletricidade e canalização básicas, ajustes, reparações e substituições;
Identificar necessidades de intervenção e reportar ao Facility Manager;
Realizar rondas técnicas e inspeções às instalações;
Acompanhar empresas especializadas de AVAC, piscinas, spa, elevadores, sistemas de incêndio, entre outros;
Apoiar visitas técnicas e intervenções de fornecedores;
Preencher checklists operacionais semanais, mensais e trimestrais;
Reportar ocorrências, anomalias e potenciais riscos;
Apoiar a equipa de receção em situações operacionais e necessidades urgentes relacionadas com o funcionamento do edifício.

Perfil pretendido
Conhecimentos gerais de manutenção e capacidade para realizar pequenos reparos;
Sentido de responsabilidade e autonomia;
Atenção ao detalhe e capacidade de organização;
Postura profissional e espírito de equipa;
Discrição e orientação para a qualidade, adequadas a um ambiente residencial premium.

Condições
Reporte direto ao Facility Manager;
Integração numa equipa local;
Responsabilidade pela manutenção operacional diária do edifício;

title: 3D Production Manager (m/f/d) (3-D-Artist)
description:
We`re fast. We‘re colorful. We are loud and quiet. We love what we do and make an important contribution to our customers‘ success every day. We create quality and are one of the leading media and IT service providers in Europe. From Germany and our locations in Asia, we advise and support international clients in several sectors such as advertising, photography, trade and industry. SCHNELLMEDIA stands for know-how and future. Our passion is professional image editing, online and print production as well as real 3D/AI visualization.

We are SCHNELLMEDIA and have a lot of plans.

A strong team needs strong personalities, therefore we are looking for a

3D Production Manager (m/f/d)
Hanoi, Vietnam, Hamburg, Berlin, Amsterdam, Paris, Madrid, Lissabon, Mailand, London, Stockholm
YOUR TASKS:

- Leadership of a motivated 3D production team (Home & Living, Fashion, Retail Industry)
- Oversee daily 3D asset production operations, ensuring smooth delivery and efficient workflows
- Building, developing and motivating the team in Hanoi
- Monitoring, ensuring, and optimizing processes
- Organizing and coordinating between the local branch and the German headquarters
- Actively contributing to the further development of our company
YOUR PROFILE:

- Experience in leadership
- Experience in 3D software such as Blender and/or 3DsMax, Vray for good understanding of 3D workflows
- Experience in photorealistic 3D visualizations of products (focus on furniture) is a plus
- Enjoy working with people and communicating in a solution-oriented manner
- High social and communication skills, flexibility and reliability
- Structured, independent, and goal-oriented working style
- Strong sense of responsibility and assertiveness
- Fluent English (business level)
OUR TOP 3 REASONS:

- Corporate culture characterized by cooperation and co-design
- Responsibility right from the start
- Short decision-making processes in a growing and international company

After an intensive induction phase, we will of course support you with your relocation to Hanoi and be on hand to answer any questions you may have. Apply now with your complete application documents, your earliest possible starting date and your salary expectations.
WE LOOK FORWARD TO RECEIVING YOUR APPLICATION.

-------------------

Wir sind schnell. Wir sind farbenfroh. Wir sind laut und leise. Wir lieben, was wir tun, und leisten täglich einen wichtigen Beitrag zum Erfolg unserer Kunden. Wir schaffen Qualität und zählen zu den führenden Medien- und IT-Dienstleistern in Europa. Von Deutschland und unseren Standorten in Asien aus beraten und unterstützen wir internationale Kunden aus verschiedensten Branchen – etwa Werbung, Fotografie, Handel und Industrie. SCHNELLMEDIA steht für Know-how und Zukunft. Unsere Leidenschaft gilt der professionellen Bildbearbeitung, der Online- und Printproduktion sowie der echten 3D- und KI-Visualisierung.

Wir sind SCHNELLMEDIA und haben viel vor. Ein starkes Team braucht starke Persönlichkeiten – daher suchen wir einen

3D Production Manager (m/w/d)
Hanoi (Vietnam) sowie Hamburg, Berlin, Amsterdam, Paris, Madrid, Lissabon, Mailand, London, Stockholm

DEINE AUFGABEN:

Führung eines motivierten 3D-Produktionsteams (Bereiche: Home & Living, Fashion, Einzelhandel)
Steuerung der täglichen 3D-Asset-Produktion sowie Sicherstellung reibungsloser Abläufe und effizienter Workflows
Aufbau, Weiterentwicklung und Motivation des Teams in Hanoi
Überwachung, Sicherstellung und Optimierung von Prozessen
Organisation und Koordination der Zusammenarbeit zwischen dem Standort vor Ort und der deutschen Zentrale
Aktive Mitgestaltung der Weiterentwicklung unseres Unternehmens

DEIN PROFIL:

Führungserfahrung
Erfahrung mit 3D-Software wie Blender und/oder 3ds Max sowie V-Ray für ein fundiertes Verständnis von 3D-Workflows
Erfahrung in der fotorealistischen 3D-Produktvisualisierung (Schwerpunkt Möbel) ist von Vorteil
Freude an der Zusammenarbeit mit Menschen und lösungsorientierter Kommunikation
Hohe soziale Kompetenz und Kommunikationsstärke, Flexibilität sowie Zuverlässigkeit
Strukturierte, eigenständige und zielorientierte Arbeitsweise
Hohes Verantwortungsbewusstsein und Durchsetzungsstärke
Fließende Englischkenntnisse (verhandlungssicher)

UNSERE TOP-3-GRÜNDE:

Eine von Zusammenarbeit und Mitgestaltung geprägte Unternehmenskultur
Verantwortung von Anfang an
Kurze Entscheidungswege in einem wachsenden, internationalen Unternehmen

title: Job i Portugal med firmabolig - Kunderådgiver for Audi - Opstart den 1. november - Book en samtale i dag!
description:
Kundeservicerådgiver for Audi. Vi har opstart den 1. november med mulighed for firmabolig.

Er du klar til at tage springet og blive en del af en global digital organisation, der leverer support i verdensklasse?

Vi søger en kunderådgiver til en spændende rolle med Audi – en af Europas mest ikoniske bilproducenter. Stillingen er 100 % remote fra Portugal, og du bliver en nøglespiller i et internationalt team, der sikrer en ekstraordinær kunderejse for Audi’s brugere.

Hvad laver en Kundeservicerådgiver?

Som kundeservicerådgiver er du kundens direkte kontaktpunkt og hjælper med alt fra bilteknologi til digitale funktioner og serviceydelser. Du skaber en professionel oplevelse med struktur, empati og høj kvalitet i centrum.

Dine opgaver inkluderer bl.a.:

  • Besvarelse af henvendelser via telefon, e-mail og chat

  • Fejlsøgning af tekniske problemer og vejledning i bilsystemer

  • Registrering af kundeinteraktioner i CRM-systemet

  • Opdatering på Audi’s produkter og politikker

  • Aktiv deltagelse i teamets deling af best practices

Dine kvalifikationer:

Vi leder efter dig, hvis du:

  • Taler og skriver dansk + har et minimum B2-niveau i engelsk

  • Har erfaring med kundeservice – gerne fra bilbranchen

  • Har teknisk flair og interesse for digitale løsninger

  • Kan kommunikere tydeligt, løse problemer og skabe tillid

Du behøver ikke opfylde alle krav – vi opfordrer dig stadig til at søge!

Vi tilbyder:

  • Mulighed for firmabolig i Braga

  • Konkurrencedygtig grundløn plus bonusordning

  • Professionelle udviklingsmuligheder

  • Et samarbejdende og støttende arbejdsmiljø

  • Adgang til eksklusive rejsefordele og rabatter

  • Restaurantkort

  • Privat sundhedsforsikring

  • 14 lønudbetalinger om året

Fordele ved at arbejde i en international virksomhed i Portugal

  • Udvidelse af dine faglige kompetencer gennem globalt samarbejde

  • Forbedring af kommunikation og salgsteknikker i et internationalt miljø

  • Mulighed for karriereudvikling inden for kundeservice, salg og rejsebranchen

  • Adgang til et netværk af internationale kolleger og brancheeksperter

  • Erfaring med moderne digitale værktøjer til kundehåndtering

Dette er en unik mulighed for at kombinere en stærk erhvervserfaring med en fleksibel arbejdsmodel.

Fordele ved at arbejde fra Portugal

  • Mildt klima året rundt – Portugal har et behageligt middelhavsklima med varme somre og milde vintre, hvilket gør det til en attraktiv destination for dem, der ønsker at bo og arbejde i et solrigt land

  • Lavere leveomkostninger – Sammenlignet med mange andre europæiske lande er leveomkostningerne i Portugal relativt lave, hvilket giver mulighed for en høj livskvalitet til en rimelig pris.

  • Høj livskvalitet – Portugal er kendt for sin afslappede livsstil, gode mad og venlige lokalbefolkning, hvilket skaber et positivt og behageligt arbejdsmiljø.

  • Internationale karrieremuligheder – Arbejde i Portugal giver mulighed for at udvikle internationale færdigheder og samarbejde med kolleger fra forskellige nationaliteter, hvilket kan være en fordel for din fremtidige karriere.

  • God infrastruktur og moderne faciliteter – Portugal har en stærk digital infrastruktur, moderne kontorfaciliteter og gode transportmuligheder, hvilket sikrer en behagelig arbejdsdag.

  • Adgang til smukke strande og natur – Portugal tilbyder nem adgang til fantastiske strande, naturskønne områder og en rig kulturarv, som kan opleves både i fritiden og weekenderne.

  • Attraktiv skattepolitik for udlændinge – For internationale medarbejdere findes der skattefordele, der kan gøre det økonomisk fordelagtigt at arbejde i Portugal.

  • Voksende erhvervsliv og økonomi – Portugal har en blomstrende erhvervssektor, hvor flere internationale virksomheder etablerer sig, hvilket skaber gode jobmuligheder og karriereveje.

  • Stærkt netværk af expats og internationale virksomheder – Mange internationale virksomheder har kontorer i Portugal, hvilket gør det nemt at integrere sig i et globalt arbejdsmiljø.

Arbejdet i Portugal giver både professionel og personlig udvikling samt mulighed for at opleve en spændende livsstil med stor kulturel og økonomisk værdi.

title: Forward Deployed Engineer: Ai Solution Architect (f/m/d) (Informatiker/in)
description:
As a Senior AI Solution Architect in our Forward Deployed Engineering team, you see the whole board before a single line of code is written. You partner directly with business leaders across Siemens to map complex challenges to existing data, design cross-platform architectures spanning cloud and enterprise systems, and make critical build-versus-buy decisions in days rather than quarters. You bridge deep technical AI expertise with systems thinking, acting as a force multiplier that enables agile engineering teams to deliver high-impact solutions reliably and repeatedly.

What we offer you:

- An attractive remuneration package- Access to Siemens share plans- 30 days of paid vacation and a variety of flexible work schedules that allow time off for you and your family- Flexible training opportunities for both your professional and personal development that you can tailor to your interests

Since each of over 300,000 team members feels that other benefits are particularly important, and we cannot list our entire benefit portfolio here, you can find more information here (https://www.siemens.com/de/en/company/jobs/benefits-what-we-offer.html) .
The individual benefits are subject to regulatory, contractual, or corporate conditions.

You’ll make an impact by:

- Driving rapid solution architecture as the first technical expert in every engagement, translating complex business problems into viable technical blueprints within days. - Designing interconnected solutions across the entire enterprise landscape, leveraging SDC for workloads while integrating seamlessly with SAP, Salesforce, and cloud-native services. - Owning crucial architecture decisions regarding cost, latency, scalability, and stack selection, while documenting clear justifications for every trade-off. - Evaluating emerging AI technologies with rigorous skepticism, providing evidence-backed adoption recommendations and having the courage to say "not ready yet." - Staying actively involved in the codebase through technical spikes, prototype development, and pull-request reviews to ensure your architectures remain grounded in reality. - Designing from day one for seamless handover, establishing explicit interface contracts, evaluation harnesses, and operational runbooks so domain teams can run systems autonomously.

Your defining qualities:

- Education: You hold a university degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, AI/ML, or a comparable quantitative field, where a proven track record of shipped systems outweighs advanced degrees. - Experience & Skills:- You bring 8 or more years of experience in software architecture, AI/ML systems design, or solution architecture, including at least 3 years focused on complex enterprise AI solutions. - You demonstrate a robust history of customer-facing delivery and technical leadership, especially when navigating demanding or high-pressure stakeholder environments. - You posses hands-on coding capabilities in Python alongside TypeScript or JavaScript, allowing you to write production-grade code and build functional prototypes. - You provide expertise in cross-platform system design by successfully integrating disparate enterprise environments like SAP, Salesforce, and modern cloud services. - You exhibit deep knowledge of the modern AI stack, covering LLM failure modes, RAG architectures, evaluation metrics, vector stores, and prominent agent frameworks. - You bring working knowledge of at least one major cloud provider (Azure, AWS, or GCP) sufficient to design scalable multi-platform workloads.
- Ways of working:- You demonstrate the critical ability to evaluate emerging technologies objectively, separate genuine value from hype, and communicate technical realities clearly. - You display exceptional live communication skills to sketch defensible architectures in real-time meetings and explain them fluently in business terms.
- Languages: You have fluent English language skills, complemented by strong German proficiency as an advantageous asset for local stakeholder engagements.

You are much more than your qualifications, and we believe in the potential of every single candidate. We look forward to getting to know you!
At Siemens, we believe that feeling valued and included is the foundation for doing great work. That’s why we aim to create an inclusive workplace where everyone feels a sense of belonging, and where individual perspectives and experiences are celebrated. Our commitment to fairness and respect extends to every applicant.
As an equal opportunity employer (http://www.siemens.com/global/en/company/sustainability/social-commitments/belonging.html) , we welcome applications from individuals of all backgrounds and particularly encourage applications from persons with disabilities.

About us
We know that our business thrives only when our people thrive and unlock their full potential. That’s why you are always our top priority. Our global, diverse team is ready to support, challenge, and inspire you, helping you grow in countless ways. Together, we’ll embark on an exciting journey of discovery. Who knows where this path will lead? Join us and take an active role in shaping your future!

Zabezpečovať realizáciu poradenských aktivít v školách prezenčným, alebo dištančným spôsobom: - realizovať individuálne poradenstvo pre pedagogických zamestnancov (PZ), vedúcich pedagogických zamestnancov (VPZ), - realizovať návštevy hodín PZ a VPZ s cieľom zvýšenia kvality výchovno-vzdelávacieho procesu, - poskytovať im spätnú väzbu na pozorované edukačné aktivity, - navrhovať odporúčania na zvýšenie kvality výchovno-vzdelávacieho procesu, - identifikovať a diagnostikovať problémy PZ a VPZ, - podporovať PZ a VPZ pri tvorbe návrhov možných riešení ich problémov, - pomáhať im pri aplikácii týchto riešení vo výchovno-vzdelávacom procese v triede a práci so žiakmi, - vedieť poskytovať poradenstvo v niektorých z uvedených oblastí: vzdelávacie programy (ŠVP, ŠkVP), hodnotenie vzdelávacích výsledkov žiakov, vzdelávací proces a vyučovací štýl učiteľa, personalizácia vyučovania a inkluzívne vzdelávanie, digitalizácia. Realizovať skupinové formy rozvoja spôsobilosti PZ a VPZ vo vyššie uvedených oblastiach - formou poldňových/celodňových workshopov, - formou organizovania učiacich sa skupín/organizácie prednášok a diskusií, Monitorovať potreby PZ, VPZ a riaditeľov škôl v regióne - formou dotazníkov pre PZ, VPZ a riaditeľov škôl a školských zariadení, - formou individuálnych rozhovorov s PZ, VPZ a riaditeľmi škôl a školských zariadení. Vykonávať administratívne úlohy spojené s pracovným miestom: - vyplnenie pracovného výkazu, - vedenie dokumentácie o činnostiach, - iné podľa potreby EduHubu. Vykonávať pracovné činnosti podľa potreby a pokynov zamestnávateľa.
Výhody:- flexibilný úväzok 40 – 100 percent , - organizácia času podľa dohody min. 2 dni v týždni, súvisle 7,5 h , - zaujímavá pracovná príležitosť v oblasti školstva na nepedagogickej pozícii, - flexibilita. Ak ešte nemáte absolvované vzdelávanie v mentoringu alebo koučingu 50 h , zabezpečíme a uhradíme ho za vás. Hľadáme predovšetkým ľudí, ktorí sú ochotní vydať sa na cestu rozvoja škôl vo svojom regióne.

title: Riadiaci pracovníci (manažéri) v priemysle
description:
The Engineering Supervisor is responsible for leading and developing a specialized engineering team within EEDC, supporting delivery of industrial automation and functional safety projects. The role combines people leadership, resource and capacity management, technical leadership, and direct project contribution when required, including acting as Lead Engineer on selected safety-related projects.

Main Responsibilities
Team Leadership & People Development
•    Lead, coach, and develop a team of engineers and technical specialists.
•    Conduct performance, development, and career discussions in line with company processes.
•    Support employee engagement, team collaboration, retention, and succession planning.
•    Foster a culture of accountability, continuous improvement, knowledge sharing, and high-quality engineering delivery.
Resource, Capacity & Delivery Management
•    Manage team utilization, workload visibility, resource allocation, and project staffing priorities.
•    Support recruitment, onboarding, competency planning, and capability development for the team.
•    Coordinate with project managers, delivery leaders, and other engineering teams to secure adequate resource coverage.
•    Monitor team objectives and contribute to operational performance, productivity, and delivery reliability.
Technical Leadership – Functional Safety & SIS
•    Provide technical guidance and mentoring on Functional Safety Management (FSM), Safety Instrumented Systems (SIS), and related industrial automation topics.
•    Support functional safety lifecycle activities, including review of safety requirements, engineering deliverables, verification approach, and project execution practices.
•    Act as Lead Engineer, Technical Lead, or Senior Engineer on selected customer projects when business needs require direct technical contribution.
•    Support technical estimation, proposal reviews, project risk identification, and solution alignment for SIS, safety PLC, DCS, SCADA, and critical control applications.
•    Ensure that engineering outputs are aligned with applicable standards, customer requirements, internal quality requirements, cybersecurity expectations, and safety practices.
Operational Excellence & Compliance
•    Support implementation of EEDC strategic initiatives, standard operating practices, and competency roadmaps.
•    Contribute to continuous improvement activities, quality management system adherence, and audit readiness where applicable.
•    Promote safe, compliant, and customer-focused execution across assigned engineering activities.
•    Collaborate with cross-border stakeholders and support regional or global delivery needs as required.

title: Čalúnnici a podobní pracovníci
description:
Náplň práce Pracovná náplň nie je obmedzená len na nižšie uvedené činnosti a zamestnanec môže byť podľa prevádzkových potrieb zamestnávateľa poverený aj ďalšími súvisiacimi pracovnými úlohami. Výroba, čalúnenie, oprava a renovácia čalúneného nábytku (stoličky, kreslá, pohovky, postele a iný nábytok). Výroba a montáž čalúnenia pre motorové vozidlá vrátane kompletného čalúnenia interiéru, obkladov, dekoratívnych prvkov a zákazkových úprav. Meranie, strihanie, príprava a spracovanie poťahových materiálov (textil, koža, ekokoža a iné materiály). Montáž výplňových materiálov (pena, vatelín, pružiny, popruhy a ďalšie čalúnnické komponenty). Šitie poťahov na priemyselných šijacích strojoch podľa potreby výroby. Poťahovanie výrobkov a upevňovanie poťahových materiálov pomocou ručného a elektrického náradia. Oprava alebo výmena poškodených častí čalúneného nábytku a interiérov vozidiel. Kontrola kvality hotových výrobkov a dodržiavanie technologických postupov. Udržiavanie čistoty pracoviska, pracovných nástrojov a výrobných priestorov. Pomoc pri nakládke, vykládke a doručovaní hotových výrobkov zákazníkom. Riadenie služobného motorového vozidla pri zabezpečovaní rozvozu alebo prepravy materiálu, ak je držiteľom platného vodičského oprávnenia. Vykonávanie pomocných a upratovacích prác podľa potrieb prevádzky. Plnenie ďalších pracovných úloh súvisiacich s výrobou, montážou, servisom a prevádzkou spoločnosti podľa pokynov zamestnávateľa. Dodržiavanie predpisov bezpečnosti a ochrany zdravia pri práci (BOZP), protipožiarnych predpisov a interných smerníc zamestnávateľa. Požiadavky na uchádzača Minimálne 3 roky preukázateľnej odbornej praxe na pozícii čalúnnik alebo v obdobnej profesii. Skúsenosti s čalúnením nábytku a výhodou sú skúsenosti s čalúnením interiérov motorových vozidiel. Manuálna zručnosť, presnosť a zodpovedný prístup k práci. Schopnosť pracovať samostatne aj v tíme. Dobrý zdravotný stav a fyzická zdatnosť. Vodičské oprávnenie skupiny B je výhodou.
Výhody:Hradené, vlastná doprava zamestnávateľa

title: Riadiaci pracovníci (manažéri) v priemysle
description:
The Engineering Supervisor is responsible for leading and developing a specialized engineering team within EEDC, supporting delivery of industrial automation and functional safety projects. The role combines people leadership, resource and capacity management, technical leadership, and direct project contribution when required, including acting as Lead Engineer on selected safety-related projects.

Main Responsibilities
Team Leadership & People Development
•    Lead, coach, and develop a team of engineers and technical specialists.
•    Conduct performance, development, and career discussions in line with company processes.
•    Support employee engagement, team collaboration, retention, and succession planning.
•    Foster a culture of accountability, continuous improvement, knowledge sharing, and high-quality engineering delivery.
Resource, Capacity & Delivery Management
•    Manage team utilization, workload visibility, resource allocation, and project staffing priorities.
•    Support recruitment, onboarding, competency planning, and capability development for the team.
•    Coordinate with project managers, delivery leaders, and other engineering teams to secure adequate resource coverage.
•    Monitor team objectives and contribute to operational performance, productivity, and delivery reliability.
Technical Leadership – Functional Safety & SIS
•    Provide technical guidance and mentoring on Functional Safety Management (FSM), Safety Instrumented Systems (SIS), and related industrial automation topics.
•    Support functional safety lifecycle activities, including review of safety requirements, engineering deliverables, verification approach, and project execution practices.
•    Act as Lead Engineer, Technical Lead, or Senior Engineer on selected customer projects when business needs require direct technical contribution.
•    Support technical estimation, proposal reviews, project risk identification, and solution alignment for SIS, safety PLC, DCS, SCADA, and critical control applications.
•    Ensure that engineering outputs are aligned with applicable standards, customer requirements, internal quality requirements, cybersecurity expectations, and safety practices.
Operational Excellence & Compliance
•    Support implementation of EEDC strategic initiatives, standard operating practices, and competency roadmaps.
•    Contribute to continuous improvement activities, quality management system adherence, and audit readiness where applicable.
•    Promote safe, compliant, and customer-focused execution across assigned engineering activities.
•    Collaborate with cross-border stakeholders and support regional or global delivery needs as required.

description: •    The IT / Platform Owner is responsible for the operational ownership, stability, and controlled evolution of the OpenText Documentum platform and related services. The role ensures that Documentum is maintained, supported, and enhanced in line with business needs, compliance requirements, and internal IT standards. A key part of the role is to manage platform consumers, coordinate vendors and service providers, and lead platform-related migration activities, including repository onboarding and consolidation after mergers and acquisitions. title: Správcovia objektov
description:
Pravidelná údržba elektrotechnických zariadení a zabezpečenie ich plnej funkčnosti. Vykonávanie pravidelnej kontroly jednotlivých zariadení. Operatívne riešenie vzniknutých problémov na rozvádzačoch a iných elektr. zariadeniach. Zodpovednosť za pravidelnú údržbu prevádzky a opravy (voda, elektrika, výmena žiaroviek, opravy svietidiel, klimatizácia, vzduchotechnika). Hlavná činnosť je zameraná na fyzický výkon práce. Všetky údržbárske práce v areáli prevádzky. Bezodkladné riešenie vzniknutých problémov a nedostatkov a ich následné hlásenie kompetentným osobám. Znalosť technických parametrov a špecifikácie používaných prístrojov a zariadení. Zapisovanie hodnôt z plynomerov, vodomerov. Výpomoc pri kosení areálu, vysádzaní kvetináčov a udržiavaní poriadku v areáli prevádzky, odpratávanie snehu, výkopové práce. V rámci dosiahnutého vzdelania a kvalifikácie (získané osvedčenia) prevádza všetky pridelené údržbárske práce.
Výhody:Stravovanie zabezpečené zamestnávateľom za symbolickú úhradu. Po uplynutí skúšobnej doby nárok na: - možnosť výmenných rekreácii v našich zariadeniach, - príspevok na III.pilier DDS, - multisport karta, - nepravidelné odmeny. Jedná sa o prácu na 12-hodinové zmeny podľa harmonogramu od pondelka do nedele.

title: Opatrovatelia a asistenti v zariadeniach pre staršie osoby a osoby so zdravotným postihnutím
description:
Ak Ti nie je ľahostajný život ľudí ohrozených stratou bývania a s nepriaznivým zdravotným stavom, príď do Útulku a zariadenia opatrovateľskej služby sv. Lujzy de Marillac a pridaj sa k nám do tímu opatrovateľov! Ako opatrovateľ, opatrovateľka budeš mať možnosť: ​ • prispievať k zlepšeniu zdravotného stavu klienta formou starostlivosti o osobnú hygienu klienta, či pomoci pri presune na lôžko či invalidný vozík • zabezpečovať výdaj stravy, ako aj nevyhnutného ošatenia a obuvi • asistovať pri sprevádzaní klienta k lekárovi a bežných denných aktivitách • podporovať klienta pri každodenných činnostiach • vykonávať administratívne činnosti spojené s poskytovaním služieb klientom • podieľať sa na tímových poradách a skupinových supervíziach Láka Ťa práca opatrovateľa, ale máš obavu, či to zvládneš? Počas zaúčacieho procesu ťa bude sprevádzať šikovný kolega a neskôr budeš mať príležitosť absolvovať certifikovaný opatrovateľský kurz hradený organizáciou. Okrem toho Ťa počas roka čakajú vzdelávacie programy, ktoré Ti pomôžu pri práci s klientom Pozícia je vhodná aj pre študentov sociálnej práce, ktorí by radi počas štúdia pretavili svoje doterajšie vedomosti pri priamej práci s klientom v praxi Týždenný pracovný čas je 37,5h (za mesiac to je 13-14 pracovných zmien). Práca je rozložená na denné a nočné zmeny (v priemere 5-6 nočných zmien mesačne). Denná služba v čase 7:45 - 20:15h a nočná služba v čase 19:45 - 8:15h. ☝️Čo je Útulok a ZOS sv. Lujzy de Marillac a aký Ťa čaká pracovný tím? V zariadení sociálnych služieb sa už 15 rokov venujeme pomoci ľuďom ohrozeným stratou bývania alebo skúsenosťou so životom na ulici, ktorí majú zdravotné ťažkosti a častokrát nemajú dostupné možnosti k doliečeniu svojho stavu. Práve u nás im poskytujeme celodennú starostlivosť s víziou zlepšenia či stabilizovania ich zdravia. V zariadení máme kapacitu 35 klientov, väčšinou v staršom veku. Aj napriek ťažkým životným skúsenostiam našich klientov neopúšťa radosť a snaha o riešenie svojho stavu. Počas týždňa sa klienti zapájajú do rôznych aktivít, ako ranné rozcvičky, prechádzky, návšteva galérie, trhov, spoločné varenie, výroba bezodpadových podpaľovačov a iné. Náš tím opatrovateľov aktuálne tvorí osem kolegov a kolegýň spolu s vedúcou opatrovateľkou, počas dňa sa stretneš aj s vedúcim a zástupkyňou zariadenia, ako aj so sociálnymi pracovníkmi, zdravotnou sestrou a koordinátorkou aktivít. Ak chceš vidieť ako to vyzerá za dverami útulku, pozri si videjko: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=PWIuYGiNTqE

title: Terénni sociálni a zdravotní pracovníci
description:
Túžiš po práci, ktorá má zmysel? Staň sa súčasťou nášho Depaul tímu a maj prácu, ktorá inšpiruje a pomáha! ​Len v Bratislave žije odhadom viac ako 5 000 ľudí bez domova. Mnohí z nich navštevujú naše zariadenia, no ešte väčšia skupina sa ukrýva priamo v uliciach, vlastnoručne postavených príbytkoch či opustených chatrčiach. Ako najväčší terénny tím v Bratislave navštevujeme Karlovu Ves, Dúbravku, Lamač a Devínsku Novú Ves, aby sme pomáhali i tým, ktorí za nami prísť nedokážu. Našim cieľom je vyhľadávať a oslovovať ľudí bez domova v ich prirodzenom prostredí, poskytovať im sociálne a psychologické poradenstvo, základné zdravotné ošetrenie, materiálnu pomoc, sprevádzanie v kríze a prepájať ich na dostupné služby a bývanie. Veríme, že solidarita a spoločná práca môže ľuďom v núdzi darovať nádej a silu na nový začiatok. Ako terénny sociálny pracovník/sociálna pracovníčka budeš: - aktívne vyhľadávať a kontaktovať osoby a rodiny so sociálnymi problémami v rámci lokality a cieľovej skupiny (osoby z marginalizovaných rómskych komunít, ľudia bez domova), - posudzovať životné situácie človeka v spoločenskom, ekonomickom, politickom kontexte lokality/regiónu/spoločnosti, - identifikovať zdroje možností a schopností klienta a jeho sociálneho prostredia potrebných pre dosiahnutie stanovených cieľov klientom, - posky­tovať podporu v krízových situáciách osobám z cieľovej skupiny a sprístupnenie ostatných foriem pomoci, - poskytovať sociálne poradenstvo na úrovni základného a špecializovaného sociálneho poradenstva v súlade so Zákonom č. 448/2008 Z.z. o sociálnych službách, - poskytovať pomoc pri uplatňovaní práv a právom chránených záujmov jednotlivca v súlade so Zákonom č. 448/2008 Z.z. o sociálnych službách, príp. znevýhodnených skupín obyvateľov na lokálnej/regionálnej úrovni, - vykonávať preventívne aktivity v súlade so Zákonom č. 448/2008 Z.z. o sociálnych službách s cieľom predchádzať sociálnemu vylúčeniu alebo jeho prehlbovaniu, zmierňovanie negatívnych dopadov a zvyšovanie kvality života ľudí žijúci v podmienkach sociálneho vylúčenia a generačnej chudoby, - vykonávať aktivity, ktoré prispievajú k zmierňovaniu napätia a latentných konfliktov v lokalite, - spolupracovať s inštitúciami a organizáciami pôsobiacimi v lokalite/regióne a koordinovať ich v záujme klienta/skupiny/komunity, - sprostredkovávať kontakt, prípadne distribuovať a sprevádzať klienta k odborníkovi, do nadväzných služieb (napr. sociálne, psychologické, pedagogické, zdravotné služby a pod.) s ohľadom na potrebu klienta, - vykonávať technicko-administratívne úkony v rámci evidencie terénnej sociálnej práce, - priebežný rozvoj odborných a sociálnych kompetencií, účasť na vzdelávaní a supervíziách, - vykonávať činností prevažne v prirodzenom prostredí klienta (v domácnosti, komunite, vo voľnom priestranstve), - dodržiavať Štandardy terénnej sociálnej práce a terénnej práce vo vylúčení a Etického kódexu sociálneho pracovníka a asistenta sociálne práce Slovenskej republiky.

title: Pomocní pracovníci inde neuvedení
description:
Túžiš po práci, ktorá by ti dávala zmysel? Staň sa súčasťou nášho Deapul tímu a maj prácu, ktorá inšpiruje a pomáha! Ako pomáhajúci pracovník/pomáhajúca pracovníčka budeš s tímom skúsených kolegov a kolegýň pracovať v nízkoprahovej Nocľahárni sv. Vincenta de Paul. Na starosti budeš mať najmä: - pomocné činnosti pri poskytovaní sociálnych služieb a zabezpečovania chodu prevádzky nocľahárne - administratívne činnosti spojené s registráciou klienta, vedenie požadovanej evidencie - pripravovanie hygienických potrieb, pranie uterákov, výdaj čistých plachiet pre klientov, pranie oblečenia - upratovacie práce priestorov počas dennej služby a príprava služby na nočnú zmenu - vo výnimočných prípadoch asistencia pri sprevádzaní imobilného klienta v zariadení, pomoc pri presúvaní, atď - výdaj a/alebo príprava stravy (raňajky), výdaj potravín a ošatenia Pozri si, ako vyzerá práca za dverami nocľahárne: https://www.facebook.com/share/r/1AfN4dSNk5/ :) Rozvrh pracovného času Ide o prácu na nočné (18:45h – 7:45h) a denné zmeny (7:30h – 20:00h) v nepretržitej prevádzke s týždennou pracovnou dobou 37,5h. Mesačný priemer je spravidla 9 nočných služieb a 4 denné služby. Rozvrhnutie zmien môže byť aj individuálne podľa dohody so zamestnancom​ Kto sme? Nocľaháreň sv. Vincenta de Paul je najväčšou nízkoprahovou nocľahárňou v strednej Európe. Funguje nepretržite už 20 rokov, bez prestávky každý deň v roku. Denne poskytne nocľah, teplé jedlo, sociálne poradenstvo a ďalšie služby pre 200 ľudí v núdzi. Nocľaháreň je jedným z 10 zariadení a projektov neziskovej organizácie Depaul Slovensko, ktorá poskytuje komplexné služby ľuďom bez domova. Pre činnosť našej organizácie sú najdôležitejší naši zamestnanci – Depaul ľudia – profesionáli s veľkým srdcom, trpezlivosťou a empatiou. Pracujeme v priateľskom kolektíve, podporujme vzdelávanie, supervízie a teambulidingové aktivity. Láka ťa práca v nocľahárni, ale premýšľaš, či máš dostatok skúseností? Počas zaúčacieho procesu ťa bude v práci sprevádzať skúsený tím kolegov. Postupne budeš mať príležitosť absolvovať školenia a supervízie, ktoré ti pomôžu pri práci s klientmi. Pozícia je vhodná aj pre študentov sociálnej práce alebo príbuzných humanitárnych odborov, ktorí by radi svoje doterajšie vedomosti preniesli do praxe. Náš tím tvorí viacero pomáhajúcich pracovníkov a počas dňa stretneš aj skvelých sociálnych pracovníkov, koordinátorky dobrovoľníkov a komunitné organizátorky či vedúcu nocľahárne s jej zástupkyňami. Viac informácií o nocľahárni a útulku nájdeš na našej webovej stránke https://depaul.sk/, v časti Naše služby, alebo vo video vizitke: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=9IufpprxiqU Tešíme sa na teba :) !

title: Dansk job i Málaga – Vil du være med til at få endnu større publikum ud til koncerter, festivaler og oplevelser?
description:
Vi leder efter en dansk kollega til vores nordiske team i Málaga med opstart den senest den 1. november. Du bliver specialisten i en international virksomhed, hvor din opgave er at åbne døren til nye kunder i Danmark og booke møder til vores salgsteam.

Vi er en international tech- og eventvirksomhed i vækst, der hjælper arrangører med at sælge billetter og nå ud til nyt publikum. Hver dag går vores platform i gang med at sælge billetter til alt fra små uafhængige events til store festivaler. Og det er dig, der åbner døren til de arrangører, der får det til at ske.

Du kontakter eventarrangører i Danmark og booker de møder, som bliver til nye kunder og. Det er ikke et callcenterjob med manuskript. Du får din plads på vores nye, moderne kontor i det centrale Málaga, hvor du sidder side om side med kolleger fra marketing, salg, admin, HR og andre specialistfunktioner. Organisationen er flad, og vejene er korte.  Miljøet er det samme, som hvis du arbejdede på et kontor i Danmark: professionelt, uformelt og præget af høj faglighed.

Kontoret er nyt og moderne, med samme miljø som på et dansk kontor: gamingrum, massagerum, gratis frokost og et modent arbejdsmiljø, hvor tillid og ansvar er en selvfølge. Kort sagt: fast kontrakt, fair løn, sol udenfor og en hverdag med reel indflydelse på, at virksomheden vokser.

Det her er chancen for at kombinere en fast stilling og en fair løn med en hverdag i solen, i en virksomhed der er i vækst.

Dine arbejdsopgaver:

  • Opsøgende kontakt til eventarrangører i Danmark

  • Booking af møder til salgsteamet

  • Opbygning af gode dialoger og relationer med nye kontakter

  • Tæt sparring med salgsteamet for at sikre størst mulig værdi i møderne

Din hverdag:

Du arbejder med outbound og har mange samtaler med nye mennesker. Du planlægger selv din dag og dine rutiner og har ansvaret for at skabe resultater. Du sidder tæt på dine kolleger i salg og marketing og har direkte dialog med dem, der overtager de møder, du booker.

Hvem er du?

  • Du taler og skriver dansk

  • Du har minimum 1 års erfaring med outbound‑samtaler

  • Du er god til at skabe dialog og trives med kontakt til nye mennesker

  • Du er positiv, struktureret og vedholdende

  • Du er en stærk holdspiller

  • Du kan arbejde fast fra kontoret i Málaga

  • Du søger en stabil stilling – ikke et sabbatårsjob

Du behøver ikke mange års erfaring. Det vigtigste er, at du har den rette indstilling og et højt drive.

Du arbejder tæt sammen med ambitiøse virksomheder, der skal onboardes til digital vækst. Du rådgiver om Pay-Per-Click-kampagner (PPC), identificerer vækstmuligheder og skaber langsigtet værdi. Barcelona byder på solrige dage, strandliv og kreativ energi. Her kan du nyde tapas ved havet, arbejde med banebrydende teknologi og udvikle dig både personligt og professionelt i et byliv, der aldrig står stille. Derudover får du:

description:

We create quality and are one of the leading media and IT service providers in Europe. From Germany and our locations in Asia, we advise and support international clients in several sectors such as advertising, photography, trade and industry. SCHNELLMEDIA stands for know-how and future. Our passion is professional image editing, online and print production as well as real 3D/AI visualization.

We are SCHNELLMEDIA and have a lot of plans.

A strong team needs strong personalities, therefore we are looking for a

3D Production Manager (m/f/d)
Hanoi, Vietnam, Hamburg, Berlin, Amsterdam, Paris, Madrid, Lissabon, Mailand, London, Stockholm

- Oversee daily 3D asset production operations, ensuring smooth delivery and efficient workflows
- Building, developing and motivating the team in Hanoi

- Organizing and coordinating between the local branch and the German headquarters
- Actively contributing to the further development of our company

- Experience in 3D software such as Blender and/or 3DsMax, Vray for good understanding of 3D workflows

- Enjoy working with people and communicating in a solution-oriented manner
- High social and communication skills, flexibility and reliability
- Structured, independent, and goal-oriented working style
- Strong sense of responsibility and assertiveness
- Fluent English (business level)
OUR TOP 3 REASONS:

- Corporate culture characterized by cooperation and co-design
- Responsibility right from the start
- Short decision-making processes in a growing and international company

After an intensive induction phase, we will of course support you with your relocation to Hanoi and be on hand to answer any questions you may have. Apply now with your complete application documents, your earliest possible starting date and your salary expectations.
WE LOOK FORWARD TO RECEIVING YOUR APPLICATION.

-------------------

Wir schaffen Qualität und zählen zu den führenden Medien- und IT-Dienstleistern in Europa. Von Deutschland und unseren Standorten in Asien aus beraten und unterstützen wir internationale Kunden aus verschiedensten Branchen – etwa Werbung, Fotografie, Handel und Industrie. SCHNELLMEDIA steht für Know-how und Zukunft. Unsere Leidenschaft gilt der professionellen Bildbearbeitung, der Online- und Printproduktion sowie der echten 3D- und KI-Visualisierung.

Wir sind SCHNELLMEDIA und haben viel vor. Ein starkes Team braucht starke Persönlichkeiten – daher suchen wir einen

3D Production Manager (m/w/d)
Hanoi (Vietnam) sowie Hamburg, Berlin, Amsterdam, Paris, Madrid, Lissabon, Mailand, London, Stockholm

DEINE AUFGABEN:

Führung eines motivierten 3D-Produktionsteams (Bereiche: Home & Living, Fashion, Einzelhandel)
Steuerung der täglichen 3D-Asset-Produktion sowie Sicherstellung reibungsloser Abläufe und effizienter Workflows
Aufbau, Weiterentwicklung und Motivation des Teams in Hanoi
Überwachung, Sicherstellung und Optimierung von Prozessen
Organisation und Koordination der Zusammenarbeit zwischen dem Standort vor Ort und der deutschen Zentrale
Aktive Mitgestaltung der Weiterentwicklung unseres Unternehmens

DEIN PROFIL:

Führungserfahrung
Erfahrung mit 3D-Software wie Blender und/oder 3ds Max sowie V-Ray für ein fundiertes Verständnis von 3D-Workflows
Erfahrung in der fotorealistischen 3D-Produktvisualisierung (Schwerpunkt Möbel) ist von Vorteil
Freude an der Zusammenarbeit mit Menschen und lösungsorientierter Kommunikation
Hohe soziale Kompetenz und Kommunikationsstärke, Flexibilität sowie Zuverlässigkeit
Strukturierte, eigenständige und zielorientierte Arbeitsweise
Hohes Verantwortungsbewusstsein und Durchsetzungsstärke
Fließende Englischkenntnisse (verhandlungssicher)

UNSERE TOP-3-GRÜNDE:

Eine von Zusammenarbeit und Mitgestaltung geprägte Unternehmenskultur
Verantwortung von Anfang an
Kurze Entscheidungswege in einem wachsenden, internationalen Unternehmen

title: Chargé(e) d'Affaires Construction Métallique (H/F)
description:
Barcelone - Espagne
Rejoindre le futur pôle d'ingénierie et développement du groupe AXOR
Dans le cadre de son développement, AXOR Ingénierie souhaite faire de Barcelone son futur pôle d'ingénierie, de coordination et de développement pour l'ensemble du groupe.
Déjà implanté sur plusieurs marchés, le groupe accompagne ses clients dans la conception, l'ingénierie, la fabrication et le déploiement de structures métalliques destinées aux bâtiments industriels, tertiaires et résidentiels.
Nous recherchons aujourd'hui un(e) Chargé(e) d'Affaires Construction Métallique capable de suivre les projets de manière autonome, de coordonner les différents intervenants et de contribuer au développement commercial du groupe.
Votre mission
En lien direct avec la Direction, les équipes techniques et les partenaires du groupe, vous prenez en charge le suivi des affaires depuis l'analyse du besoin client jusqu'à la coordination de la réalisation.
Votre rôle consiste à faire le lien entre les clients, les bureaux d'études, les équipes commerciales, les partenaires techniques et les unités de production afin de garantir le bon déroulement des projets.
Ce poste est basé à Barcelone, avec une activité tournée principalement vers le développement et le suivi des affaires en France et sur les autres marchés du groupe.
Vos principales responsabilités
Suivi des affaires et coordination technique
- Analyser les demandes clients, les dossiers techniques, plans et cahiers des charges ;
- Participer à l'étude de faisabilité technique et commerciale des projets ;
- Préparer, suivre et relancer les offres commerciales ;
- Coordonner les échanges entre clients, bureaux d'études, partenaires techniques et équipes internes ;
- Suivre l'avancement des projets, les délais, les priorités et les points de blocage ;
- Assurer un reporting régulier auprès de la Direction ;
- Veiller à la bonne transmission des informations nécessaires à la production et à la réalisation des projets.
Développement commercial et relation partenaires
- Développer et entretenir un portefeuille de clients et partenaires ;
- Représenter AXOR auprès des acteurs du secteur : entreprises, bureaux d'études, architectes, maîtres d'œuvre, partenaires industriels ;
- Identifier de nouvelles opportunités d'affaires sur les marchés ciblés ;
- Participer à la structuration des méthodes commerciales et du suivi client ;
- Contribuer au développement des activités liées aux structures métalliques, à l'enveloppe du bâtiment et aux solutions constructives.
Profil recherché
- Expérience confirmée en chargé d'affaires, conduite de projets, développement commercial BTP, construction métallique, ingénierie ou environnement similaire ;
- Bonne compréhension des dossiers techniques, plans, métrés, chiffrages et contraintes chantier ;
- Capacité à piloter plusieurs affaires en parallèle avec rigueur et autonomie ;
- Aisance dans la relation client, la négociation et la coordination d'interlocuteurs variés ;
- Esprit entrepreneurial, sens de l'organisation et capacité à structurer son activité ;
- Profil terrain, réactif, fiable et orienté solutions ;
- Une expérience dans la construction métallique, le bâtiment industriel, l'enveloppe du bâtiment ou les structures métalliques serait fortement appréciée.
Langues
- Français courant indispensable ;
- Espagnol professionnel indispensable ;
- Anglais apprécié ;
- Turc apprécié.
Ce poste s'adresse à vous si..
En plus d'une solide compréhension technique et commerciale, nous recherchons une personne capable de prendre en main des affaires de manière autonome, de sécuriser le suivi des projets et de contribuer concrètement au développement du groupe.
Cadre de la collaboration
- CDI ou collaboration selon profil ;
- Poste basé à Barcelone ;
- Déplacements ponctuels à prévoir en France et auprès des clients / partenaires ;
- Rémunération selon profil et expérience.

title: Conseiller clientèle H/F - Barcelone - Poste en français
description:

Tu rêves de t'expatrier en Espagne ? Tu aimes écouter, conseiller et trouver des solutions ? Tu recherches un CDI dans une entreprise internationale où tu pourras évoluer ?

Alors cette opportunité est faite pour toi !

Tes missions

Au quotidien, tu accompagneras une clientèle francophone par téléphone, e-mail ou chat en :

Répondant aux demandes des clients ;

Écoutant et comprenant leurs besoins ;

Leur apportant des réponses claires et des solutions adaptées ;

Assurant le suivi des demandes jusqu'à leur résolution ;

Mettant à jour les informations dans l'outil CRM ;

Veillant à leur satisfaction et à la qualité du service.

Le profil idéal

Pas besoin d'avoir déjà travaillé dans la relation client !

Nous recherchons avant tout des profils capables de :

faire preuve de motivation, de patience et de dynamisme ;

utiliser le téléphone et les outils numériques avec aisance ;

entretenir une bonne relation avec les clients et faire preuve de sens du service ;

écouter, analyser une demande et proposer une solution ;

apprendre et progresser ;

envisager une expérience professionnelle en Espagne.

Ce que tu vas adorer
Une vraie évolution de carrière

CDI à temps plein de droit espagnol ;

Formation lors de la prise de poste ;

Perspectives d'évolution interne ;

Environnement international et multiculturel.

Une qualité de vie exceptionnelle

Barcelone : plage, soleil et ambiance internationale ;

Une équipe dynamique et multiculturelle ;

Un environnement de travail convivial ;

Des avantages complémentaires selon l'entreprise partenaire.

Ton expatriation simplifiée

Colybry accompagne gratuitement les candidats tout au long du processus de recrutement.

En cas de mobilité vers Barcelone, notre équipe peut également t'informer et t'accompagner dans tes démarches administratives et ta recherche de logement.

Prêt(e) à tenter l'aventure ?

Si tu souhaites vivre à Barcelone, travailler en français et développer de véritables compétences dans la relation client, n'attends plus : postule dès maintenant !
  
Motivation, patience et dynamisme, aisance au téléphone et avec les outils numériques, sens du service et bon relationnel. Français professionnel. Débutants acceptés, formation prévue.

We are working on behalf of a well-established European e-commerce business within the office supplies sector, known for its strong reputation and loyal customer base.

As a Sales Agent, you’ll play a key role in strengthening customer relationships while identifying opportunities to add value through smart product recommendations.

What You’ll Be Doing

- Calling existing German-speaking customers **(warm leads only)**
- Advising on printers, cartridges, toners, and office supplies
- Recommending alternative or home-brand products where relevant
- Identifying upselling opportunities (bundles, larger quantities, better-value deals)
- Ensuring accurate and smooth order processing
- Collaborating closely with your team to deliver great customer experiences

This role is all about trust, understanding customer needs, and delivering real value—not aggressive selling.

What You Bring

- Native-level German
- Strong communication skills and confidence on the phone
- A commercial mindset with the ability to spot opportunities
- High attention to detail when managing orders
- A proactive attitude and eagerness to learn and grow

Sales experience is a plus, but not essential—motivation and mindset are key.

Why This Role Stands Out

This isn’t a typical sales role:

- No cold calling
- No pushy tactics
- No anonymous leads

Instead, you’ll benefit from:

- An existing, loyal customer base
- Clear and straightforward product offerings
- Honest upselling that benefits both the customer and the business
- A supportive environment focused on development

What’s in It for You?

- Live and work in sunny Valencia, Spain
- Breakfast and lunch provided at the office
- Spanish health insurance included
- Free Spanish language lessons
- Career development and growth opportunities
- Monthly team events, sports, and social activities
- Full relocation support to help you settle in smoothly

Ready to Get Started?

If you enjoy building relationships, spotting opportunities, and working in an international, fast-paced environment—this is your chance to grow your career while enjoying life in Spain.

title: Quality Evaluator and Coach (Danish Speaking) - Benalmádena, Spain
description:
Experience the power of a game-changing career

Are you passionate about quality, coaching and customer experience? Do you enjoy working with data, supporting teams and finding opportunities to improve performance?

At Concentrix, we are looking for a Quality Evaluator & Coach to join our team and play a key role in monitoring quality, coaching agents and supporting daily operations.

In this role, you will combine quality evaluation, performance coaching, reporting and operational support, working closely with agents, team leaders and client stakeholders.

What you will do in this role

- Monitor and manage Back Office emails, Moreshop and Trustpilot activities.

- Create and maintain Back Office schedules.

- Participate in weekly, bi-weekly and monthly operational and sales meetings.

- Prepare and present monthly performance data to clients and stakeholders.

- Conduct call calibration sessions every 8 weeks, reviewing four calls per agent.

- Perform monthly quality controls for Back Office and Moreshop emails.

- Conduct monthly coaching sessions with agents based on quality evaluations.

- Set and follow up on individual performance goals, identifying areas for improvement.

- Review daily unpaid digital sales reports and update the Callback List.

- Provide training and ongoing support to new agents.

- Keep Humany updated based on the client's weekly magazine stock report.

- Support daily operations by handling calls, emails and Back Office activities, including Moreshop, Intrum and social media.

Around 65% of the role will involve hands-on operational support, keeping you closely connected to the customer experience and day-to-day needs of the team.

Your qualifications

- Are proficient or bilingual in Danish and English  

- Experience in quality monitoring, coaching, customer service or contact center operations.

- Strong communication, coaching and stakeholder-management skills.

- Excellent organisational, planning and time-management skills.

- Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret KPIs, sales results, quality scores and operational data.

- Proficiency in Microsoft Excel, including formulas, filters, pivot tables and basic data analysis/reporting.

- Experience working with CRM, ticketing or customer service management systems.

- Ability to create, maintain and analyse operational reports and performance trackers.

- Familiarity with quality monitoring and call calibration processes.

- Ability to work confidently across multiple platforms and systems.

- Good understanding of data accuracy, documentation and reporting procedures.

- Ability to troubleshoot basic system or access issues and escalate technical problems when necessary.

- Experience with workforce scheduling and resource planning is an advantage.

- Ability to quickly learn and adapt to new systems, digital tools and operational processes.

What's in it for you?

- Full-time position: 39 hours per week, Monday to Friday from 9:00 to 17:00

- Base salary of 24.600 euros gross/year plus up to 3.600 euros gross/year in bo

nus

- Training and development opportunities to help you grow your career.

- Multicultural and dynamic work environment with colleagues from around the world.

- Career growth opportunities within Concentrix.

- Employee discounts on a wide range of products and services.

- Wellbeing initiatives and access to resources to support your physical and mental health.

- Modern office environment in Benalmadena with a collaborative and supportive culture.

Experience the best version of you

At Concentrix, we believe that our people are at the heart of everything we do. We create an environment where you can develop your skills, take on new challenges and grow your career.

If you're ready to make an impact through quality, coaching and continuous improvement, we'd love to hear from you!

Apply now and join Concentrix!
