title: Embedded Software Product Owner
description:
🚀 We’re Hiring: Product Owner – Test Automation & Android Infotainment (1-2 Year Fixed Term Employment)

Hykmann Global Business Solutions AB is looking for a technically strong and proactive Product Owner to lead a Verification & Test Automation team focused on Driver Information and Infotainment systems within the automotive industry.

We are seeking a professional who combines product ownership, agile leadership, and test strategy expertise with hands-on technical knowledge of Android testing, test automation, and test architecture. If you enjoy driving product quality, building scalable automation solutions, and collaborating across engineering teams, this opportunity could be a great fit.

🔧 About the Role

As Product Owner, you will own the test automation roadmap and backlog, lead prioritization, and ensure alignment with software development milestones and quality objectives. You will work closely with software developers, test engineers, system architects, and AI specialists to evolve test strategies and deliver reliable, high-performance automotive infotainment systems.

The role combines strategic planning with practical technical involvement in automation development, testing infrastructure, regression testing, and CI/CD integration.

💻 Key Responsibilities

Define the feature roadmap and prioritize deliverables to meet software development milestones.

Own and manage the test automation product backlog for Android infotainment systems.

Lead the test automation team, ensuring stable, scalable, and quality-focused testing infrastructure.

Define and communicate user stories, epics, features, and acceptance criteria.

Develop and evolve test architecture aligned with system design and verification objectives.

Provide hands-on support for test automation development using Python, C#, CAPL, Docker, and AI-based testing approaches.

Collaborate with stakeholders to clarify requirements and ensure adequate test coverage.

Drive automated regression testing and integrate test suites into CI/CD pipelines.

Monitor test execution, investigate failures, and collaborate with developers on root-cause analysis.

Explore AI-driven testing methods and continuously improve test frameworks for scalability and maintainability.

Skills & requirements

🎯 Required Skills & Experience

Bachelor's or Master's degree in Automotive Engineering, Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or a related field.

Proven experience as a Product Owner or Technical Lead in test automation projects, preferably within automotive or infotainment systems.

Strong technical understanding of the Android platform and debugging using Android Debug Bridge (ADB).

Hands-on programming or scripting experience with Python, C#, and CAPL, along with Docker.

Solid knowledge of test automation architecture and verification strategies.

Understanding of Hardware-in-the-Loop (HIL), Software-in-the-Loop (SIL), and cloud-based testing frameworks.

Exposure to AI/ML applications in testing, such as anomaly detection and intelligent test-case selection.

Experience with Agile/Scrum methodologies, backlog management, and stakeholder coordination.

Strong communication, analytical, and problem-solving skills.

⭐ Preferred Skills

Experience with automotive software quality standards, including ISO 26262 and Automotive SPICE (ASPICE).

Knowledge of automotive communication protocols such as CAN, LIN, and Ethernet.

Experience with Android Automotive OS (AAOS) or In-Vehicle Infotainment (IVI) systems.

Familiarity with Jenkins, Bitbucket, Gerrit, and Git.

Experience with test management and requirements tools such as JIRA, SystemWeaver, SE Tool, and Confluence.

🌟 Who Should Apply?

We are looking for a technically hands-on product leader who can translate product objectives into an effective test automation strategy, guide engineering teams, and continuously improve software quality across complex automotive systems.

📩 Interested? Send us your updated CV, highlighting your product ownership experience, Android testing expertise, test automation skills, and automotive industry background.

title: Embedded Software Engineer
description:

Provide technical leadership and guide system engineering activities within the team.

Integrate software deliveries from multiple contributors and ensure quality and release readiness.

Contribute to early-stage development, technical roadmaps, and long-term engineering strategies.

Strong expertise in embedded software applications and automotive system engineering.

Experience across the software development lifecycle, including requirements breakdown, design, implementation, testing, and verification.

Proven ability to lead technical activities, coordinate deliveries, and ensure high-quality software releases.

Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to address complex technical challenges.

Experience mentoring engineers, sharing knowledge, and providing technical guidance.

Ability to connect technical solutions with product strategy, business objectives, and industry trends.

A strong T-shaped technical profile, combining deep expertise in a specialist domain with broader engineering knowledge.

Experience in one or more of the following areas is highly relevant:

Vehicle Systems and HMI

Combustion Engines and Engine Aftertreatment

Electromobility

Powertrain Control

Control Theory

Mechatronics

Automotive Diagnostics

🌟 What Makes This Opportunity Special?

This role is suited to an established technical expert who can combine hands-on engineering with system-level leadership. You will have the opportunity to influence technical direction, contribute to product roadmaps, solve complex discipline-related challenges, and help strengthen engineering capabilities across the organization.

📩 Interested? Send us your updated CV, highlighting your embedded software expertise, automotive experience, technical leadership, and relevant specialist domain.

title: Data Engineer (Python and Java/Scala skills)

title: Backend Engineer
description:
About Epiminds

We’re building Lucy, an AI system that investigates marketing performance and carries approved changes through to execution.

Behind that work is a backend coordinating model calls, external APIs, persistent state, and code running in sandboxes. We’re a small team in Stockholm building the infrastructure this product needs.

The Problem

Agent workloads are difficult to predict. One request can become several parallel investigations. A task can pause for approval and continue later. A worker can disappear after an external API accepts a change but before the result is saved.

Retrying may duplicate the action. Giving up may leave the work unfinished. Keeping everything ready reduces latency but consumes idle compute.

The system has to know what happened, who owns the next step, and what is safe to repeat—while keeping data isolated and costs under control.

The Role

You’ll own the execution infrastructure, data systems, and reliability behind Lucy.

You’ll work across application code, databases, and cloud infrastructure, taking changes from design through deployment and operation. Your decisions will shape how the product handles more work and recovers when things fail.

What You’ll Do

    Make execution durable. Build scheduling, queues, leases, cancellation, and recovery for work that outlives an individual request.
    Make retries safe. Preserve execution state and prevent duplicate events from repeating external actions.
    Run agent compute efficiently. Improve sandbox startup, worker scaling, resource limits, and cleanup.
    Build dependable data flows. Handle pagination, partial failures, changing provider contracts, and datasets that should be streamed rather than held in memory.
    Make failures explainable. Connect traces, logs, and cost data so the team can find bottlenecks and resolve incidents.

What We’re Looking For

You’ve operated backend systems in production and owned their reliability. You understand database design, distributed state, queues, and the difference between a failed request and a failed operation.

You’re comfortable with containers and cloud infrastructure. You can explain what breaks under load, how recovery works, and when a simpler design is enough.

Our stack includes TypeScript, Node.js, Supabase/PostgreSQL, Redis, Temporal, Cloud Run, GKE, Modal, Docker, and Pulumi.

Why Join Now

Execution is central to the product. You’ll shape how agents run, how their work survives failures, and how infrastructure cost changes as usage grows.

What we offer

    Competitive salary and meaningful equity.
    Healthcare, retirement savings, and wellbeing support.
    Office catering.

Hiring process

    Recruiter screening.
    Technical task.
    Code interview.
    Trial with us in the office.

We welcome applicants of all backgrounds.

title: Personlig assistent till ung kvinna i Umeå  fast schemarad
description:
Om Provide Assistans. Vi är ett familjärt företag inom personlig assistans som är verksamma i Västerbotten. Vi hjälper människor, som är beviljad personlig assistans, att utifrån sina behov och önskemål kunna leva ett så rikt liv som man vill och kan. Våra grundvärderingar är inflytande, omtanke och kunskap. Dessa styr vår verksamhet i grunden och gör oss till det vi är. Det guidar såväl företaget som våra medarbetares vardag i mötet med kunder, samarbetspartners och kollegor. Vi tycker det är viktigt med hållbarhet, inkludering och jämställdhet. Vi vill definitivt vara med och bidra till en hållbar utveckling och göra vad vi kan för att minska vår egen klimatpåverkan genom att påverka de vi möter i vår egen verksamhet samt i vår närhet.

Vi söker nu dig som vill vara med och skapa en varm, trygg och glädjefylld vardag för en ung kvinna i Umeå. Hon tycker om musik, dans, god mat, att resa men också lugnare stunder med pyssel eller annat. Din roll blir att stötta henne i att fortsätta med det som får henne att må bra – rörelse, gemenskap, upplevelser och små stunder av vardagsglädje.



Stödet handlar mycket om att vara lyhörd, närvarande och att bygga en trygg relation. Du kommer att hjälpa henne i kommunikationen och få möjlighet att lära dig förstå hennes sätt att uttrycka tankar, känslor och önskemål. Tillsammans får ni träna och utveckla kommunikationen i vardagen, vilket är en viktig del av uppdraget och hennes möjlighet till delaktighet och självbestämmande.



I rollen ingår även viss hjälp med personlig hygien, så det är viktigt att du känner dig bekväm med det. Hon har daglig verksamhet på vardagar, vilket innebär att arbetspassen främst är förlagda till andra tider. När du arbetar hos henne är du den som bidrar med lugn, trygghet, struktur och ett positivt bemötande.

Om tjänsten

    Fast schemarad på ca 40 %
    Arbetspass förlagda till dag, kväll och natt med sovande jour
    Utdrag ur belastningsregistret kommer att begäras innan anställning

Vi tror att du:

    Är varm, lyhörd och uppmärksam på individens behov
    Tycker om att skapa delaktighet och uppmuntra till aktiviteter som ger glädje och livskvalitet
    Har tålamod och tycker att det är givande att utveckla kommunikation och samspel tillsammans med en annan person
    Är trygg, ansvarstagande och engagerad

Önskade kvalifikationer

    Är varm, lyhörd och trygg i mötet med andra människor
    Har tålamod och tycker om att bygga relationer
    Tycker om att skapa glädje, delaktighet och meningsfulla aktiviteter i vardagen
    Har goda kunskaper i svenska, både i tal och skrift

Meriterande:

    Erfarenhet av personlig assistans, omsorg eller liknande arbete
    Erfarenhet av AKK eller andra kommunikationsstöd

Övrig information:

    I det här uppdraget söker vi en kvinnlig assistent och stor vikt läggs vid personlig lämplighet.
    Du behöver inte ha körkort!
    Tillträde: Omgående, inskolning sker på studs.
    Vi tillämpar individuell lönesättning och har kollektivavtal. Intervjuer sker löpande och tjänsten kan komma att tillsättas innan sista ansökningsdag.

Vid frågor om tjänsten, är du varmt välkommen att kontakta: Andreas Elveljung, kundansvarig via info@provideassistans.se alternativt via 070-2929319.

Varmt välkommen med din ansökan innehållande ett cv samt ett personligt brev.

title: Validation Engineer Sterilization (MS&T)
description:
At Galderma, we are advancing dermatology for every skin story. We are now looking for a highly experienced Validation Engineer Sterilization to join our MS&T team in Uppsala. This is a key role for someone who wants to combine deep technical expertise with cross-functional collaboration in a highly regulated manufacturing environment.

In this position, you will act as the subject matter expert for sterilization processes with a particular focus on autoclaves with moist heat sterilization and VHP (Vaporized Hydrogen Peroxide) decontamination systems.

You will play a critical role in ensuring that sterilization processes remain compliant, scientifically sound, and in a validated state throughout the product lifecycle, supporting patient safety and product quality.

The Role

As Validation Engineer Sterilization, you will lead and drive validation and qualification activities across sterilization systems and processes. Working closely with Manufacturing, Engineering, Quality, and other stakeholders, you will provide technical leadership and ensure compliance with regulatory requirements and industry best practices.

Your responsibilities will include:

    Acting as the SME for autoclave-based moist heat sterilization and VHP decontamination of isolators and controlled environments.

    Leading autoclave cycle development, qualification, and validation activities for equipment, components, and finished products.

    Planning and executing equipment qualification and process validation activities, including IQ/OQ/PQ.

    Maintaining sterilization cycle parameters, load configurations, and process definitions.

    Driving requalification programs and lifecycle management of validated systems.

    Performing thermal mapping, heat penetration studies, biological indicator evaluations, and cold spot identification.

    Establishing and maintaining scientifically justified sterilization cycles aligned with regulatory expectations.

    Authoring, reviewing, and approving validation protocols, reports, risk assessments, deviations, CAPAs, and change controls.

Who You Are

We are looking for a technically strong and quality-focused professional who thrives in a collaborative environment. You enjoy solving complex problems, influencing stakeholders, and driving activities from concept through execution while maintaining a strong compliance mindset.

To be successful in this role, you bring:

    A Bachelor's or Master's degree in Engineering, Chemistry, Biochemistry, Biotechnology, Pharmaceutical Sciences, or a related field.

    Approximately 10 years or more of relevant experience within qualification and validation in a GMP-regulated environment.

    Demonstrated expertise in moist heat sterilization, autoclave validation, and sterilization science.

    Experience with VHP decontamination systems and controlled manufacturing environments.

    Strong knowledge of validation methodologies, qualification activities, and lifecycle validation.

    Solid understanding of cGMP requirements and regulatory expectations.

    Excellent technical writing, documentation, communication, and collaboration skills.

    Strong analytical abilities with experience in root cause analysis and risk-based decision making.

Experience from pharmaceutical, biopharmaceutical, medical device, or other regulated manufacturing environments is highly valued.

Please note, applications will be reviewed continuously and we may fill the position before the closing date, so we encourage you to apply as soon as possible.

Why Galderma?

At Galderma, you'll have the opportunity to work in a company dedicated to innovation, quality, and improving patient outcomes. You will join a collaborative and science-driven environment where your expertise will have a direct impact on product quality, operational excellence, and the future growth of our Uppsala site.

We look forward to hearing from you.

title: Product Sourcing Leader
description:
Inter IKEA Group connects IKEA franchisees with range development and suppliers and ensures alignment of the overall IKEA strategic direction. Every day, we strive to develop, produce, and sell products and services that are affordable and accessible to everyone.

In Purchasing Development, we bring IKEA products to life by working closely with suppliers and partners. Together, we turn designs into real, affordable and responsibly produced products. We secure IWAY requirements, improve materials, strengthen sourcing and keep costs low while helping the IKEA value chain stand strong when the world changes.

Within Purchasing Development, Category Area Food is part of the Food total value chain transformation. We are creating simpler and more connected ways of working, with clearer ownership and faster decisions closer to where value is created for our customers. For sourcing, this means using supplier competence earlier, reducing handovers and creating stronger conditions for speed, availability, affordability and growth.

We are now looking for 3 Product Sourcing Leaders who wants to help shape the next chapter of IKEA Food sourcing. In this role, you will connect product development, supplier capability and sourcing optimisation, from early development ideas to sourcing implementation.

Food operates in an industry with short shelf life, strong requirements on freshness, quality and food safety, and a supplier landscape that calls for both strategic partnerships and simpler sourcing solutions. You will bring fact-based sourcing input early, support clear choices and help create feasible, cost-conscious sourcing setups that work in real business life.

Job Description

As Product Sourcing Leader, you will lead sourcing and supplier capability input to product development and portfolio planning. You will support the move towards a more industry-fit sourcing setup by evaluating supplier options, deciding on development suppliers and securing sourcing readiness for news, moves, improves, launches, changes and market expansion.

Your home base will be a dedicated development team, while you also collaborate across development teams within your assigned segment. You will work closely with Range Areas, Category business teams, Regional Sourcing Specialists, Supply Chain and suppliers to align priorities, plan sourcing activities and follow up segment, sourcing and supplier-base performance.

In this role, you will:

    Lead sourcing and supplier capability input to product development and portfolio planning.
    Use supplier competence early to secure realistic product development, cost and availability preconditions.
    Provide sourcing expertise to development teams, decide on development suppliers and secure early supplier alignment and production feasibility.
    Evaluate sourcing alternatives, including strategic partnerships and simpler sourcing solutions where relevant.
    Secure implementation and on-time sales start together with business teams.
    Coordinate product development agreements and sourcing readiness for launches, changes and market expansion.
    Lead creation and implementation of segment sourcing strategies in line with Category Business Plans and Purchasing Development Plans.
    Identify supplier capability gaps, consolidation opportunities and sourcing setups that support speed, affordability and availability.
    Lead or coordinate RFQs, RFPs and RFIs together with Regional Sourcing Specialists when needed.
    Drive fact-based decisions through data, risk assessment, scenario planning and clear prioritisation.

Qualifications

We are looking for someone who:

    Has experience in product development, sourcing, purchasing development, supplier development or food sourcing.
    Understands the Food business context and how sourcing choices affect quality, food safety, speed, availability, affordability and growth.
    Has strong knowledge of sourcing strategy, supplier capability and sourcing implementation.
    Understands product development, portfolio planning and how sourcing input affects feasibility, cost and readiness.
    Has good understanding of supplier capability, materials, production techniques and sourcing alternatives.
    Uses supplier, cost, risk and performance data to create insight, assess scenarios and support clear decisions.
    Can influence and coordinate stakeholders across category, range and development, supply chain and supplier interfaces.
    Communicates clearly in English and can connect different perspectives into practical sourcing outcomes.

At IKEA, strong sourcing helps good ideas become affordable, sustainable and relevant food products for the many people. As Product Sourcing Leader in Food, your work will help us strengthen sourcing readiness, use supplier capability earlier and support faster product development from idea to implementation.

You will be part of strengthening the Food value chain by working close to colleagues across Purchasing Development, Category Area Food, Range Areas, regional sourcing teams and Supply Chain. Together, we reduce complexity, make sourcing choices clearer and create the conditions for better growth at lower cost.

To succeed in this role, we believe you are curious about how products, suppliers and the total Food value chain connect. You enjoy creating clarity when many needs meet, and you are comfortable making choices based on facts, risks and business priorities. You build trust through simple communication, good listening and close collaboration. You bring energy to development work and help others move forward with confidence.

Additional information

We encourage you to apply as soon as possible, as we might start interviewing early for certain roles. Due to high volumes, we have limited flexibility to reschedule, so please make sure to prioritize the interview if you are invited.

title: Rotor Dynamics and Vibration Engineer
description:
Job Description: Rotor Dynamics and Vibration Engineer



Join us as a Rotor Dynamics Engineer and help shape the next generation of gas turbines, heat pumps, and selected steam turbine applications. Your analysis and engineering judgement will directly influence product reliability, efficiency, and performance.



A Snapshot of Your Day



You will improve engineering methods, develop practical analysis tools, and turn complex rotor-dynamic challenges into better products. Working closely with experienced colleagues across several disciplines, you will contribute throughout the development cycle—from early concepts and simulation to testing and product support.



How You’ll Make an Impact



    Have responsibility over the design and evaluation of the rotor and stator structure of robust, reliable, and highly efficient turbomachinery engines by using in-house developed and commercial software.
    Be a part of the whole engine development process starting from the concept design of engines to the test evaluation and further behavior in the product’s life cycle.
    Be responsible to drive the innovation and technology within the field of rotor and structural dynamics.
    As part of a global organization, you will have the opportunity to build a network that expands across the world, from Europe to North America and Asia. On top of that, your multi-disciplinary collaborations will, for example, include Mechanical Design, Mechanical Integrity, Test department and Manufacturing.



What You Bring



    A master’s degree or PhD in mechanical engineering, aerospace engineering, engineering physics, or a related field.
    Knowledge of and a strong interest in structural dynamics.
    Experience in rotor dynamics is highly desirable.
    Knowledge of finite element analysis, mechanical integrity, mechanical design, tribology, or related areas is an advantage.
    Experience with engineering tools such as Abaqus, Simcenter 3D, MATLAB, Python, or equivalent software is beneficial.
    A proactive and committed approach to analysing and resolving technical challenges.
    The ability to work across disciplines, both independently and as part of a team, while contributing to effective and efficient delivery.
    Proficiency in English is required; Swedish is an advantage.



We welcome applicants ranging from early-career engineers to experienced specialists. This role provides opportunities to develop technical expertise, contribute to engineering methods and tools, and work with challenging dynamics problems across a broad range of products.



About the Team



You will join a diverse R&D group of 14 highly skilled engineers specializing in rotor dynamics and aeromechanics. We work closely together and bring a wide range of backgrounds and experience to the team. As part of an R&D organization of nearly 300 people, you will have access to a unique breadth of expertise as we work together to develop world-class gas turbines.

title: Geodata Engineer
description:
Geodata Engineer for Exploration Geodata Systems

Boliden is a high-tech metals company with its own mines and smelters that works long-term to guarantee society’s access to base and precious metals. For a century, our work has been part of the value chains that have shaped modern society. At Boliden, we know that the metals we mine and make available will continue to play a crucial role in the future. What matters is how we produce them. Become part of us and drive change for generations to come.

Your opportunity

Would you like to combine geoscience, data and technology to support the future of mineral exploration?

We are looking for an Exploration Geodata Specialist to help develop and maintain Boliden’s geoscientific data platform and support exploration teams across the organization. You will help ensure that Boliden’s geoscientific and exploration data remains reliable, accessible and useful over time. A key part of the assignment will be contributing to the implementation and further development of our new SQL-based geodata platform, QDB, across our exploration sites.

The position can be based at the Boliden office or at one of our sites, subject to agreement.

Who you will work with

You will be part of our Exploration Geodata team and collaborate with database geologists, geologists, geophysicists, GIS users, mine geologists, Boliden IT, the Assay & Data Quality group and Exploration management. You will also interact with software suppliers, consultants, developers and other technology partners.

This is a collaborative role where you will connect operational geoscience needs with practical and sustainable technical solutions.

What you will do

Your main responsibilities will include:

    Develop, improve and document SQL-based exploration database structures, views and validation logic
    Design workflows for geological, geophysical and spatial data
    Support the rollout and continued development of QDB
    Develop SQL scripts, import and export routines and automated workflows
    Integrate databases with GIS, modelling, reporting and analysis tools
    Support data quality, governance, QA/QC, metadata management and controlled access
    Translate the needs of geologists, geophysicists and Geodata users into practical system improvements
    Test new solutions and provide technical support, documentation and training material
    Collaborate with Geodata, Exploration, GIS users, IT and external suppliers
    Help ensure that exploration data is reliable, validated, traceable and accessible over time

What you bring

You enjoy working at the intersection of geoscience and technology. You approach complex information methodically and understand the importance of quality, traceability and long-term maintainability. You communicate clearly and can turn operational needs into practical technical solutions.

We believe you have

    A university degree or equivalent education in geology, geophysics, GIS, geodata management, database development, computer science or another relevant technical field
    Strong knowledge of SQL and relational databases
    A good understanding of geological or geophysical data, drillhole data and exploration workflows
    Practical experience with GIS and spatial data
    Programming or scripting skills
    The ability to develop, test and document database applications and automated workflows
    A structured, quality-focused and analytical approach
    Good written and spoken English
    Proficiency in the local language relevant to your workplace
    The ability to collaborate effectively with both technical specialists and operational users
    A valid European Category B driver’s license

It is an advantage if you have

    Experience integrating databases with GIS or geological modelling tools
    Experience with geodata management, exploration databases or geological and geophysical information
    Broad academic or professional experience covering both geoscience and data systems

We value potential and encourage you to apply even if you don’t tick all the boxes.

Why work with us

At Boliden, care, courage and responsibility are central to everything we do. We offer a collaborative workplace where your contribution can have a direct impact on future generations. You will have the opportunity to work with geoscientific information that supports exploration activities across Boliden and to shape systems and workflows designed for long-term value.

Apply today to be part of something truly meaningful!

At Boliden, diversity and inclusion are drivers of innovation. We know that different perspectives and experiences strengthen us and help us remain at the forefront of an important and exciting industry. We therefore encourage applications from people with diverse backgrounds and viewpoints. Together, we build a workplace where everyone can feel safe and inspired to reach their full potential.

Want to know more about the position? Contact hiring manager Monica Johansson, monica.johansson@boliden.com, +46 70 201 21 67.

Questions about the application are answered by our Talent Acquisition Partner, Terese Lindholm, terese.lindholm@boliden.com.

For union information, please contact Mats Lindblom, SACO, +46 73-350 04 19, Andreas Mårtensson, Unionen, +46 70-541 83 93 or Peter Markström, Ledarna, +46 910-77 40 09.

description:

Are you passionate about supply chain planning, inventory optimization, and cross-functional collaboration? Do you enjoy using data to solve business challenges and improve performance? We Are Looking For Someone Who Has

    Ability to prioritize and make decisions in a fast-paced environment
    Strong communication and stakeholder management skills

Language Requirements

title: Formulation & Laboratory Technician  Personal Care & Food Applications
description:
Background

Melt&Marble harness precision fermentation to create the next generation of sustainable designer fats, tailored for applications ranging from delicious, climate-friendly foods to high-performance personal care products.

We are expanding our team and looking to attract enthusiastic & mission-driven people to join us on our journey.



Position summary

We are looking for a hands-on and detail-oriented Formulation & Laboratory Technician to support our personal care and food product development activities.

In this role, you will support the development and application of our innovative ingredients by carrying out routine laboratory work, preparing cosmetic prototypes and customer samples, supporting stability and quality control activities, and maintaining an organised and well-functioning formulation laboratory.

The role is suited to someone who enjoys practical laboratory work and is comfortable working independently according to established procedures, while also being curious about formulation science, personal care and food applications.

Main Responsibilities & Tasks

Formulation activities

    Prepare cosmetic formulations and prototypes according to established formulations and laboratory procedures. This might require large-scale manufacturing at times.
    Support formulation experiments by preparing raw materials, samples and test batches.
    Support preparation of application prototypes for internal evaluation, customer demonstrations and technical activities.
    Support food formulation experiments when required, including preparation and testing of food prototypes according to established procedures.
    Initiate stability testing of in-house formulations, maintain stability sample storage and perform and document routine stability observations and measurements at defined timepoints according to internal SOPs.

Quality control support

    Perform routine QC checks on raw materials, intermediate materials and finished prototypes where applicable according to internal procedures.
    Support batch-to-batch comparison and reproducibility testing.
    Maintain accurate laboratory records and ensure traceability of samples and results.

Laboratory and inventory management

    Perform routine cleaning and maintenance of laboratory equipment and ensure equipment is ready for use.
    Monitor inventory of raw materials, packaging materials, consumables and laboratory supplies.
    Receive, label and appropriately store incoming raw materials and laboratory materials, together with technical documentation.
    Maintain sample and prototype storage, including appropriate identification and disposal of expired or obsolete samples.
    Follow laboratory safety, chemical handling, waste disposal and documentation procedures.

Documentation and data management

    Maintain accurate laboratory notebooks, batch records, sample logs and stability records.
    Enter routine laboratory results into established templates.
    Maintain traceability of formulations, raw materials, batches and customer samples.
    Identify and communicate deviations, unexpected observations or potential quality issues.

Collaboration

The role will work primarily with our Senior Product Application Scientist, and wider Product team, and may also provide laboratory support to food application activities when required.

You will primarily execute established laboratory procedures and experiments, while also contributing observations and practical insights that can support formulation development and troubleshooting.

As the role develops, there may be opportunities to take ownership of selected laboratory procedures, routine testing activities or specific application projects.

Who we are looking for

We are looking for someone who is:

    Hands-on and enjoys practical lab work.
    Highly organised and attentive to detail.
    Comfortable performing repetitive work accurately and consistently.
    Able to follow established procedures while recognising and reporting deviations.
    Reliable and able to work independently.
    Comfortable with accurate weighing, sample preparation and laboratory equipment.
    Interested in cosmetics, food formulation, formulation science, or biotechnology.
    Comfortable documenting experimental work and working with basic Excel or similar tools.
    A good communicator who is comfortable asking questions and raising potential issues.

Required qualifications

    Previous experience working in a laboratory environment.
    Experience with accurate weighing, sample preparation and laboratory documentation.
    Good organisational skills and attention to detail.
    Ability to work safely with chemicals and laboratory equipment.

Preferred qualifications

    BSc in chemistry, pharmacy, biotechnology, food science or a related field.
    Experience in cosmetic formulation, personal care, food, pharmaceutical or chemical laboratories.
    Experience with mixing, homogenisation, heating/cooling or other formulation processes.
    Experience with preparing food products, such as bakery products or confectionery.
    Affinity with and interest in food formulation and product development.
    Experience with stability testing or routine QC.
    Basic understanding of cosmetic formulations and raw materials.
    Experience with laboratory inventory or sample management.

What you will contribute

This role is key to maintaining an efficient and reliable laboratory operation, taking ownership of routine formulation, sample preparation, stability testing, QC and laboratory management activities, allowing the scientific team to focus on development, validation and customer-facing technical work

We offer:

    An innovative, interdisciplinary, and fun research environment where you can rapidly grow your skillset and advance in your career
    Unique opportunity to make meaningful contributions to innovative projects that address key global challenges
    Competitive remuneration, generous vacation package, and other benefits



Location: Gothenburg, Sweden.



Application procedure:

Please apply here- https://meltandmarble.recruitee.com/o/formulation-laboratory-technician-personal-care-food-applications

Applications should be in English and contain the following:

title: Digital Communications Officer (parental leave cover)
employer: Stift The Stockholm Environment Institute, Sei
description:
Are you an experienced digital communicator who understands how to turn science into stories that capture attention, spark curiosity, and inspire action? SEI is looking for a Digital Communications Editor to manage our global social media channels and help communicate our research and insights to diverse audiences.

Become part of our international non-profit research organization and help translate evidence into policy and practice on global environmental and development challenges. At Stockholm Environment Institute (SEI), you will be joining a world-leading research institute.

The role

The Digital Communications Editor is part of the Communications and Impact Division based at SEI Headquarters. This is a central role where you will support the global organization with curation, editing and writing for the website, social media channels and our monthly newsletter.

Your responsibilities will include managing SEI’s global social media platforms (LinkedIn, Bluesky, Facebook and YouTube) with a focus on user engagement, brand consistency and innovative content creation. You will act as an internal advisor, collaborating with different team members to ensure high-quality content that aligns with our mission and values. This role involves both content creation and curation, alongside implementing effective social media strategies to enhance our SEI’s digital visibility and reputation. You will use analytics and analysis to follow up and report on engagement and impact.

The role may also include supporting colleagues with web publishing on sei.org. You will lead on creating and sending SEI’s monthly newsletter.

Key duties and responsibilities

    Manage SEI’s global social media accounts, creating, editing and curating engaging content that draws on SEI research, organizational priorities and relevant external developments to reach and engage target audiences. This includes editing and scheduling colleagues’ posts in Buffer, creating posts for institutional news and daily community management.
    Manage and develop SEI’s monthly newsletter, including editorial planning, content selection, writing and editing, distribution, and ongoing optimization.
    Support website publishing ensuring content is accurate, accessible, well-structured according to house style and optimized for online audiences
    Coordinate global digital content workflows by working proactively and responsively with our global community of communications experts, managing requests via shared inboxes and Asana, to ensure digital content meets our quality and brand standards on our global digital channels.
    Ensure digital content meets SEI’s visual identity, accessibility, and editorial standards, applying relevant guidelines and identifying opportunities to improve the quality and accessibility of content.
    Collaborate with communications colleagues across SEI to develop content promotion plans, share good practices and strengthen coordination and learning across the global organization.
    Monitor, analyse, and report on digital performance, using analytics and audience insights to evaluate engagement and assess impact. Provide recommendations for improving content and channel performance.
    Prioritize requests and workload during peak periods, deciding what to publish and when.

Who you are

You will have a strong interest in sustainability and climate science and be passionate about the importance of communication to drive change. You should enjoy being part of a team, finding innovative solutions while working individually in a structured manner. You must have an eye for detail, be adept at working across digital communications platforms and be happy to juggle different priorities. You will enjoy working in an international setting with people from varied backgrounds and disciplines.

Formal qualifications and knowledge

    At least three years professional experience in digital communications, including social media, editing and web publishing.
    Track record of creating, editing and publishing quality digital content in English.
    Proven experience with web content management systems (ideally WordPress), scheduling tools such as Buffer, email marketing tools such as Mailchimp and project management tools such as Asana.
    Experience coordinating content with multiple contributors and managing projects.
    Skilled in analytics, monitoring, analysis and reporting, ideally in social media and for websites.
    Experience with content in climate, environment and/or development topics is a plus.
    Written and spoken fluency in English.
    Experience explaining complex or technical subjects in accessible formats for different audiences.

Required personal skills

    Effective communication and strong networking skills.
    Good organizational and time management abilities.
    Diplomatic approach and inclusive mindset.
    Have a service-minded attitude and the ability to balance conflicting priorities.
    Flexible, positive attitude and enjoy working with a collaborative team.

Our offer

At SEI HQ, we offer a stimulating position in an international environment. You will be part of a leading multinational, multidisciplinary and multilingual team of experts in an organization where the well-being and development of our employees is a high priority. We value diversity and creativity at the core of what we do. We welcome applicants from diverse backgrounds to apply. Our ambition is to provide a safe, professional and creative workspace for all.

Employment at SEI HQ includes:

    Collective agreement, including occupational pension and many other collectively agreed benefits.
    Annual healthcare contribution and additional benefits connected to promoting employee well-being such as yearly health check-ups.
    Flexible working hours, 37.5-hour work week and a generous number of vacation days.

Additional information

This is an eight-month temporary position at SEI HQ in Stockholm, Sweden. The start date is in December to allow a period of handover.

SEI has a hybrid work environment, which allows employees to share their time between the SEI office and working remotely from their homes in Sweden. As this is a short fixed-term contract, there is not enough time to complete a work permit process before the start date, so it is only open to candidates who already have the right to work in Sweden for the full contract period. Please note that it is not possible to work outside of Sweden.

title: Cashier-Stockholm-Södertälje
description:
Ria Money Transfer is a business arm of Euronet Worldwide, Inc. (NASDAQ: EEFT) and a leading financial services player. We offer fast, secure and affordable global money transfers to millions of customers worldwide. In addition to this, we also provide currency exchange services. With over 600,000 agents in almost 200 countries, our goal is to create opportunities for a better everyday life.

We believe in a world where everyone is empowered to shape the life they dream of, regardless of their background or location.

ABOUT THIS ROLE

Ria Financial Services is looking for a driven and service-oriented employee for the role of Sales Cashier/Store Employee. We are a global leader in money transfers and currency exchange with an extensive network of our own offices and branches.

This is a part-time position located in Stockholm and Södertälje, starting at the beginning of November. As a Sales Cashier/Store Employee, you will be a key part of our team and the face of our business. You will be responsible for delivering excellent customer service while contributing to our sales targets.



ROLES & RESPONSIBILITIES

    Carry out transactions for money transfers and currency exchange with high precision and efficiency.
    Actively engage customers to understand their needs and offer appropriate financial services.
    Provide personalized and professional service by answering questions and providing clear guidance.
    Manage cash flow carefully and ensure accurate accounting according to company guidelines.
    Help achieve and exceed sales goals by building trust and customer loyalty.
    Be flexible with working hours and be able to work evenings, weekends and holidays when needed.



We are looking for you who

    Has experience in sales and customer service (meritorious).
    Fluent in Swedish and English, with proficiency in a third language such as Ukrainian, Russian, Arabic, Mandingo ecc.
    Is self-motivated, goal-oriented and thrives in a dynamic work environment.
    Have a strong customer focus and the ability to create a positive experience for our customers.
    Has experience in cashier work and handling of cash (meritorious).
    Is flexible and can adapt to different tasks and shifts. Weekend work occurs.
    Have basic computer skills (Word, Excel).



PERKS & BENEFITS

    An exciting and dynamic work environment in an international company.
    Opportunity to develop in sales and financial services.
    An inclusive and multicultural team where we value diversity.

We look forward to hearing from you and welcoming you to our team at Ria Financial Services!

Please note that for security reasons, we request an extract from the criminal record before employment can be carried out.

Ria Money Transfer is an employer that promotes equal opportunities. We value diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive work environment for all employees.

Read more about us here: www.riamoneytransfer.com

title: Senior Android Developer
description:
Who are we?

Amaris Consulting is an independent technology consulting firm providing guidance and solutions to businesses. With more than 1,000 clients across the globe, we have been rolling out solutions in major projects since 2007 – this is made possible by an international team of 7,600 people spread across 5 continents and more than 60 countries. Our solutions focus on four different Business Lines: Information System & Digital, Telecom, Life Sciences and Engineering. We’re focused on building and nurturing a top talent community where all our team members can achieve their full potential.

At Amaris, we strive to provide our candidates with the best possible recruitment experience.

We like to get to know our candidates, challenge them, and be able to give them proper feedback as quickly as possible. Here's what our recruitment process looks like:

Brief Call: Our process typically begins with a brief virtual/phone conversation to get to know you! The objective? Learn about you, understand your motivations, and make sure we have the right job for you!

Interviews (the average number of interviews is 3 - the number may vary depending on the level of seniority required for the position). During the interviews, you will meet people from our team: your manager of course, but also other people related to your future role. We will talk in depth about you, your experience, and skills, but also about the position and what will be expected of you. Of course, you will also get to know Amaris Consulting: our culture, our roots, our teams, and your career opportunities!

Case study: Depending on the position, we may ask you to take a test. This could be a role play, a technical assessment, a problem-solving scenario, etc.

As every role is different, we adapt the process accordingly, always focusing on the best possible candidate experience. We look forward to meeting you!

Job description

Join Amaris Consulting as an Android Developer and contribute to a long-term project with our client in Gothenburg, within the Information System & Digital scope. You will join a product team developing and continuously improving a large-scale mobile application focused on digital customer journeys, purchasing flows, and user experience across several markets.

Your missions

    Develop native Android features using Kotlin and Android SDK.
    Build and improve mobile user interfaces with Jetpack Compose and XML-based UI development.
    Enhance digital customer journeys and purchasing flows within a large-scale mobile application.
    Integrate mobile features with APIs and backend services.
    Maintain and optimize existing Android application features to support performance, reliability, and scalability.
    Contribute to new development initiatives across several markets.
    Collaborate with cross-functional product and development teams in an agile environment.
    Analyse technical issues and implement corrective actions to improve the mobile application experience.

Your profile

    Several years of experience in native Android development.
    Experience working on large mobile applications with high user volumes.
    Strong knowledge of Kotlin and Android SDK.
    Experience with Jetpack Compose and XML-based UI development.
    Experience with API integrations and backend services.
    Experience with agile and cross-functional development environments.
    Experience with digital purchasing flows or similar user journeys is a plus.
    English fluent.
    Strong analytical mindset and attention to detail.
    Ability to collaborate effectively with product and technical teams in an international environment.

What we offer

    An international community bringing together 110+ different nationalities.
    An environment where trust has a central place: 70% of our key leaders started their careers at the first level of responsibilities.
    A robust training system with our internal Academy and 250+ available modules.
    A vibrant workplace that frequently gathers for internal events, including afterworks and team buildings.
    At Mantu, sustainability is part of everything we do. You’ll have the opportunity to turn your ideas into action and make a tangible impact. Every day, our teams bring our ESG commitments to life, from reducing our footprint to driving positive change within our communities. Through our WeCare Together program, you’ll be empowered to design and lead projects that create real social or environmental impact, with the company’s full support.

Amaris Consulting is proud to be an equal-opportunity workplace. We are committed to promoting diversity within the workforce and creating an inclusive working environment. For this purpose, we welcome applications from all qualified candidates regardless of gender, sexual orientation, race, ethnicity, beliefs, age, marital status, disability, or other characteristics.

title: Product Verification & Test Rig Engineer - the Workshop Suite
description:
Role Summary



This role is a part of TRATON Group R&D, located in Södertälje, Sweden



As a Product Verification & Test Rig Engineer, you will combine hands-on ownership of HIL and SIL test rigs with verification of the Workshop Suite (tWS) in physical trucks. You will ensure that the rigs are correctly built, configured, maintained and operational according to the needs of development and test teams. This includes installing and replacing ECUs and other rig-related hardware, performing software updates, configuring rigs and connected systems, and troubleshooting hardware, communication and integration issues. In addition to the rig responsibilities, you will verify tWS as a complete product in physical trucks, with particular focus on end-to-end quality, robustness, reliability and vehicle safety under realistic operating conditions.

Job Responsibilities



• Build, configure, commission and maintain HIL and SIL test rigs, including installation and replacement of ECUs and other rig-related hardware.



• Perform software updates and configure test rigs and connected systems with the required software, data and system settings, while maintaining documented software baselines and rig configurations.



• Troubleshoot rig hardware, communication interfaces and system integrations, and verify that HIL and SIL test rigs are operational and meet the agreed needs of development and test teams.



• Coordinate and administer rig-related work, including planning activities, prioritizing requests, following up on actions and aligning rig availability with the needs of development and test teams.



• Plan, design and execute end-to-end verification of tWS as a complete product in physical trucks, assessing its behavior and quality under realistic operating conditions.



• Assess the quality, robustness, stability, reliability and safety-related behavior of tWS; document deviations and support root cause investigations together with development teams.

Who You Are



You are a hands-on and experienced test engineer who enjoys combining practical rig engineering with structured product verification. You have at least 4 years of relevant professional experience in HIL/SIL test rig engineering, verification of software products in physical trucks, or closely related work.



• You have experience building, configuring, commissioning, maintaining and troubleshooting HIL and SIL test rigs, including ECU installation and replacement, software updates and configuration of connected systems.



• You understand vehicle electronic systems, ECU interactions, and the information exchange between the truck, ECUs, tWS and supporting systems. You can use this understanding to verify tWS as a complete product in a physical truck.



• You work systematically, take ownership and communicate clearly. You are comfortable collaborating across development and test teams, analyzing logs and system behavior, documenting rig configurations and deviations, and supporting technical issues through to resolution.



• You have at least a Class B driving license (preferable Class C)



Experience supporting shared HIL and SIL test rigs and using test and defect management tools such as JIRA or Zephyr is advantageous.



We welcome applicants from all backgrounds – your unique experience and perspectives is valuable to us.

This Is Us



You will join Content Enablement & Verification, where the Verification area is responsible for end-to-end testing of the Workshop Suite. Our work covers both functional and non-functional testing, quality assurance and verification of tWS as a complete product. We also provide test tools and HIL and SIL test rigs that support efficient development and verification across the organization. We work cross-functionally and support other teams with test capabilities, technical expertise and shared solutions. Our work environment is hands-on and driven by innovation and sustainability.



Within TRATON Group R&D, you are an important part of something bigger. Joining us means gaining access to the ins and outs of the entire transportation industry.  

TRATON Offers



We offer a dynamic and engaging workplace where collaboration, innovation, and continuous improvement are part of everyday life. You will be part of a strong team environment that encourages knowledge sharing and close cooperation across functions.



With a structured development plan and a wide range of training opportunities, TRATON Group R&D supports your professional growth both locally and internationally.



Benefits include access to our health center in Gröndal or a wellness allowance, bonus, flexible working hours, and company car leasing. We also arrange events for employees and their families, and for those living in Stockholm, convenient commuting is supported through direct Scania Job express buses to Södertälje.

Application



We look forward to receiving your application, consisting of your CV and kindly ask you not to share a cover letter to ensure an efficient and unbiased recruitment process for all parties.



Apply as soon as possible, no later than 2026-10-26. Screening will take place on an ongoing basis during the application period. Logical and personality tests may be used as part of the selection process, and a background check may be required for this role.



We look forward to your application!



This recruitment process is handled by Scania for TRATON Group R&D

title: Director New Nuclear
description:
Company Description

Vattenfall is one of Europe’s largest producers and retailers of electricity and heat. Our main markets are Sweden, Germany, the Netherlands, Denmark, and the UK. The Vattenfall Group has approximately 21 000 employees. We have been electrifying industries, powering homes and transforming life through innovation for more than 100 years.

Job Description

We are looking for a senior leader to head New Nuclear and play a key role in shaping Vattenfall’s strategic development in new nuclear. Together with a dedicated expert team, you will develop potential investment opportunities, provide strategic advice to senior management and manage a complex landscape of internal and external stakeholders.

The team, “New Nuclear”, is also responsible for activities linked to Vattenfall’s ownership of the company “Videberg kraft AB”. This entails support to Vattenfall’s Board representatives as well as internal and external stakeholder management.

Your tasks and responsibilities

    Lead the team of New Nuclear
    Support Vattenfall’s ownership interests in Videberg kraft AB, including support to Vattenfall’s Board representatives.
    Develop opportunities in the area of potential investments in new nuclear
    Build and manage relationships with authorities, municipalities, industry actors, strategic partners and other key stakeholders.
    Provide strategic advice and recommendations to senior management on new nuclear opportunities, risks and strategic choices.

Qualifications

    Extensive experience in large-scale industrial, infrastructure or energy-related business development, preferably involving greenfield investments or new establishments
    Proven experience of developing and evaluating major investment opportunities and contributing to senior investment decision-making
    Excellent communication skills and the ability to simplify complex topics and provide clear strategic recommendations
    Strong experience managing complex stakeholder landscapes involving senior management, authorities, municipalities, partners or other external stakeholders
    Experience of investment evaluation and investment decision making processes
    Experience from the nuclear industry and/or corporate governance and board-level environments is an advantage
    Fluency in Swedish and English, both written and spoken

Your profile

You are a confident and engaging leader who creates direction while giving experienced experts the space to contribute. You combine strategic thinking with a strong drive to move complex matters forward and take accountability for results.

You are comfortable navigating complex stakeholder landscapes and can build trust while standing firm in your own judgement when required. With strong communication skills and sound business judgement, you are able to simplify complex topics, prioritise what matters most and influence stakeholders at different levels of the organisation and externally.

Next to this you:

    live our Vattenfall values, open, active, positive and safe and challenges others to do the same.
    work in accordance with the Vattenfall LEADership expectations to ultimately ensure a performance culture.
    have a personal interest in developing your people and the teams you are part of and you strive for continuous development.
    are performance oriented, accountable and you both give and ask for feedback
    have a strong business acumen, commercial thinking and analytical skills and the ability to understand the details without losing sight of the big picture.
    view diversity & inclusion as a natural part of the daily business, contributing to business success and people engagement.

Additional Information

Our Offer

We offer a challenging and international work environment and the possibility to work with some of the best in the field. You will be working in interdisciplinary teams and you can always count on support from committed colleagues as ‘Ask and Share’ concept is essential for the way we work. We offer attractive employment conditions (smart working, flexible working hours and a good-work-life balance) and opportunities for personal and professional development. Click here for further information.  

Location Solna or Gothenburg. Ability and willingness to travel as required by the role.

We welcome your application in Swedish, no later than October 29,2026. We kindly request that you do not send applications by any means other than via our website as we cannot guarantee that we will be able to process applications that are not made via our website.

An executive assessment is normally part of the recruitment process. By applying you agree to the use of potentially already existing assessment reports and talent management data during the selection process.

For more information about the position, you are welcome to contact hiring manager, Daniel Nordgren, daniel.nordgren@vattenfall.com and for information about the recruitment process Executive recruiter Cecilia Wijkman, cecilia.wijkman@vattenfall.com.

Trade union representatives in Sweden: Marika Westman (Akademikerna), Anders Bohlin (Unionen), Christer Gustafsson (Ledarna) Robert Lönnqvist (SEKO) Thomas Rådeby (Unionen). To get in contact with the representatives, please call Vattenfall´s switchboard +46 8 739 50 00.

The security of Vattenfall and its employees is essential. For that reason, a pre-employment screening will be part of your recruitment process. The screening is based on the role you will fulfill within Vattenfall. Since Vattenfall is part of the Swedish critical infrastructure many of our positions are security classed. If this position is security classed the final candidate can be subject to a security vetting process, according to the Swedish legislation.

At Vattenfall we are convinced that diversity contributes to build a more profitable and attractive company and we strive to be a good role model regarding diversity. Vattenfall works actively for all employees to have the same opportunities and rights regardless of gender, ethnicity, age, transgender identity or expression, religion or other belief, disability or sexual orientation. Click here for further information.

We look forward to your application!

title: Workstream Lead  Source to Pay - 20126
description:
Veritaz is a leading IT staffing solutions provider in Sweden, committed to advancing individual careers and aiding employers in ensuring the perfect talent fit. With a proven track record of successful partnerships with top companies, we have rapidly grown our presence in the USA, Europe, and Sweden as a dependable and trusted resource within the IT industry.

Job Overview

Role Summary

An experienced Workstream Lead – Source to Pay (S2P) is required to support a large-scale ERP transformation based on SAP S/4HANA. The organization is implementing a harmonized global solution across multiple sites and business areas. Building on an initial pilot implementation, the assignment focuses on preparing and delivering the next rollout phase.

The Workstream Lead will hold overall responsibility for the S2P workstream, including its dependencies with other transformation areas. The role combines strategic direction with hands-on operational execution to ensure that business processes, system solutions and integrated legacy environments are aligned into a sustainable and effective target solution.

Key Responsibilities

    Lead the Source to Pay workstream throughout the next SAP S/4HANA rollout phase.
    Manage workstream scope, schedule, quality, risks, issues, resources and key dependencies.
    Coordinate activities across business stakeholders, IT teams, implementation partners and related workstreams.
    Ensure alignment between S2P business processes, SAP solutions, data requirements and integrated custom-built or legacy systems.
    Identify, assess and help resolve process, data and system gaps affecting the rollout.
    Drive stakeholder engagement, coordinate responsibilities and support key workstream decisions.
    Support change initiatives and promote harmonized ways of working across sites and business areas.
    Track workstream progress, follow up on milestones and contribute to realization of expected business benefits.
    Act as an ambassador for the new solution during rollout activities.

Technical Stack & Requirements

    Strong practical experience with SAP Sourcing and SAP Ariba implementations.
    Relevant experience with SAP S/4HANA-based ERP transformations and rollout delivery.
    Strong knowledge of Source to Pay processes and their organizational and system dependencies.
    Experience integrating ERP platforms with custom-built applications and legacy systems.
    Ability to manage cross-functional transformation dependencies involving business processes, data and system solutions.
    SAP S/4HANA certification is considered advantageous.

Qualifications & Experience

The successful candidate has a relevant academic degree in IT, Computer Science, Business Systems or a related discipline. Proven experience leading projects or workstreams within Source to Pay is required, along with a strong understanding of S2P processes, transformation challenges and organizational dependencies. Experience from manufacturing or another complex operational environment is advantageous. The role requires a confident, pragmatic and collaborative leader who can engage effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

title: Head of Engineering
description:
Every day, around 3,000 employees of RUAG and RUAG Real Estate make as significant contribution to the security of Switzerland. They ensure that the Swiss Armed Forces and other emergency and security organizations can comprehensibly carry out their tasks at all times.

Head of Engineering

80 \- 100

Wangen

**You can move it**

* You lead the Engineering division's day\-to\-day operations and ensure that agreed objectives are achieved.
* You are responsible for the development of products – particularly software – and services in close collaboration with the relevant departments.
* You support the acquisition of new business opportunities by providing technical solutions and well\-founded cost calculations.
* You ensure that delivery deadlines, budgets and quality standards are met.
* You plan and manage the required personnel and technical resources.
* You ensure compliance with the division's quality and safety standards, as well as internal and external requirements.
* You promote Business Excellence, continuous improvement (CIP) and the further development of the operational system.


**What you should bring with you**

* Leadership experience: Proven experience in managing a division, including operational leadership and the implementation of divisional objectives.
* Technology and industry expertise: Understanding of sensor technology and reconnaissance systems; knowledge of radar systems is an advantage. Familiarity with the Swiss defence and security sector is beneficial.
* Financial expertise: Experience in cost centre responsibility and financial management.
* Communication skills: Strong communication and negotiation skills when dealing with customers, partners and internal stakeholders.
* Languages: Excellent German and English skills; French is an advantage.
* Education: A degree in engineering, information and communication technology, or an equivalent qualification.


Do you not fully meet all the requirements? Apply anyway. We are always looking for talented and motivated people to join our team. We place great emphasis on diversity and equal opportunities and aim to build a versatile team where everyone can fully utilize their personal strengths. In particular, we encourage all people, regardless of gender, who may have concerns about accepting a position in a military\-related environment to apply.

**About the field of activity**

The Engineering division within the Sensors \& Electronic Warfare Business Segment is responsible for the technical advancement and innovation of our solutions. Working closely with internal and external partners, the division identifies customer needs, drives research and development projects, and supports the implementation of the business segment's strategic objectives. The focus is on technical excellence, forward\-looking solutions and the sustainable fulfilment of customer requirements.

**Your advantages**

**Salary and fringe benefits**

It is very important to us that our employees find a healthy balance between their professional and private lives. This is why, among other things, we offer flexible working hours and options for working from home.

We offer you a performance\-oriented salary in line with the market, 13 months' wages as well as generous premiums and bonuses. Together with additional fringe benefits this makes for an attractive overall package.

**Flexible work**

**Benefits**

At RUAG, you benefit from discounts on transportation and meals. You can also take advantage of attractive offers on our benefits portal and receive fleet discounts from a number of well\-known car brands.

**Career and development opportunities**

We are committed to developing and realizing the potential of our employees. For this reason, we support them in continuously expanding their skills through training, courses and further education so they can achieve their professional goals.

**Leisure activities**

We care about our employees. That is why we give them a day off for their birthday, offer a wide range of sports activities and the opportunity to take additional days off with a pay deduction in addition to their annual vacation entitlement.

Lars Thomann

Talent Acquisition Specialist

* Assemblaggio e cablaggio di quadri elettrici industriali secondo schemi elettrici e specifiche tecniche
* Montaggio di componenti elettrici ed elettromeccanici all'interno dei quadri
* Realizzazione e collegamento dei cablaggi elettrici e dei circuiti di comando e potenza

* Esperienza pregressa nel montaggio e cablaggio di quadri elettrici industriali

* Conoscenza delle normative di sicurezza elettrica e delle 5 regole di sicurezza SUVA
* Buona dimestichezza nell'utilizzo degli strumenti di misura elettrici

* Buona conoscenza della lingua italiana
* Familiarità con i sistemi informatici e con i principali pacchetti Microsoft Office
* Disponibilità al lavoro su turni
* Propensione alla crescita professionale e all'acquisizione di nuove competenze

description:
- Eine etablierte Institution in der Region Muri sucht Verstärkung: Sie als Dipl. Pflegefachfrau/-mann HF/FH, Schwerpunkt Leitung Tageszentrum.

### Dipl. Pflegefachfrau/-mann HF/FH in Muri: das Wichtigste in Kürze

**Position:** Dipl. Pflegefachfrau/-mann HF/FH

**Arbeitgeber:** Den Namen nennen wir Ihnen gerne im Gespräch

Kurz gesagt: Der Rahmen stimmt. Zudem lernen Sie nun den Arbeitsort besser kennen, denn genau darum geht es als Nächstes.

Muri liegt im mittleren Aargau und besticht durch eine ausgezeichnete Verkehrsanbindung mit direktem Bahnanschluss sowie guter Autobahnanbindung. Sie profitieren von der Nähe zur Limmatlinie, die schnelle Verbindungen nach Zürich und Baden ermöglicht. Die Region bietet Ihnen ein attraktives Arbeitsumfeld mit stabiler Infrastruktur, guter Erreichbarkeit und angenehmen Lebensqualität in direkter Nähe zu Wäldern und Naherholungsgebieten.

### So sieht Ihr Alltag als Pflegefachfrau HF/FH Leitung Tageszentrum in Muri aus

- Sie tragen dabei die Verantwortung über den ganzen Pflegeprozess, von der Erhebung bis zur Auswertung
- Zudem: Durchführung ärztlicher Verordnungen sowie sichere Abgabe der Medikamente
- Zudem überwachen Sie die Vitalzeichen, denn Sie erkennen früh, wenn sich etwas ändert
- Darüber hinaus leiten Sie FaGe, Pflegeassistenz sowie Lernende fachlich an
- Ausserdem lückenlose Pflegedokumentation im elektronischen System
- Zusammenarbeit mit Ärzteschaft, Therapien sowie Angehörigen auf Augenhöhe

### Was Sie für diese Stelle mitbringen

- Zuerst das Fachliche: die Ausbildung als dipl. Pflegefachfrau/-mann HF oder FH
- Bei ausländischem Diplom: SRK-Anerkennung zwingend erforderlich
- Zudem Erfahrung in der Langzeitpflege, Akutpflege oder Reha
- Vor allem Verantwortung, Empathie sowie eine belastbare, ruhige Art
- Dazu sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift (mind. B2)

### Ihr Arbeitsumfeld: Leitung Tageszentrum

Sie arbeiten in einem psychiatrischen Umfeld. Beziehung ist hier das wichtigste Werkzeug: Sie begleiten Menschen in Krisen, geben Halt und arbeiten mit klaren Strukturen. Zudem sind Deeskalation und der geschulte Blick für Veränderungen Teil Ihres Alltags – ein Fachbereich, der viel gibt.

Kurz gesagt: Als Pflegefachfrau HF/FH Leitung Tageszentrum in Muri verbinden Sie Fachlichkeit mit einem Umfeld, das zu Ihnen passt. Darum lohnt sich diese Stelle doppelt.

### Der Beruf im Detail: Was macht eine diplomierte Pflegefachperson HF/FH?

Diplomierte Pflegefachpersonen HF/FH tragen die fachliche Verantwortung im gesamten Pflegeprozess. Sie erheben den Pflegebedarf, danach planen Sie die Massnahmen und werten die Ergebnisse aus. Zudem steuern Sie die Abgabe der Medikamente, überwachen Vitalzeichen und erkennen Veränderungen früh. Somit entsteht Pflegequalität, die ankommt.

Der Weg in diesen Beruf führt über die höhere Fachschule (HF) oder das Bachelorstudium Pflege (FH). Ausländische Diplome brauchen dafür eine [Anerkennung durch das Schweizerische Rote Kreuz (SRK)](https://www.redcross.ch/de/srk-anerkennung). Ausserdem stehen erfahrenen Fachpersonen viele Wege offen: ein Nachdiplomstudium (NDS), die Rolle als Berufsbildnerin oder die Teamleitung.

Die Region Muri verzeichnet eine anhaltend hohe Nachfrage nach qualifizierten Pflegefachpersonen mit Leitungserfahrung, da Tagesbetreuungseinrichtungen kontinuierlich expandieren. Als Diplom-Pflegefachfrau oder -mann HF/FH mit Leitungskompetenz finden Sie ausgezeichnete Chancen auf dem Arbeitsmarkt, da Ihr Profil gesucht und gut bezahlt ist. iPersonal erleichtert Ihnen als spezialisierter Personalvermittler den Einstieg erheblich, indem wir Sie gezielt mit passenden Arbeitgebern in Ihrer Region verbinden und den gesamten Bewerbungsprozess professionell begleiten.

- Gratis-Weiterbildungen dank [Temptraining](https://temptraining.ch) – somit bekommt Ihre Karriere Rückenwind

- Und vor allem: Diskretion garantiert – Ihre Bewerbung behandeln wir streng vertraulich

### Häufige Fragen zur Stelle als Pflegefachfrau HF/FH Leitung Tageszentrum in Muri

**Welche Ausbildung brauche ich für diese Stelle?**
Dafür benötigen Sie ein Diplom als Pflegefachfrau/-mann HF oder aber einen Bachelor in Pflege FH. Ausländische Abschlüsse sind mit SRK-Anerkennung ebenso willkommen.

**Ist mein ausländisches Pflegediplom in der Schweiz gültig?**
Ja, sofern das Schweizerische Rote Kreuz (SRK) Ihr Diplom anerkannt hat. Ausserdem beraten wir Sie gerne kostenlos zur Anerkennung.

**Wie schnell erhalte ich eine Rückmeldung auf meine Bewerbung?**
In der Regel melden wir uns bereits innerhalb von 24 Stunden bei Ihnen, denn Ihre Zeit ist wertvoll. Zudem halten wir Sie danach laufend auf dem neusten Stand.

**Erfahre ich den Namen des Arbeitgebers?**
