Global Customer Experience Manager
==================================

An international Customer Experience role focused on shaping and optimising end\-to\-end customer journeys through data\-driven insights, strategic initiatives, and close collaboration with business and digital teams. The position offers the opportunity to influence customer\-centric transformation projects with high visibility across the organisation.

Global Customer Experience Manager
==================================

Prestigious international Insurance company

**Description**

In this role, you will help translate the organisation's customer experience strategy into practical initiatives and tangible improvements for customers and business teams. Working across regions and functions, you will support the design, delivery and scaling of customer\-centric solutions that drive measurable business and customer outcomes.

You will collaborate with business units, customer teams and technology partners to identify opportunities, optimise customer journeys and promote customer experience best practices across the organisation. Success will be measured through contributions to growth, customer loyalty, operational efficiency and the adoption of customer\-centric standards.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Customer Insight \& Analysis**

* Leverage customer research, journey analytics and business data to support the development of personas, customer journeys and experience improvement opportunities across key touchpoints.


**Customer Journey Improvement**

* Partner with business units to enhance customer experiences across critical journeys by identifying pain points, developing recommendations, supporting roadmap planning and tracking progress against customer and business objectives.
* Support the execution of the organisation's customer experience strategy, translating strategic priorities into actionable initiatives and customer\-focused improvements.


**Solution Delivery**

* Collaborate with UX/UI designers, service designers, product teams and technology partners to deliver customer\-centric solutions aligned with defined customer experience standards.
* Contribute to the development of digital experience strategies through customer research, stakeholder engagement, workshops and the definition of future experience requirements, capabilities and success metrics.


**Platforms \& Enablers**

* Support the coordination of customer experience capabilities across digital platforms, including CRM, analytics, experimentation, accessibility and AI\-driven solutions, based on business priorities.


**Stakeholder Collaboration**

* Build strong relationships with customer teams, technology functions, business stakeholders and external partners to support the successful delivery of customer experience initiatives and transformation programmes.

**Profile**

* Bachelor's or master's degree in design, digital, marketing, business or a related field.
* Around 3 years of relevant experience in customer experience, service design, digital product or consulting. Exposure to international or multi\-market environments is a plus.
* Experience contributing to customer journey or digital experience work, having been
* part of initiatives that moved from research through to delivery.
* Working knowledge of user research, journey mapping and design thinking, with familiarity with service design and human\-centred design principles.
* Comfort working with data, using customer research, journey analytics and business metrics to frame problems and support recommendations.
* Business awareness, with an interest in connecting CX work to tangible business outcomes and the ability to explain why an initiative matters to non\-CX stakeholders.
* Familiarity with digital experience platforms (content management, CRM, customer data, analytics and experimentation tooling). Understanding what these capabilities enable matters more than expertise in any specific vendor product.
* Strong collaboration and communication skills, able to work across departments (IT, marketing, local markets, business teams) and to explain complex topics clearly to both technical and non\-technical audiences.
* A pragmatic, solution\-oriented mindset, comfortable in a fast\-moving environment with shifting priorities and willing to work outside established processes when needed.
* A learning mindset, keen to pick up new methods, tools and ways of working quickly.
* Fluent in English; other languages are an asset.


**Nice to have:**

* Experience in insurance, financial services or another regulated industry.


* Familiarity with accessibility standards (WCAG) and inclusive design practices.
* Exposure to AI\-enabled customer experience use cases.


* Experience contributing to web or digital platform strategy work.

Interested?

HSE Manager
===========

### description:

**We are looking for an experienced HSE Manager to take ownership of Health, Safety and Environmental activities at an established industrial and logistics site in Hinwil. In this role, you will drive a strong safety culture, ensure compliance with Swiss regulations and international ISO standards, and work closely with site management to continuously improve HSE performance.**

### About the customer:

* **Location: Hinwil, Zurich**
* **Start: 2 November 2026**
* **Duration: Until 30 2027 with a possible extension or internalization**
* **Workload: 80–100%**
* **Working hours: 42 hours per week (100%)**


### Requirements:

You will be the key HSE expert on\-site, responsible for implementing and continuously improving Health, Safety and Environmental standards. Working closely with site leadership and various departments, you will ensure a safe, compliant and environmentally responsible working environment.

HSE Strategy \& Management Systems

* Lead the implementation and continuous improvement of the Integrated Management System (IMS), aligned with ISO 14001, ISO 45001 and ISO 9001\.
* Implement Group HSE policies and develop a site\-specific HSE roadmap addressing key risks and improvement opportunities.
* Define, monitor and report on HSE objectives, KPIs and improvement initiatives.


Health, Safety \& Risk Management

* Lead workplace risk assessments, inspections and preventive safety initiatives.
* Identify hazards, implement risk mitigation measures and monitor their effectiveness.
* Ensure safe working procedures, including contractor safety and coordination of simultaneous activities.
* Investigate incidents and accidents, conduct root cause analyses and ensure corrective and preventive actions are implemented.
* Take immediate action, including stopping activities, in situations involving serious or imminent danger.


Environmental Management \& Compliance

* Ensure compliance with Swiss HSE legislation and applicable ISO 14001 and ISO 45001 requirements.
* Monitor regulatory developments, identify compliance gaps and coordinate corrective actions.
* Act as the main contact for relevant authorities, including SUVA, labour inspectorates and environmental authorities.
* Oversee environmental assessments and reporting related to waste, emissions and energy consumption.


Audits, Training \& Emergency Preparedness

* Coordinate internal and external HSE audits, including ISO certification audits, and ensure timely closure of findings.
* Develop and implement HSE training plans, deliver training sessions and promote safety awareness across the site.
* Establish and maintain emergency response plans, organise drills and support management during critical incidents.


Leadership \& Cross\-Functional Collaboration

* Act as a trusted HSE advisor to the Site Manager and other department leaders.
* Guide and support line managers in fulfilling their HSE responsibilities.
* Coordinate on\-site HSE contact persons and collaborate with Legal, HR, Facilities and other departments.
* Contribute to Group HSE initiatives, share best practices and ensure accurate reporting and escalation of critical issues.


### Competences:

* 5–8 years of professional experience in HSE Management, ideally within an industrial, manufacturing or logistics environment.
* Strong practical knowledge of ISO 14001 and ISO 45001, including implementation, compliance and audit processes. Familiarity with ISO 9001 and integrated management systems.
* ASA certification is mandatory, together with relevant ISO 14001 and ISO 45001 qualifications.
* Solid understanding of Swiss occupational health, safety and environmental regulations, including interaction with regulatory authorities.
* Proven experience in risk assessments, incident investigations, corrective actions and continuous improvement.
* Strong communication, organisational and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence and support teams at different levels.
* A proactive, hands\-on approach with the confidence to take ownership and drive a positive safety culture.
* Fluent (negotiation level) and very good English communication skills.

### Ihr Arbeitsumfeld: Langzeitpflege

Die Langzeitpflege lebt von Beziehung: Sie begleiten Menschen über lange Zeit, kennen ihre Gewohnheiten und bauen echtes Vertrauen auf. Dabei begleiten Sie auch komplexe, chronische Verläufe – mit Ruhe und Kontinuität statt Hektik.

Als diplomierte Pflegefachperson HF/FH tragen Sie die fachliche Verantwortung über den ganzen Pflegeprozess. Sie erheben den Pflegebedarf, danach planen Sie die Massnahmen und werten die Ergebnisse aus. Zudem steuern Sie die Abgabe der Medikamente, überwachen Vitalzeichen und erkennen Veränderungen früh. Somit entsteht Pflegequalität, die ankommt.

Der Weg in diesen Beruf führt über die höhere Fachschule (HF) oder das Bachelorstudium Pflege (FH). Ausländische Diplome brauchen dafür eine [Anerkennung durch das Schweizerische Rote Kreuz (SRK)](https://www.redcross.ch/de/srk-anerkennung). Ausserdem stehen erfahrenen Fachpersonen viele Wege offen: ein Nachdiplomstudium (NDS), die Rolle als Berufsbildnerin oder die Teamleitung.

Dafür benötigen Sie ein Diplom als Pflegefachfrau/-mann HF oder aber einen Bachelor in Pflege FH. Ausländische Abschlüsse sind mit SRK-Anerkennung ebenso willkommen.

Dans le cadre d'un remplacement, nous recherchons un(e) physiothérapeute à 50\-60% pour assurer une prise en charge en physiothérapie générale pour le smois de novembre et décembre.

Vous assurez également le suivi régulier des progressions, la réévaluation des objectifs et l'ajustement des mesures de prise en charge selon les besoins.


En lien avec l'équipe pluridisciplinaire, vous contribuez à la coordination des soins et à la continuité de la prise en charge. Vous participez aux échanges cliniques, partagez vos observations et collaborez activement avec les différents intervenants afin de garantir une approche globale, pertinente et sécurisée pour chaque patient. Vous veillez en outre à la qualité de la documentation, à la traçabilité des actes réalisés et au respect des protocoles en vigueur.


Votre rôle implique également une attention constante à la relation patient. Vous savez instaurer un climat de confiance, expliquer vos interventions avec clarté et accompagner chaque personne avec empathie, professionnalisme et bienveillance. Vous contribuez ainsi à offrir une prise en charge de qualité, adaptée aux attentes et aux besoins spécifiques de chacun.

-----------------

Vous êtes titulaire d'un diplôme reconnu de physiothérapeute et disposez d'une autorisation d'exercer en Suisse ou êtes en mesure d'en justifier l'équivalence selon les exigences en vigueur. Vous savez prendre en charge une patientèle diverse avec rigueur, autonomie et sens de l'organisation. Votre capacité à analyser rapidement une situation clinique, à prioriser vos interventions et à adapter vos traitements en fonction des objectifs thérapeutiques constitue un atout essentiel. Vous maîtrisez les bases de la documentation professionnelle et savez travailler avec méthode dans le respect des standards de qualité et des règles de confidentialité.  

Sur le plan relationnel, vous êtes reconnu(e) pour votre écoute, votre empathie et votre capacité à instaurer une relation de confiance avec les patients. Vous faites preuve de flexibilité, de fiabilité et d'un excellent sens des responsabilités, des qualités indispensables pour assurer une prise en charge continue et de qualité dans le cadre d'un remplacement.  

Nous recherchons une personne dynamique, engagée et disponible rapidement, capable de s'intégrer efficacement dans une structure existante et de garantir une continuité de service irréprochable sur la période définie.

HSE Manager

HSE Manager
===========

### description:

**We are looking for an experienced HSE Manager to take ownership of Health, Safety and Environmental activities at an established industrial and logistics site in Hinwil. In this role, you will drive a strong safety culture, ensure compliance with Swiss regulations and international ISO standards, and work closely with site management to continuously improve HSE performance.**

### About the customer:

* **Location: Hinwil, Zurich**
* **Start: 2 November 2026**
* **Duration: Until 30 2027 with a possible extension or internalization**
* **Workload: 80–100%**
* **Working hours: 42 hours per week (100%)**


### Requirements:

You will be the key HSE expert on\-site, responsible for implementing and continuously improving Health, Safety and Environmental standards. Working closely with site leadership and various departments, you will ensure a safe, compliant and environmentally responsible working environment.

HSE Strategy \& Management Systems

* Lead the implementation and continuous improvement of the Integrated Management System (IMS), aligned with ISO 14001, ISO 45001 and ISO 9001\.
* Implement Group HSE policies and develop a site\-specific HSE roadmap addressing key risks and improvement opportunities.
* Define, monitor and report on HSE objectives, KPIs and improvement initiatives.


Health, Safety \& Risk Management

* Lead workplace risk assessments, inspections and preventive safety initiatives.
* Identify hazards, implement risk mitigation measures and monitor their effectiveness.
* Ensure safe working procedures, including contractor safety and coordination of simultaneous activities.
* Investigate incidents and accidents, conduct root cause analyses and ensure corrective and preventive actions are implemented.
* Take immediate action, including stopping activities, in situations involving serious or imminent danger.


Environmental Management \& Compliance

* Ensure compliance with Swiss HSE legislation and applicable ISO 14001 and ISO 45001 requirements.
* Monitor regulatory developments, identify compliance gaps and coordinate corrective actions.
* Act as the main contact for relevant authorities, including SUVA, labour inspectorates and environmental authorities.
* Oversee environmental assessments and reporting related to waste, emissions and energy consumption.


Audits, Training \& Emergency Preparedness

* Coordinate internal and external HSE audits, including ISO certification audits, and ensure timely closure of findings.
* Develop and implement HSE training plans, deliver training sessions and promote safety awareness across the site.
* Establish and maintain emergency response plans, organise drills and support management during critical incidents.


Leadership \& Cross\-Functional Collaboration

* Act as a trusted HSE advisor to the Site Manager and other department leaders.
* Guide and support line managers in fulfilling their HSE responsibilities.
* Coordinate on\-site HSE contact persons and collaborate with Legal, HR, Facilities and other departments.
* Contribute to Group HSE initiatives, share best practices and ensure accurate reporting and escalation of critical issues.


### Competences:

* 5–8 years of professional experience in HSE Management, ideally within an industrial, manufacturing or logistics environment.
* Strong practical knowledge of ISO 14001 and ISO 45001, including implementation, compliance and audit processes. Familiarity with ISO 9001 and integrated management systems.
* ASA certification is mandatory, together with relevant ISO 14001 and ISO 45001 qualifications.
* Solid understanding of Swiss occupational health, safety and environmental regulations, including interaction with regulatory authorities.
* Proven experience in risk assessments, incident investigations, corrective actions and continuous improvement.
* Strong communication, organisational and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence and support teams at different levels.
* A proactive, hands\-on approach with the confidence to take ownership and drive a positive safety culture.
* Fluent (negotiation level) and very good English communication skills.

HSE Manager

Job description:

**We are looking for an experienced HSE Manager to take ownership of Health, Safety and Environmental activities at an established industrial and logistics site in Hinwil. In this role, you will drive a strong safety culture, ensure compliance with Swiss regulations and international ISO standards, and work closely with site management to continuously improve HSE performance.**

About the customer:

* **Location: Hinwil, Zurich**
* **Start: 2 November 2026**
* **Duration: Until 30 April 2027 with a possible extension or internalization**
* **Workload: 80–100%**
* **Working hours: 42 hours per week (100%)**


Requirements:

You will be the key HSE expert on\-site, responsible for implementing and continuously improving Health, Safety and Environmental standards. Working closely with site leadership and various departments, you will ensure a safe, compliant and environmentally responsible working environment.

HSE Strategy \& Management Systems

* Lead the implementation and continuous improvement of the Integrated Management System (IMS), aligned with ISO 14001, ISO 45001 and ISO 9001\.
* Implement Group HSE policies and develop a site\-specific HSE roadmap addressing key risks and improvement opportunities.
* Define, monitor and report on HSE objectives, KPIs and improvement initiatives.


Health, Safety \& Risk Management

* Lead workplace risk assessments, inspections and preventive safety initiatives.
* Identify hazards, implement risk mitigation measures and monitor their effectiveness.
* Ensure safe working procedures, including contractor safety and coordination of simultaneous activities.
* Investigate incidents and accidents, conduct root cause analyses and ensure corrective and preventive actions are implemented.
* Take immediate action, including stopping activities, in situations involving serious or imminent danger.


Environmental Management \& Compliance

* Ensure compliance with Swiss HSE legislation and applicable ISO 14001 and ISO 45001 requirements.
* Monitor regulatory developments, identify compliance gaps and coordinate corrective actions.
* Act as the main contact for relevant authorities, including SUVA, labour inspectorates and environmental authorities.
* Oversee environmental assessments and reporting related to waste, emissions and energy consumption.


Audits, Training \& Emergency Preparedness

* Coordinate internal and external HSE audits, including ISO certification audits, and ensure timely closure of findings.
* Develop and implement HSE training plans, deliver training sessions and promote safety awareness across the site.
* Establish and maintain emergency response plans, organise drills and support management during critical incidents.


Leadership \& Cross\-Functional Collaboration

* Act as a trusted HSE advisor to the Site Manager and other department leaders.
* Guide and support line managers in fulfilling their HSE responsibilities.
* Coordinate on\-site HSE contact persons and collaborate with Legal, HR, Facilities and other departments.
* Contribute to Group HSE initiatives, share best practices and ensure accurate reporting and escalation of critical issues.

* Strong practical knowledge of ISO 14001 and ISO 45001, including implementation, compliance and audit processes. Familiarity with ISO 9001 and integrated management systems.

* Solid understanding of Swiss occupational health, safety and environmental regulations, including interaction with regulatory authorities.
* Proven experience in risk assessments, incident investigations, corrective actions and continuous improvement.
* Strong communication, organisational and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence and support teams at different levels.
* A proactive, hands\-on approach with the confidence to take ownership and drive a positive safety culture.
* Fluent German (negotiation level) and very good English communication skills.

🌟 Stellenangebot: Medizinisch-technische/r Radiologieassistent/in (MTR / MTRA) - Basel, Schweiz

Ihre Perspektive in Basel
Möchten Sie Ihre Fachkompetenz in einem hochmodernen medizinischen Umfeld einbringen und von den attraktiven Rahmenbedingungen des Schweizer Gesundheitswesens profitieren?
Im Auftrag einer renommierten Radiologie-Praxis bzw. Klinik im Raum Basel suchen wir eine engagierte Persönlichkeit mit ausgeprägter Expertise im Bereich der Mammographie sowie Vielseitigkeit in der allgemeinen Bildgebung.
Ihre Aufgaben
Schwerpunkt Mammographie: Eigenverantwortliche und empathische Durchführung von Mammographien auf höchstem technischem Niveau sowie Betreuung der Patientinnen während des gesamten Untersuchungsablaufs.
Allgemeine Radiologische Diagnostik: Kompetente Durchführung von Routine- und Spezialuntersuchungen in den Bereichen Röntgen, Computertomographie (CT) und Magnetresonanztomographie (MRT).
Prozess- & Qualitätsmanagement: Einhaltung und Sicherstellung höchster Qualitäts-, Strahlenschutz- und Hygienestandards.
Patientenorientierung: Professionelle, einfühlsame Vorbereitung und Betreuung der Patienten in einer vertrauensvollen Atmosphäre.
Das bringen Sie mit
Ausbildung: Erfolgreich abgeschlossene Ausbildung als MTR / MTRA (Medizinisch-technische/r Radiologieassistent/in) oder eine vergleichbare, in der Schweiz anerkannte Qualifikation.
Fachkompetenz: Nachweisbare, vertiefte Erfahrung und hohe Routine in der Mammographie.
Vielseitigkeit: Gute Praxiskenntnisse und Sicherheit im Umgang mit Geräten der Sparten Röntgen, CT und MRT.
Persönlichkeit: Hohe Sozialkompetenz, Empathie im Umgang mit Patienten sowie eine zuverlässige, selbstständige und teamorientierte Arbeitsweise.
Sprachkenntnisse: Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift.
Das erwartet Sie
Attraktive Vergütung: Schweizer Gehaltsstandard inklusive hervorragender Sozialleistungen und Vorsorgekonzepte.
Modernste Technologie: Arbeiten mit Geräten der neuesten Generation in einem dynamischen und professionellen Team.
Umfassender Relocation-Support: Als Deutsch-Schweizer Vermittlungsverbund begleiten wir Sie persönlich beim Übergang nach Basel (Anerkennung der Diplome, Behördengänge, Wohnungssuche, steuerliche Orientierung).
Work-Life-Balance: Geregelte Arbeitszeiten, planbare Schichten und die hohe Lebensqualität der Dreiländereck-Region Basel.
Haben wir Ihr Interesse geweckt?
Senden Sie Ihre vollständigen Bewerbungsunterlagen (Lebenslauf, Zeugnisse, Diplome) einfach per E-Mail an uns. Wir begleiten Sie diskret, kostenfrei und Schritt für Schritt auf Ihrem Weg zu Ihrer neuen Herausforderung in der Schweiz!

title: Leitende Ärztin, Leitender Arzt für Psychiatrie und Psychotherapie Region Bern (Facharzt/-ärztin - Psychiatrie und Psychotherapie)
description:
Die Psychiatrie des Spitals in der Region Bern bietet anspruchsvolle Arbeitsplätze für Ärztinnen und Ärzte, Psychologinnen und Psychologen mit der Möglichkeit zur persönlichen Weiterentwicklung mit Rücksicht auf die eigenen Ressourcen. In dem überschaubaren Betrieb prägt die Persönlichkeit jedes Mitarbeitenden die Art des Umgangs miteinander und der Zusammenarbeit. Individualität betrachten wir als Bereicherung. Die Klinik bietet Arbeitsplätze an zwei Standorten in der Berner Region und ist SIWF-anerkannt sowie eine zertifizierte Weiterbildungsstätte.

Zur Führung der Teams suchen wir per sofort oder nach Vereinbarung eine fachlich qualifizierte und engagierte Persönlichkeit als

Leitende Ärztin, Leitender Arzt für Psychiatrie und Psychotherapie für die Region Bern.

Bei dieser besonderen Vakanz erwartet Sie eine vielseitige und verantwortungsvolle Aufgabe mit vielen Gestaltungsmöglichkeiten und einer engen interprofessionellen Zusammenarbeit. Freuen Sie sich auf eine Arbeit in einer traumhaften alpinen Lage, die Ihnen zahlreiche attraktive Freizeitaktivitäten bietet.

Zuständigkeiten / Hauptaufgaben

- Die ärztliche Leitung des Bereichs, bestehend aus einer Kriseninterventionsstation, einer Tagesklinik und einem Ambulatorium in Absprache mit der Bereichsleitung
- Sie sind Verantwortlich für die Pflege aller psychiatrischen Angelegenheiten und bilden die Schnittstelle zwischen niedergelassenen Kolleginnen und Kollegen, der Somatik und anderen Kooperationspartnern.
- Zudem unterstützen Sie Ihre Kollegen, wobei Ihnen dabei kompetente und engagierte Teams zur Seite stehen, die sich auf Verstärkung freuen.
- Als Mitglied des Leitungsgremiums der Psychiatrie haben Sie die Möglichkeit, relevanten Einfluss auf die strategische Ausrichtung des Gesamtbetriebs zu nehmen.

Qualifikationen / Anforderungen

- Abgeschlossene Facharztweiterbildung für Psychiatrie und Psychotherapie sowie erfüllte Voraussetzungen für die MEBEKO-Anerkennungen (EU-Facharzttitel,
EU-Approbation und EU-Staatsbürgerschaft)
- Freude an interprofessioneller und interdisziplinärer Zusammenarbeit sowie an der Mitgestaltung und Weiterentwicklung des Behandlungs- und Therapieangebotes
- Sie leben eine sozialpsychiatrische, flexible, freundliche und dienstleistungsorientierte Grundhaltung
- Die MEBEKO-Anerkennungen müssen bei Stellenantritt nicht vorhanden sein, jedoch unmittelbar danach und mit unserer Unterstützung eingereicht werden.
- Stilsicheres Deutsch, resp. C1-Zertifikat

Leistungen der Anstellung

- Gehalt zwischen CHF 170.000 und 200.000 brutto pro Jahr bei Vollzeit, je nach Berufserfahrung, Aus- und Weiterbildung
- Aufbau und Leitung des psychiatrisch-psychotherapeutischen Ambulatoriums
- Mitgestaltung und konzeptionelle Weiterentwicklung des Zentrums für Psychiatrie und Psychotherapie
- Der Stellenantritt kann per sofort oder nach Vereinbarung erfolgen
- Einen freien Tag. Mitarbeitende aus allen Abteilungen können an einem Ski-, Velo-, Töff-, Wander-, Fun-, Weihnachtsmarkt- oder Kulturtag teilnehmen.
- Spitaleigene KITA
- Ein Team, das in einem innovativen Betrieb ein wertschätzendes Arbeitsklima lebt.
- Abwechslungsreiche und sehr selbständige Tätigkeit
- Regelmäßige Supervision, interne und externe Weiterbildung

Hilfe zum Start

Das Spital arbeitet in interprofessionellen und interdisziplinären Teams, um Menschen ganzheitlich – physisch und psychisch – zu behandeln. Die hohe Weiterempfehlungsrate zeugt vom großen Vertrauen in das Spital und seine Mitarbeitenden.

title: Gesundheits- und Krankenpfleger / Pflegefachperson (m/w/d) für Einrichtungen in den Schweizer Alpen (Gesundheits- und Krankenpfleger/in)
description:
Du wünschst dir bessere Arbeitsbedingungen, ein spürbar höheres Gehalt und die Berggipfel direkt vor der Haustür? Für verschiedene renommierte Akutkliniken, Rehabilitationseinrichtungen und Pflegezentren in den Schweizer Alpen suchen wir motivierte Pflegekräfte aus Deutschland und der EU.

Wir von SWISSMEDICAL sind dein persönliches Sprungbrett über die Grenze. Als spezialisierter Partner begleiten wir dich Schritt für Schritt bei deinem Wechsel in die Schweiz. Wir vermitteln dich direkt in erstklassige Schweizer Gesundheitseinrichtungen – absolut kostenfrei und perfekt auf deine Wünsche abgestimmt.

**Einsatzbereiche:** Akutkliniken, Ambulatorien oder soziale Einrichtungen
**Ort:** Schweizer Alpen (z. B. Graubünden, Wallis, Berner Oberland)
**Anstellungsart:** Vollzeit (Festanstellung)

Gutes Gehalt, ein hervorragender Betreuungsschlüssel und die Alpen direkt vor der Haustür? Die Schweiz bietet dir genau die Wertschätzung und Lebensqualität, die du in deinem Pflegealltag oft vermisst.

„Weniger Stress, mehr Zeit für den Patienten und eine Lebensqualität, die ihresgleichen sucht. Der Wechsel in die Schweiz war die beste Entscheidung meines Lebens.“

- **Top-Vergütung:** Attraktives Jahresgehalt (ca. 75.000 bis 95.000 CHF je nach Erfahrung) mit im Vergleich zu Deutschland moderaten Steuerabzügen.
- **Entspannter Pflegealltag:** Ein deutlich besserer Pflegeschlüssel sorgt für mehr Zeit pro Patient und nachhaltig weniger Belastung im Schichtdienst.

- **Rundum-Sorglos-Relocation:** Volle Unterstützung bei der Diplom-Anerkennung (SRK), den Behördengängen für die Aufenthaltsbewilligung sowie der Wohnungssuche.
- **Moderne Arbeitsumgebung:** Erstklassig ausgestattete Häuser, strukturierte Einarbeitung und ein wertschätzendes, kollegiales Team.
- **Weiterbildung:** Großzügige Budgets und Freistellungen für deine berufliche Entwicklung.

Deine Aufgaben:

- Empathische und fachgerechte Grund- und Behandlungspflege in deinem Fachbereich.
- Planung, Durchführung und digitale Dokumentation der Pflegeprozesse.
- Konstruktive Zusammenarbeit im interdisziplinären Team aus Ärzten, Therapeuten und Pflegekräften.

Das bringst du mit:

- Freude am Beruf, hohe Fachkompetenz und Lust auf eine neue Herausforderung in den Schweizer Alpen.
- Eine abgeschlossene Ausbildung als Gesundheits- und Krankenpfleger, Krankenschwester oder Pflegefachkraft (m/w/d).

title: Oberarzt oder Leitender Facharzt (m/w/d) für Psychiatrie und Psychotherapie am Vierwaldstättersee (Facharzt/-ärztin - Psychiatrie und Psychotherapie)

title: Einrichtungsberater / Einrichtungsberaterin bei Möbel Märki in Hunzenschwil
description:
**Möbel Märki** ist das grösste, noch **echt schweizerische Einrichtungs\-Fachgeschäft** mit 6 Filialen in der Deutschschweiz. Wir beraten in der Ausstellung, bei den Kunden zu Hause und an den wichtigsten Publikumsmessen. Unser Motto heisst **«schöner Wohnen – besser Leben – das märki mir!».**

Wir suchen kontaktfreudige und begeisternde Persönlichkeiten, die auf Anhieb Sympathie ausstrahlen und erzeugen \- **Menschen, die sich bewusst sind, dass Verkaufen immer im Vordergrund steht**, entweder verkaufen wir eine Idee, uns selbst oder einen Gegenstand wie ein Möbel.

**Genau zuhören können und achtsam sein ist die Grundlage**, um im Dialog die Wohnsituation zu erfassen und für die Kunden ein neues Einrichtungs\-Konzept zu entwerfen. Die erfolgreichen Kundengespräche dauern eine Stunde oder länger. Dabei erarbeiten wir schrittweise die für den Kunden beste Lösung und treten elegant und mit Excellence auf. **Wir geben uns erst zufrieden, wenn auch unsere Kunden zufrieden sind.**

Um das breite Sortiment zu verstehen und die Einrichtungs\-Kompetenz zu erweitern, organisieren wir im Team wöchentlich **Erfahrungsaustausch und Schulungen**. Dort teilen wir auch unsere Planungs\-Ideen, um für unsere Kunden immer noch eine Lösung mehr zu kreieren. **Wir dienen und leisten gerne und sind immer bestrebt unsere persönlichen Fähigkeiten zu erweitern.**

Unsere Beratenden wünschen wir uns verbindlich und verlässlich, fleissig und fokussiert, humorvoll und mit einem frischen Auftreten. **Hohe Selbst\- und Sozialkompetenz setzen wir voraus.** Stilsicherheit, eine Affinität zu Design, Materialien und Farben und die Fähigkeit zu Präsentieren auch mit spontanen Handskizzen erleichtern einem den Alltag. Auch **Wiedereinsteigende und Teilzeitmitarbeitende (ab 60%) sind willkommen**, wobei der Samstag immer im Wochen\-Einsatzplan enthalten ist.

Wir bieten ein gutes Betriebsklima, **kleine Teams, selbständiges Arbeiten** und ein Provisions\-System, das überdurchschnittliche Leistungen entsprechend belohnt. Wir bieten gute Sozialleistungen und eine Pensionskasse mit Deckungsgrad über 120\.

Ihre **Bewerbung** richten Sie bitte **an Ilse Furter**. Wir freuen uns, wenn wir zusammenpassen und uns finden und den weiteren, beruflichen Weg gemeinsam gehen. **«Das märki mir!»**

Handwerker (m/w/d) Aufbau Jump Factory Zofingen
===============================================

### DAS SIND WIR

Jump Factory ist ein führendes Freizeitunternehmen, das an seinen Standorten in Basel, Wohlen und Biberist für Action und Abenteuer sorgt. Unsere Parks bieten eine Vielzahl an Attraktionen, darunter Trampolinparcours, Ninja\-Warrior\-Bereiche und Hochseilparks. Jetzt bauen wir unseren neuen Standort in Zofingen, und dafür suchen wir tatkräftige Unterstützung.



### DAS BIST DU

Du packst gerne an, arbeitest selbstständig und hast ein Auge für Details. Du möchtest beim Aufbau eines neuen Freizeitparks von Anfang an dabei sein und sorgst gemeinsam mit unserem Team dafür, dass unser neuer Standort termingerecht und in hoher Qualität fertig wird.



### DEINE AUFGABEN

1. **Aufbau \& Montage:** Du unterstützt beim Aufbau und bei der Installation unserer Attraktionen wie Trampoline, Ninja\-Parcours und Hochseilanlagen.
2. **Innenausbau \& Handwerksarbeiten:** Du übernimmst vielseitige Arbeiten im Innenausbau, zum Beispiel Holz\-, Metall\- und Montagearbeiten sowie kleinere Installationen.
3. **Zusammenarbeit mit Fremdfirmen:** Du arbeitest eng mit externen Firmen sowie mit unserem Technischen Leiter und dem Inhaber zusammen, koordinierst Arbeiten vor Ort und behältst den Baufortschritt im Blick.
4. **Qualität \& Sicherheit:** Du achtest auf die fachgerechte Ausführung aller Arbeiten, hältst Sicherheitsvorgaben ein und unterstützt bei der Abnahme der neuen Anlagen.
5. **Ordnung auf der Baustelle:** Du sorgst für eine saubere und sichere Baustelle sowie für Ordnung bei Material und Werkzeug.




### DAS BRINGST DU MIT

– Abgeschlossene handwerkliche Ausbildung (z. B. /in, /\-frau, Metallbauer/in, Monteur/in) oder vergleichbare Erfahrung

– Handwerkliches Geschick und technisches Verständnis

– Strukturierte und selbstständige Arbeitsweise

– Körperliche Belastbarkeit und Schwindelfreiheit

– Verantwortungsbewusstsein und Zuverlässigkeit

– Verfügbarkeit ab sofort für ein Pensum von 100 %

– Führerschein der Kategorie B (von Vorteil)



### DAS BIETEN WIR

– Ein spannendes Bauprojekt, bei dem du einen neuen Freizeitpark mitgestaltest

– Abwechslungsreiche Aufgaben in einem motivierten, unkomplizierten Team

– Einsatz ab sofort bis 31\. Dezember 2026, mit Option auf Verlängerung bei Projektverzögerung

title: Head of Engineering
description:
Every day, around 3,000 employees of RUAG and RUAG Real Estate make as significant contribution to the security of Switzerland. They ensure that the Swiss Armed Forces and other emergency and security organizations can comprehensibly carry out their tasks at all times.

Head of Engineering

80 \- 100

Wangen

**You can move it**

* You lead the Engineering division's day\-to\-day operations and ensure that agreed objectives are achieved.
* You are responsible for the development of products – particularly software – and services in close collaboration with the relevant departments.
* You support the acquisition of new business opportunities by providing technical solutions and well\-founded cost calculations.
* You ensure that delivery deadlines, budgets and quality standards are met.
* You plan and manage the required personnel and technical resources.
* You ensure compliance with the division's quality and safety standards, as well as internal and external requirements.
* You promote Business Excellence, continuous improvement (CIP) and the further development of the operational system.


**What you should bring with you**

* Leadership experience: Proven experience in managing a division, including operational leadership and the implementation of divisional objectives.
* Technology and industry expertise: Understanding of sensor technology and reconnaissance systems; knowledge of radar systems is an advantage. Familiarity with the Swiss defence and security sector is beneficial.
* Financial expertise: Experience in cost centre responsibility and financial management.
* Communication skills: Strong communication and negotiation skills when dealing with customers, partners and internal stakeholders.
* Languages: Excellent German and English skills; French is an advantage.
* Education: A degree in engineering, information and communication technology, or an equivalent qualification.


Do you not fully meet all the requirements? Apply anyway. We are always looking for talented and motivated people to join our team. We place great emphasis on diversity and equal opportunities and aim to build a versatile team where everyone can fully utilize their personal strengths. In particular, we encourage all people, regardless of gender, who may have concerns about accepting a position in a military\-related environment to apply.

**About the field of activity**

The Engineering division within the Sensors \& Electronic Warfare Business Segment is responsible for the technical advancement and innovation of our solutions. Working closely with internal and external partners, the division identifies customer needs, drives research and development projects, and supports the implementation of the business segment's strategic objectives. The focus is on technical excellence, forward\-looking solutions and the sustainable fulfilment of customer requirements.

**Your advantages**

**Salary and fringe benefits**

It is very important to us that our employees find a healthy balance between their professional and private lives. This is why, among other things, we offer flexible working hours and options for working from home.

We offer you a performance\-oriented salary in line with the market, 13 months' wages as well as generous premiums and bonuses. Together with additional fringe benefits this makes for an attractive overall package.

**Flexible work**

**Benefits**

At RUAG, you benefit from discounts on transportation and meals. You can also take advantage of attractive offers on our benefits portal and receive fleet discounts from a number of well\-known car brands.

**Career and development opportunities**

We are committed to developing and realizing the potential of our employees. For this reason, we support them in continuously expanding their skills through training, courses and further education so they can achieve their professional goals.

**Leisure activities**

We care about our employees. That is why we give them a day off for their birthday, offer a wide range of sports activities and the opportunity to take additional days off with a pay deduction in addition to their annual vacation entitlement.

title: Metzger:in 100%
description:
Der Zoo Basel, liebevoll «Zolli» genannt, ist eine grüne Oase mitten in der Stadt. In seiner einzigartigen Parklandschaft beherbergt er über 600 Tierarten aus allen Kontinenten. Wissenschaftlich geführt, schafft er Nähe zwischen Mensch und Tier, schützt bedrohte Tierarten und fördert die Biodiversität. Hier verbinden sich Erholung, Bildung, Forschung und Naturschutz zu einem Arbeitsumfeld für vielfältige sinnstiftende Aufgaben.

Metzger:in 100%

**Ihre Aufgaben**

Sie arbeiten in der Logistik des Zollis und eng mit den Mitarbeitenden der Tierpflege zusammen, um die optimale Versorgung der Zootiere sicherzustellen. Der Bereich verantwortet die Futterorganisation und \-zubereitung, die Mistabfuhr, die Mauszucht und die dazugehörige Logistik innerhalb des Zoos. Im Bereich der Metzgerei unterstützen und vertreten Sie den Metzger in seinen vielseitigen Tätigkeiten. Dazu gehören geplante wie auch Not\- Schlachtungen, Verarbeitung von Schlachttieren und die Bereitstellung von Fleisch und Fisch zur Verfütterung.

**Was Sie mitbringen**

Sie verfügen über eine abgeschlossene Lehre als Metzger:in resp. Fleischfachmann/\-frau EFZ Fachrichtung Gewinnung und konnten bereits einige Jahre Berufserfahrung sammeln. Eine Jagdausbildung sowie Jagderfahrung ist ein Vorteil. Sie sind teamfähig und verfügen über gute Sozialkompetenzen. Auch in hektischen Situationen bleiben Sie ruhig, arbeiten strukturiert, sehr sorgfältig und zuverlässig. Sie sind belastbar, haben eine rasche Auffassungsgabe und sind stets interessiert, Neues zu lernen. Sie haben sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse, Kenntnisse in Englisch\- und/oder Französisch sind von Vorteil.  

Sie arbeiten regelmässig an Wochenenden. Dank der langfristigen Einsatzplanung sind Ihre Arbeitseinsätze frühzeitig bekannt. Ein Wohnsitz in der Region Basel ist sehr erwünscht.

**Was wir Ihnen bieten**

Sie erwartet ein abwechslungsreicher Arbeitsplatz in einer aussergewöhnlichen Umgebung mitten in der Stadt Basel. Unsere gut ausgestattete Logistikbereich bieten Ihnen ein breites Tätigkeitsfeld, in dem Sie Ihre fachlichen Kenntnisse täglich einsetzen und weiterentwickeln können.  

Die Arbeit im Zoo bietet Ihnen zudem einen besonderen Einblick in das Zusammenspiel von Logistik, Tierhaltung und Besucherbetrieb. Um Ihre Sensibilität für die Arbeit im Bereich der Wildtiere zu stärken, erhalten Sie die Chance, einen Tierdienst zu erlernen.  

Freuen Sie sich auf einen nicht alltäglichen Arbeitsplatz mit abwechslungsreichen Aufgaben, viel Gestaltungsspielraum und einer faszinierenden Umgebung mitten in der Stadt Basel. Sie erhalten einen Einblick in einen modernen, wissenschaftlich geführten Zoo. Ein kollegiales und motiviertes Team an einem nicht alltäglichen Arbeitsplatz in einer faszinierenden Umgebung im Herzen der Stadt Basel freut sich auf Sie.

**Chief Executive Officer (CEO) – Asset \& Wealth Management (100%)**

Pfäffikon SZ, Switzerland

**About the Company**

We are an internationally focused Swiss asset management company based in the Canton of Schwyz. As an asset manager within the meaning of the Swiss Financial Institutions Act (FinIA), we provide our clients with asset management, financial advisory and related financial services.

We operate in an international environment and act both on our own account and on behalf of third parties. In doing so, we combine financial expertise with an entrepreneurial approach to identifying and developing investment opportunities.

As we enter the next phase of our corporate development, we are seeking an accomplished and internationally experienced Chief Executive Officer (CEO) to lead the company, strengthen the existing business and drive strategic expansion into new markets and investment sectors, with a primary focus on Life Sciences (particularly artificial intelligence) and international markets – with an emphasis on the United Kingdom, and Eastern Europe.

**Your Role**

As CEO, you will have overall responsibility for the strategic, operational and commercial development of the company. Working closely with the Board of Directors, shareholders and other senior stakeholders, you will define and implement the corporate strategy and lead the continued development of the company as an internationally focused Swiss asset manager.

You will combine strong leadership and investment expertise with entrepreneurial thinking, extensive transaction experience and a deep understanding of international financial markets.

**How You Will Contribute to Our Success**

\- Assume overall responsibility for the strategic, operational and commercial management of the company and translate its long\-term vision into measurable business objectives.

\- Identify, assess and develop new markets, with a focus on the United Kingdom, and Eastern Europe, as well as investment opportunities and strategic partnerships in the Life Sciences sector (particularly artificial intelligence).

\- Drive fundraising initiatives and further expand the company’s international investor and business network, particularly in the United Kingdom, and Eastern Europe, within the aforementioned financial sectors.

\- Lead and oversee investment activities across asset and portfolio management, corporate finance, M\&A, private equity and fundraising.

\- Lead, develop and support the management team and employees, while establishing a culture of excellence, accountability, integrity and entrepreneurial thinking.

**Requirements**

\- A university degree with excellent academic results from a **top\-tier university**in **Life Science Entrepreneurship**.

\- Strong industry knowledge and relevant professional experience **in Life Sciences and AI**, including the ability to assess companies, technologies, markets and investment opportunities in these sectors.

**\- Several years of international leadership experience in the financial sector**, ideally in asset or wealth management, investment management, private equity, corporate finance, investment banking or a comparable environment.

\- A proven track record in several of the following areas: **corporate finance and financial analysis, M\&A and transaction execution, fundraising, private equity, portfolio management and investment management, with a particular focus on Life Sciences (especially artificial intelligence)**.

\- A demonstrated ability to identify and develop new markets and business opportunities and to translate strategic opportunities into sustainable commercial growth – **preferably with leadership experience in and the United Kingdom**.

\- Excellent communication, representation and negotiation skills, together with the ability to build trusted relationships with boards of directors, shareholders, investors, clients and other senior stakeholders.

\- A high degree of integrity, discretion, resilience and sound judgement, including when handling confidential information and complex decisions.

**Languages: English and Russian**.

**Willingness to be based in Switzerland for this role**.

**What We Offer**

\- A top\-level executive position with overall responsibility for an internationally focused Swiss asset management company.

\- The opportunity to play a significant role in shaping the company’s strategic direction and to lead it through its next phase of growth and international development.

\- A central role in expanding the company’s activities in some of the most dynamic investment sectors, particularly Life Sciences (artificial intelligence).

\- A high degree of responsibility and autonomy in developing new markets, investment opportunities and strategic partnerships in the aforementioned area, particularly in the United Kingdom, and Eastern Europe.

\- Close collaboration with the Board of Directors, shareholders, investors and senior stakeholders across the Swiss and international financial ecosystem.

\- A professional, ethical and performance\-oriented working environment that encourages initiative, accountability and long\-term professional development.

Unser Herz schlägt türkis.

Head Client Lifecycle Integrity \- Director \- Member of Senior Management
==========================================================================



As part of its ongoing organisational evolution, Swissquote is creating a new department, theClient Lifecycle Integrity (CLI) Department. Acting as a1\.5 line of defence and independent from the Front Office, the CLI brings together key activities supporting the integrity\-related management of private client relationships throughout their lifecycle, from onboarding and periodic reviews to AML transaction monitoring.



In this context, the Head Client Lifecycle Integrity will play a key leadership role in shaping and implementing the new organisation. As a member of Senior Management and Director, the role is responsible for defining the CLI's strategic direction, establishing an effective and forward\-looking operating model, driving a culture ofcontinuous improvement and operational excellence and ensuring the successful integration and performance of its different activities, in compliance with all applicable laws, regulations and internal policies. The Head Client Lifecycle Integrity shall in particular have a strong focus on technology enablement, AI\-driven optimisation and operational scalability, with a strong client\-centric and data\-driven approach.



The Head Client Lifecycle Integrity will act as a senior partner to the Executive Management and work closely with the Front Office, Group foreign entities, the Compliance Department as well as technology functions to continuously enhance the Bank's integrity\-related client lifecycle framework.







  **Key responsibilities:**



**1\. Leadership, Governance \& Stakeholder Management**



* Lead the CLI, defining its strategy, organisation, governance and priorities, and establishing clear accountability across the department.
* Establish and maintain a strong, risk\-based control environment, ensuring that all activities within the CLI's remit are effective, consistent and compliant with applicable legal and regulatory requirements, internal policies and the Bank's risk tolerance.
* Provide senior leadership and direction on complex or sensitive cases and operational matters, driving appropriate escalation and decision\-making.
* Represent the CLI at Senior Management and in relevant governance bodies, and act as a strategic partner to the Executive Management, the Front Office, Group foreign entities, the Compliance Department and other key stakeholders.
* Serve as a senior point of contact for FINMA, auditors and other relevant external stakeholders within the CLI's area of responsibility.
* Drive high standards, quality and effectiveness across the different CLI activities, supported by appropriate policies, procedures, controls, management information and risk and performance indicators.
* Ensure timely reporting of key risk and performance indicators to the Executive Management and relevant governance bodies.
* Build and develop a high\-performing management team and foster a culture of strong control, collaboration and operational excellence.
* Contribute to the preparation of external and internal audits, inspections as well as regulatory reviews.


**2\. Client Onboarding, Integrity\-related Lifecycle Management \& AML Transaction Monitoring**



* Oversee private client onboarding (incl. with respect to prospects introduced or managed by Group foreign entities), in line with applicable legal and regulatory requirements, internal policies and the Bank's risk tolerance.
* Oversee integrity\-related lifecycle activities, including periodic and event\-driven reviews, changes in circumstances, account maintenance, dormant account processes and closures, ensuring compliant and efficient execution.
* Oversee AML transaction monitoring across all client segments, ensuring effective identification, assessment and escalation of potentially suspicious activities.
* Ensure appropriate risk management and robust governance for complex or high\-risk client relationships and transactions, while maintaining effective collaboration with Front Office and the Compliance Department.


**3\. Process Effectiveness, Automation \& Continuous Improvement**



* Continuously enhance the effectiveness and scalability of CLI processes, with a focus on optimisation, automation and digitalisation.
* Identify and implement opportunities to leverage technology, data, analytics, workflow solutions and AI to reduce manual activities, improve quality, consistency and risk effectiveness and ensure compliance.
* Establish and monitor appropriate operational and quality metrics to identify performance gaps, assess outcomes and support informed management decisions.
* Work closely with technology functions as well as other relevant stakeholders to deliver sustainable improvements across client onboarding, integrity\-related lifecycle management and AML transaction monitoring as well as anticipate and adapt to the evolving client onboarding and lifecycle landscapes.
* a culture of continuous improvement, encouraging teams to challenge existing ways of working and identify practical opportunities to enhance operational efficiency and control effectiveness.

title: Master thesis / Internship in modelling of densified activated sludge in sequencing batch reactor
description:
Master thesis / Internship in modelling of densified activated sludge in sequencing batch reactor (DAS\-SBR)  
Eawag, the Swiss Federal Institute of Aquatic Science and Technology, is an internationally networked aquatic research institute within the ETH Domain (Swiss Federal Institutes of Technology). Eawag conducts research, education and expert consulting to achieve the dual goals of meeting direct human needs for water and maintaining the function and integrity of aquatic ecosystems.  
The Department of Process Engineering (ENG) has a vacancy for a  
Master thesis / Internship in modelling of densified activated sludge in sequencing batch reactor (DAS\-SBR)  
Densified Activated Sludge (DAS), a hybrid system consisting of flocs and small granules (typically 200\~500 ?m in diameter), is a promising solution for the increasing stringent effluent quality standards and the intensification of biological processes in wastewater treatment. Compared to conventional activated sludge, DAS offers significant advantages to "do more with less" \- increasing treatment capacity without expanding the plant footprint. The improved settleability enables high biomass retention, thereby substantially increasing volumetric treatment capacity. The enrichment of slow\-growing bacteria, particularly nitrifiers, promotes microbial activities and provides greater flexibility for optimizing aeration strategies for enhancing nutrient removal.  
The application of DAS in sequencing batch reactors (SBR) is being increasingly investigated and implemented worldwide, yielding many new valuable experimental findings and operational experience. However, a comprehensive understanding of long\-term performance of DAS\-SBR systems under dynamic conditions remains limited. Existing mathematical models do not yet adequately represent all relevant processes and characteristics, nor have they been calibrated and validated using real\-world operational data.  
This project aims to develop a DAS\-SBR model in Sumo, which can better represent the key biological and physical processes observed in practice. By calibrating and validating the model against real\-world datasets, the project seeks to improve the understanding of DAS\-SBR system and to provide a reliable tool for process analysis, optimization, and future design.  
We are looking for a motivated master thesis student or intern, who needs to be enrolled in a university for the entire thesis/internship duration, with interests in advanced technologies for biological wastewater treatment and modelling biological processes. Fluent spoken and written English are essential. Strong data analysis and programming skills and experience with modelling in Sumo are highly recommended. The preferred starting date is September/October 2026 onwards, not later than March 2027\.

We promote genuine participation, exchange, and mutual understanding. The FIM is the worldwide governing body for motorcycle sport and the global advocate for motorcycling. With some 50 World Championships organised under its aegis, the FIM works for the benefit of the sport and all its stakeholders.

**Your mission:**



Reporting to the CCR Director, Sporting Manager and Coordinators, you will support the administrative and sporting activities of the **Circuit Racing Commission (CCR)**, contributing to the smooth running of its disciplines, including FIM World Championships and Prizes.



Working closely with the CCR Director, Sporting Manager and Coordinators, you will support the preparation of meetings, seminars, regulations, sporting documentation and communications, while liaising with a wide range of internal and external stakeholders, including FMNs, CONUs, organisers, promoters, teams, riders and manufacturers.



We are looking for a well\-organised and proactive person with strong communication skills and attention to detail, who enjoys working as part of a team and is motivated to contribute to the activities of international motorcycle sport.



**Key responsibilities:**



**Administrative and Operational Support:** Provide day\-to\-day administrative support to the CCR Director, Sporting Manager and Coordinators in the management of the Commission's activities.



**Stakeholder Coordination:** Participate in maintaining regular contact with FMNs, CONUs, organisers, promoters, teams, riders and manufacturers’ associations and other stakeholders involved in the CCR disciplines.

**Meeting Organisation:** Support the preparation and organisation of CCR meetings, prepare agendas and meeting documentation, draft minutes and follow up on agreed actions.

**Seminar and Event Support:** Assist in the preparation of seminars, webinars, Superlicence seminars and other CCR events.

**Communication Support:** Contribute to the drafting and proofreading of communications and provide support to the Communication Division when required.

AG is a Swiss engineering and manufacturing company based in Muttenz (BL), specializing in high\-performance mixing, homogenizing and process systems for liquids and semi\-solids.

As continues to strengthen its technical and manufacturing capabilities, we are looking for an experienced professional to join our assembly team at our headquarters in Muttenz.

**Role Description**

The **Senior Mechanical Assembler** is a full\-time, on\-site position based at AG's headquarters in Muttenz (BL).

The role is responsible for the high\-quality mechanical assembly, installation, testing and maintenance of 's pharmaceutical and industrial process equipment.

The successful candidate will work independently from technical drawings, assembly documentation and engineering specifications to assemble complex mechanical systems and components according to 's quality standards.

The position requires strong mechanical expertise, precision and the ability to identify and resolve technical issues during assembly and testing.

**Key Responsibilities**

Perform complete mechanical assembly of machines, process equipment and related components. Independently read and interpret mechanical drawings, assembly drawings, technical specifications and bills of materials. Assemble complex mechanical systems, including vessels, agitators, homogenizers, gearboxes, mechanical seals, piping assemblies and machine frames. Install and correctly position mechanical, pneumatic and process components. Perform accurate fitting, alignment, adjustment and mechanical setting of components and assemblies. Carry out mechanical modifications and adjustments when required during assembly. Identify mechanical problems, determine root causes and implement appropriate corrective actions in coordination with Engineering. Perform dimensional and functional checks during the assembly process. Ensure that assembled equipment complies with drawings, specifications and applicable quality requirements. Support Factory Acceptance Tests (FAT) and machine testing activities. Support installation, commissioning, maintenance and troubleshooting activities at customer sites when required. Perform mechanical maintenance, repair and refurbishment of existing equipment. Work closely with Engineering, Automation, Project Management, Quality and Service teams. Provide technical guidance and practical support to junior assemblers and other workshop personnel. Maintain accurate assembly and production proper handling and care of tools, measuring equipment, machine components and a clean, organized and safe working environment. Follow 's internal quality procedures and applicable GMP\-related requirements. Contribute to continuous improvement of assembly methods, workshop organization and manufacturing processes.

**Qualifications**

Completed vocational education or technical training as a **Polymechanic, Mechanical Technician, Machine Mechanic, Industrial Mechanic, Mechanical Assembler** or equivalent. Several years of professional experience in mechanical assembly, preferably involving industrial machinery, process equipment or customized engineered systems. Strong ability to independently read and work from mechanical and technical drawings. knowledge of mechanical assembly techniques, tolerances, fits, bearings, seals and precision mechanical components. Experience with stainless\-steel process equipment, piping systems, hygienic components or pharmaceutical machinery is a strong advantage. Experience with pneumatic systems and basic understanding of automation components is beneficial. practical troubleshooting and problem\-solving level of precision and strong attention to detail. Independent, reliable and quality\-oriented working style. Ability to work effectively both independently and as part of a multidisciplinary technical team. Experience working according to GMP or pharmaceutical manufacturing requirements is an knowledge of  **and/or English**; ability to communicate in both languages is an advantage. Willingness to travel internationally when required for installation, commissioning, service or maintenance activities.

**What We Offer**

A key technical role within an established Swiss engineering company with more than 70 years of industry experience. The opportunity to work on high\-quality, customized pharmaceutical and industrial process equipment. A varied technical environment involving precision mechanics, machine assembly, testing, installation and service. Close collaboration with experienced engineers, automation specialists and project managers. Exposure to international pharmaceutical, biotechnology and industrial projects. The opportunity to take technical responsibility and contribute directly to the quality of 's machines. A dynamic working environment with short decision\-making processes. Workplace at AG's headquarters in Muttenz, Switzerland.

description:
Get to know Climeworks
Climeworks is a leading high-quality carbon removal provider, combining decades of expertise in Direct Air Capture (DAC) technology with a holistic approach to carbon removal solutions.

Climeworks advises companies on their carbon removal strategies and provides tailored portfolios of nature-based and engineered approaches, offering end-to-end services to help achieve net-zero goals. The company runs the world's first two DAC plants in Iceland, demonstrating its core commitment to high-quality carbon removal that is backed by over 15 years of pioneering research, development, and deployment.

By advancing the most reliable solutions in the market, Climeworks accelerates the global transition to net zero, unlocking economic value for businesses, governments, and society.

We foster a dynamic environment and are building a global purpose driven team. We are looking for disruptive thinkers, passionate achievers and inspiring leaders that are ready to take on the world’s greatest challenge.

Will you join us?

Job description
Product Development Ownership: You take ownership of developing innovative sorbent modules from approximately TRL3 to TRL6, optimizing trade-offs between product requirements, performance, manufacturability, and scalability.

Lifecycle Management: You lead the lifecycle management of new sorbent modules from TRL6 through product launch, service, and end-of-life, ensuring successful product deployment and long-term performance.

Validation & Industrialization: You coordinate the validation of new products through serial production delivery, initiating and driving all engineering, manufacturing, testing, and validation activities required for successful industrialization.

Cross-Functional Collaboration: You work closely with in-house technology, development, and operations teams, as well as external collaborators, suppliers, and partners, to ensure seamless product development and delivery.

Prototype Fabrication & Testing: You support the fabrication and testing of prototypes, conducting experiments to validate design concepts, troubleshoot issues, and refine product performance.

Continuous Improvement: You drive the continuous improvement of sorbent modules by identifying opportunities to enhance product performance, reliability, manufacturability, and cost-effectiveness throughout the product lifecycle.

Requirements

Educational Background & Experience: You hold an advanced degree in Mechanical Engineering or a related field and bring at least 5 years of industrial experience in product development, mechanical design, or design engineering.

Design & Engineering Expertise: You have hands-on experience with material selection, Design for Manufacturing and Assembly (DfMA), Design for Maintainability (DfM), and Design for the Environment (DfE), combined with a basic understanding of chemical processes and associated energy and productivity trade-offs.

Project Leadership: You have a proven track record of successfully managing development projects from concept through implementation, coordinating engineering activities and ensuring delivery through collaboration with cross-functional teams and external vendors.

Innovation & Problem Solving: You bring strong creative problem-solving skills and a passion for advancing sustainable technologies, with a particular interest in contributing to early-stage R&D and product innovation.

Collaboration & Communication: You are an effective communicator who enjoys working across multidisciplinary teams, mentoring junior engineers, and managing IP-sensitive collaborations with third-party suppliers and partners.

Language Skills & Availability: You are fluent in English and comfortable operating in an international, collaborative engineering environment. You are available to work 80–100% and are willing to travel up to 10% as required.

Our promise: At Climeworks, you are accepted for who you are, and we are committed to building an inclusive environment where everyone feels valued. We encourage all qualified applicants to apply – regardless of background, identity, or experience. Studies show that women and individuals from minority backgrounds often only apply for jobs when they meet 100% of the listed criteria. If this sounds like you, don’t hold back. If you think you’d make a great fit for this role, we’d love to hear from you, even if you don’t check every single box. Let’s tackle one of humankind’s greatest challenges together.

What we offer:

Time Off: Enjoy 25 paid vacation days every year, plus public holidays.
Flexibility: Work how it suits you best. We offer a hybrid work setup and up to 4 weeks of remote work annually within any EU country.
Ownership: Fair base pay paired with an equity package – because your contributions matter.
Family Support: Inclusive parental leave.
Continuous Learning: Dedicated budget to invest in your professional growth.
Referral Rewards: Help us grow our team and earn bonuses for your successful referrals.

Salary: At Climeworks, salary ranges are assigned to a job based on the level of seniority and the location specific market median of similar jobs according to external benchmark surveys. Individual compensation depends on your skills, experience, and the value you bring to the team.

Formalities:

This position is based in Opfikon, Zurich, and we ask that you work onsite at least three days per week.

The percentage in the job title means flexibility – choose full-time or part-time based on what works for you.

We do not accept candidate profiles through recruitment agencies.

Global Head of Regulatory Strategy
==================================

**The Opportunity**


NonStop Consulting is partnering with an established international pharmaceutical organisation to appoint a Global Head of Regulatory Strategy.

This is a high\-impact senior leadership opportunity for an accomplished Regulatory Affairs executive to shape and drive global regulatory strategy across an international pharmaceutical portfolio.

The successful candidate will play a pivotal role in defining regulatory direction, influencing critical development and commercial decisions, and ensuring the successful execution of regulatory strategies across key international markets.

In this senior leadership position, you will combine strategic oversight with hands\-on leadership, guiding an experienced international team and collaborating closely with key cross\-functional stakeholders.

Key Responsibilities
--------------------

* Global Regulatory Strategy: Define, lead and execute comprehensive regulatory strategies across multiple assets, from clinical development through registration, commercialisation and lifecycle management.
* Strategic Leadership: Provide senior\-level regulatory guidance to global development teams, ensuring regulatory considerations are embedded in key portfolio and business decisions.
* Regulatory Authority Engagement: Oversee high\-level interactions and negotiations with major international health authorities, including the FDA, EMA, PMDA and other relevant regulatory bodies.
* Global Team Leadership: Lead, develop and mentor an international team of senior regulatory professionals, fostering accountability, collaboration and high performance.
* Portfolio Oversight: Direct regulatory strategy and execution across key markets, including the US, Europe and selected international territories.
* Executive Collaboration: Contribute to global regulatory leadership decisions, resource allocation, risk management and long\-term functional strategy.
* Business Development Support: Provide strategic regulatory input into due diligence activities, potential licensing opportunities and portfolio assessments.
* Operational Excellence: continuous improvement, innovation and the responsible adoption of new technologies to enhance regulatory effectiveness.
* Cross\-Functional Partnership: Collaborate closely with Clinical Development, Medical Affairs, Quality, Commercial and other global functions to support business objectives.


**Your Profile**
----------------


We are seeking an experienced, commercially aware and strategically minded Regulatory Affairs leader with the credibility to operate at the highest levels of an international pharmaceutical organisation.


**Essential experience and qualification**s:

* Extensive experience in Regulatory Affairs within the pharmaceutical industry.
* Significant leadership and organisational management experience, ideally within an international regulatory function.
* Proven experience defining and delivering global regulatory strategies across complex pharmaceutical portfolios.
* Extensive experience engaging with major regulatory authorities, particularly the FDA and EMA, with broader international regulatory exposure.
* Strong understanding of global drug development, registration, commercialisation and product lifecycle management.
* Demonstrated ability to build, lead and develop international teams, including senior regulatory leaders.
* Excellent stakeholder management, influencing and negotiation skills, with experience contributing to executive\-level decision\-making.
* Strong strategic judgement, regulatory risk management capabilities and the ability to navigate complex development challenges.
* Bachelor's degree in a relevant scientific discipline required; PharmD, PhD or equivalent advanced qualification preferred.
* Fluency in English.
* Experience with specialised therapies, complex development programmes or niche therapeutic areas would be advantageous


Why Consider This Opportunity?
------------------------------

* Executive\-level influence: Play a key role in shaping global regulatory strategy and contributing to high\-level business decisions.
* International scope: Take ownership of regulatory strategy across multiple markets and a diverse pharmaceutical portfolio.
* Leadership impact: Lead and develop an established team of experienced regulatory professionals.
* Strategic visibility: Work closely with senior leadership and influence the direction of a global regulatory function.
* Innovation and transformation: Drive continuous improvement and contribute to the evolution of regulatory strategy and operational excellence.
* Meaningful impact: Support the development and successful commercialisation of innovative therapies for patients worldwide.

--------------------------------

Further details regarding the organisation, leadership structure and strategic priorities will be shared with suitably qualified candidates during a confidential discussion.
